chapters.title: Chapter 2451 Fighting Owen(2)
paragraphs: After being provoked by Yuan, Owen's aura surged, unleashing at least thirty percent of his strength as an Absolute God.
A light smile tugged at Yuan's lips when Owen continued to underestimate him, which wasn't surprising, as he'd purposefully allowed himself to be overwhelmed just now.
Without exchanging any more words, Yuan and Owen clashed shortly later.
Owen used both Blood Manipulation and Bone Techniques, a power he'd acquired after absorbing many Bone Demons through the Supreme Immolation Array.
Not wanting to alarm Owen too early, Yuan deliberately restrained himself—matching Owen's strength just closely enough to appear slightly inferior.

'What the hell is happening?! How is a mere first level False God rivaling me, an Absolute God who has been empowered through the Supreme Immolation Array?!' Owen cried inwardly, feeling shocked even though his face didn't show it.
Even though he was still holding back the majority of his strength, it still didn't make sense.

A False God was so insignificant that even a True God could easily kill one without any effort, much less an Absolute God like Owen, who could kill True Gods with five percent of his true strength. Yet, Yuan, who was a mere first level False God, was barely keeping up with him.
'No...!' Owen's pupils shrank as the realization struck him. 'I've been steadily increasing my strength, yet he's still barely keeping up—as if he's growing stronger alongside me!'
'This bastard... he's still mocking me!' Suddenly, Owen drastically increased his output to seventy percent of his true power.
Owen's sudden surge in power quickly overwhelmed Yuan, and it became obvious that he could no longer keep up.
"Hahaha! What's wrong, you damn bastard?!" Owen jeered. "Having trouble matching me?! Matching strength is a privilege reserved for the stronger one—you insignificant ant!"
"I guess this is the limit of my Demonic Awakening... alone." Yuan mumbled after seeing his limit.

After absorbing so much Demon God's Ordeal, Yuan's demon form had strengthened significantly even if it didn't fully ascend—to the point where even he couldn't tell how strong he'd become with it alone until just now.
Sure enough, Yuan had been relying on nothing but his Demonic Awakening this entire time, and he was able to match Owen using around fifty percent of his strength as an Absolute God.
In other words, Yuan, as a first level False God in his Demonic Awakening and with the Demon Annihilation Sword out, was as strong as an Absolute God demon using half of their strength.
Even though the Demon Annihilation Sword was far away, as long as it was out in the world, Yuan would still receive its effects.

It should also be noted that Owen in his current state was much stronger than Supreme Ruler Grant without his fake Eternal Essence. However, when compared to Supreme Ruler Dena, he was still slightly behind.
The next moment, Yuan activated Absolute Dragon Awakening and True Phoenix Awakening, causing his aura to skyrocket even higher.
"What?!" Owen's eyes widened in shock after seeing how much stronger Yuan's presence got out of thin air even though his cultivation remained the same.
However, Yuan wasn't done and also used Chaotic Essence to further strengthen himself.
"Let's fight for real this time, shall we?" he said with a calm smile on his face.
They continued their fight the next moment.
Meanwhile, in Death Paradise, Helena and Angela were getting impatient. "Damn it! What the hell is taking him so long?! Don't tell me that he ditched us, too?!" Helena cried out loud.

"Let's not jump to conclusions so quickly," Selena said while shaking her head. "He'd just left, and I doubt he'd abandon his friends." "T-That's right! He wouldn't abandon us—at least not Supreme Ruler Dena!" Lev said in a nervous voice. "After all, I personally watched him risk his life just to meet her."
"Oh? Tell me more about it," Selena said, sounding interested in it.

"Well, I didn't follow him all the way since it was too dangerous for me, but what happened was..." Lev explained the kind of place the Deprived Crimson Valley was before talking about Supreme Ruler Dena's condition, what she'd done there, and how Yuan went to meet her despite the danger.
"Are they lovers?" Selena asked with an excited smile on her face.
"Uh... I don't think so, but I also cannot say for sure, so you'll have to ask him when he returns.
Time passed quickly, in the blink of an eye, several days had gone by since Yuan was sent to capture Owen.
"How?! How the hell is a False God like you fighting an Absolute God like me?!" Owen roared out loud, sounding irritated and confused at the same time.
He was certain Yuan's cultivation was only at the first level of False God, and that he wasn't suppressing it, but that only made things more perplexing.
Yuan wasn't exactly overwhelming in battle, yet their strengths seemed evenly matched, as neither could kill the other, leaving them locked in a stalemate.

Suddenly, in the middle of their battle, Yuan's aura suddenly started to change. "This bastard! He's having a breakthrough in the middle of our fight?!" Owen cried out loud when he realized that Yuan's cultivation was slowly soaring to the next level.

After consuming the True Emperor of the Seas' and the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence, Yuan had actually accumulated enough energy to enter the next realm. However, he purposefully suppressed it and kept his cultivation at the first level of God Ascension, as he hadn't encountered a threat that required him to really push his cultivation further.
<You have entered the Second Level of God Ascension!>
Suddenly, Yuan felt a strange sensation, as if he were recovering forgotten memories, except what returned wasn't memory at all, but his strength.
<Your Soul Strength has drastically increased!>
After entering the Second Level of God Ascension, some of the Soul Strength that Yuan gained during his ascension but lost after exiting it returned to him.
One might expect it to be a little, but in a split second, Yuan's Soul Strength increased by leaps and bounds, becoming at least a dozen times stronger in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 2452 Fighting Owen(3)
paragraphs: <Demon Sealing Zone>
After his breakthrough, Yuan immediately activated Demon Sealing Zone, forming a barrier around himself and Owen.

"This trick again?! How many times do I have to destroy it before you learn that it won't contain me?!" Owen sneered as he struck the barrier, expecting it to shatter as easily as before. But when his Bone Technique slammed into the Demon Sealing Zone, it didn't collapse in a single blow. Instead, it only produced a thin crack—one that mended itself in the blink of an eye.
"What?!"
Owen's eyes widened with surprise. He couldn't fathom how the difference of a single level could be this vast, and he was beginning to doubt whether Yuan was actually going all out before.

However, even though Yuan's Soul Strength witnessed a tremendous growth from his breakthrough, it was the only thing that really had a drastic difference, as everything else was lackluster in comparison.
'I guess Dena was right—that I will slowly regain the Soul Strength I gained during the phenomenon as my cultivation increases,' Yuan thought to himself.
And since his Demon Sealing Aura was tied to his Soul Strength, his Demon Sealing Techniques had become powerful enough to truly affect Absolute Gods, where before, they were barely effective.
However, even though his Demon Sealing Techniques were finally effective, he was still nowhere near strong enough to overpower Owen without using Eternal Essence.
Owen, realizing this, no longer wanted to slowly torture Yuan to death and decided to try and finish Yuan as quickly as possible.
Now that he had no further interest in keeping Yuan alive, Owen abandoned all restraint and unleashed his full cultivation as he clashed with him.
"Demon Annihilation Sword," Yuan muttered.
In the next instant, the Demon Annihilation Sword, who was with Lev and the others, abruptly vanished into thin air, before reappearing at Yuan's side.
"Who the hell are you and where did you come from?!" Owen halted his movement to analyze the newcomer.
"You're not a living being but a treasure...?" Owen could hardly believe his eyes after realizing her true form, as he'd never seen a treasure take the form of a human before.
"Master, can I devour him?" The Demon Annihilation Sword asked as she pointed at Owen.
"Not entirely, but you can take some small bites out of him," Yuan said. "Just make sure you don't kill him."
The Demon Annihilation Sword nodded, but before she went to confront Owen, she extended her arm toward Yuan and handed something to him.
"This is...?"
Yuan looked at the object she handed him with raised eyebrows.
It was a small, round object resembling a marble. Moreover, it was something he knew very well, as he had consumed many of them before.
"Where did you get this Demon Core?" Yuan asked her. "And who does it belong to?"
The object she handed him was a Demon Core, and it contained an immense amount of energy—far more than any Demon Core he'd consumed before. Of course, this included the Demon Emperors' Demon Cores.
"This belongs to the one I just finished consuming," she said.
"The one you just consumed? That would mean it belongs to... Supreme Ruler Exosso...?" Yuan stared at her with wide eyes.
As far as he was aware, Supreme Ruler Exosso didn't leave behind a Demon Core after his death, so how did she acquire it?
Unfortunately, Yuan didn't have the time to ponder about it, and the Demon Annihilation Sword went to confront Owen before he could ask any more questions.
Although Yuan had planned on fighting Owen with the Demon Annihilation Sword, he decided to let her handle him for the beginning.
"Take care of him for a bit," Yuan said to her.
"Yes, Master!"
The next moment, Yuan lifted the fingers clutching Supreme Ruler Exosso's Demon Core to his lips and swallowed it without the slightest hesitation.
<You have consumed Supreme Ruler Exosso's Demon Core!>
<You have learned Bone Manipulation!>
Yuan immediately felt his bones reforming, growing denser and tougher.
However, that wasn't all, as his cultivation also started to climb again, swiftly approaching the third level of God Ascension.

Even though he had just entered the second level of God Ascension, the sheer amount of spiritual energy he'd obtained from the Blood Essences was enough to push his cultivation close to the third level right after his breakthrough.
Soon, he'd acquired enough spiritual energy to enter the third level.

Yuan considered keeping his cultivation at the second level, but if he wanted to capture Owen, he'd need to seal him, and in order to do that, he must strengthen his Demon Sealing Aura—his Soul Strength.
Thus, he decided to have the breakthrough now.
After taking a deep breath, Yuan immediately made his attempt, and thanks to his past experience, he succeeded on the first try with ease.
Within moments after consuming the Demon Core, Yuan stepped into the third level of God Ascension, mere minutes after entering the second level.
<You have entered the Third Level of God Ascension!>
Once again, Yuan felt the same sensation from his previous breakthrough.
<Your Soul Strength has drastically increased!>
Immediately after his breakthrough, Yuan wasted no time joining the Demon Annihilation Sword's battle with Owen.
<Demon Annihilation Array!>
Yuan unleashed the Demon Sealing Zone's true potential.
"Not this bullshit again!"
Owen unleashed his strongest attack against the barrier, but to his shock, he couldn't even produce a single crack this time.
However, Yuan wasn't done.
<Sword of Eternal Torment!>
Millions of glowing swords materialized in the sky, covering it like a blanket.
"Have some of my Demon Sealing Aura," Yuan said aloud as he started transferring his Demon Sealing Aura to the Demon Annihilation Sword, fueling it with even more power.
"This is insane... How can a single being possess so much power...?" Owen muttered in a daze, as the fear he once held for Tian Chenyu—buried deep within his soul—began to resurface.
But he quickly snapped out of his daze and retrieved a small, round object from his spatial ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 2453 The Eternal Behind Owen
paragraphs: "Oh?" A smile tugged at Yuan's lips when he saw what Owen pulled out of his spatial ring.
"I thought you didn't need to rely on that thing to deal with me," he said with a mocking smile.
"Shut the hell up, you damn monster!" Owen roared as he controlled the treasure, causing it to hover before him.
"I wouldn't use that treasure if I were you," Yuan said while shaking his head.
"And why the hell not?! If you think you can fool me—"
"Because I will have to fight you seriously, and I don't want to accidentally kill you."
Owen stared at him with wide eyes and in stunned silence.
"Hahaha!" He burst out laughing a moment later.
"Even if you are somehow hiding more power, you will never match—"
Owen abruptly halted his speech and even nearly choked on his own laughter when an unfathomable aura suddenly exploded from Yuan's body.
"Y-You!"
His gaze shifted between Yuan and his treasure nonstop.
"That power! Impossible!"
While Owen was in a daze, Yuan controlled the millions of glowing swords in the sky, combining them into a single, behemoth sword.
<Divine Judgment!>
The sword descended toward Owen with immense speed, but the target himself was too shocked to even realize it.
By the time he realized, it was already too late.
The massive sword plunged into Owen from the top of his head and continued to fall until it pieced through the entire island.
However, while it appeared as if his body had been cleanly cleaved in two, the blade did not actually sever him and only left him pinned in place instead.
An immense amount of Demon Sealing Aura rushed into Owen's body, and despite his desperate attempt to fight back, he was sealed almost instantly.
When Owen was sealed and turned into a stone statue, his control of the treasure was disrupted, and it fell to the ground with a soft thud.
Yuan picked up the treasure and muttered, "As much as I want to see the power of this thing, I have a promise to keep."
After putting away the treasure, Yuan grabbed Owen's petrified body and jumped into the crimson sea together.
<Water Tunnel!>
Yuan used Water Tunnel for the first time, traversing through the Bloody Expanse and returning to Selena and the others in the blink of an eye.
"Here's Owen, as promised," Yuan said as he emerged from the crimson sea, rising from its depths in a manner similar to the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.
"He's not dead... right?" Helena looked at Owen's petrified body with a deep frown.
"No, he's just sealed. I can unseal him right now if you want."
"Do it." Helena said with a cold smile on her face, even cracking her knuckles in excitement.
"I'm unsealing him now."
Yuan unsealed Owen the next moment.
"You bastard! I will—"
Owen immediately began hurling curses loudly, but the moment he saw Helena and Angela hovering before him, his entire body stiffened.
"H-How? How the hell are you outside Death Paradise?!" Owen screamed in disbelief, still thinking that he was in Bone Atoll.
Although the sky was dark, a prime characteristic of Death Paradise, Owen's mind was too occupied with Helena and Angela's presence to notice it.
'I need to run!' Owen subconsciously began to run, but his attempt was halted before it could even begin.
"Don't even think about leaving, you little traitor."
Helena suddenly grabbed him by his neck before his body could even move.
"W-Wait! I can explain!" Owen hastily said.
"I'll listen to you... once I exhaust some of this anger!"
However, before Helena could start her torture session, Yuan said to her, "Before you kill him, let me ask him some questions."
Then he said to Owen, "If you answer my questions, I will ask them to spare you."
"I-I will answer them! All of them!" Owen quickly replied.
"What was your master's goal? Why did you want the Transcendents' blood?"
"I don't know! The Demon God didn't tell me anything besides to acquire their blood!"
"What?! You are working with the Demon God?!" Selena and the others were immediately alarmed by his words.

However, Yuan quickly explained, "He just thinks that he's working with the Demon God. I highly doubt the Demon God is really behind him. If the Demon God really needed your blood, he wouldn't resort to such schemes."
"Where is my blood, anyway?" Helena glared at him.
"I-It's in my spatial ring..."
"What were you going to do after acquiring it?" Yuan asked after snatching his spatial ring.
"I need to deliver it to my master in the Boundless Expanse..." he said.
"And how are you going to do that?" Angela asked.
"I was going to contact my master to update him, but before I could do that, he appeared before me." Owen said, pointing at Yuan with his eyes.
"How do you contact him? Through this?" Yuan showed Owen his own treasure.
He silently nodded.
"Is that so? Well, that's all I need to know."
Yuan turned around, as if ready to leave.
"Wait! What about your promise?!"
"Oh, right. I almost forgot." Yuan turned to face Helena and asked, "Can you spare him?"
"No." Helena instantly refused.
Yuan looked at Owen and shrugged in a nonchalant manner, "I tried."
"B-Bullshit! You didn't even put in the slightest effort!" Owen roared loudly.
"Why should I? I only said I'd ask them, and that's exactly what I did. Whether they are willing to spare you or not is not up to me."
"I'll excuse myself now. If you need anything from me, you can let Selena or Angela know. As for the blood I gave him... you can keep it," Helena said to Yuan, preparing to drag Owen away.
"N-No! Spare me!! Please!!!" Owen started begging for mercy.
"You can ask Selena because I will also join Helena," Angela then said.
Without another word, the two of them vanished into the void, dragging Owen away with them.
"What are you going to do now?" Selena suddenly appeared beside Yuan and asked him.
Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was still in her cocoon, and then looked at Owen's treasure in his grasp.
"I am going to see who's behind this whole thing," he said.
"You're going to contact the one supporting Owen?" Selena's eyes widened at his words, even swallowing nervously.
After all, he was going to contact someone who might be on equal terms with the Demon God.
Some time later, Yuan began examining the treasure in detail.
Unsurprisingly, the system had no information on the treasure.
However, just from his own examination, Yuan could tell that it was mostly a communication treasure with some offensive function.
Eventually, Yuan activated the treasure and tried to contact the Eternal behind everything.
Soon, a voice entered Yuan's head.
"What do you want?"
Yuan's eyes widened with shock and disbelief after hearing this voice because he actually recognized it.
"Why are you staying silent?" The voice returned moments later when Yuan didn't respond, sounding annoyed.
"Hahaha!" Yuan suddenly burst out laughing.
"Have you gone insane?" "I knew we'd meet again one day, but I never expected it would be in this manner, Zaaran!" Yuan said.
The Eternal behind Owen was none other than Zaaran, who had turned Kulas into a giant and started the first major war in the Nine Heavens.
"How the hell do you know my name?!" Zaaran exclaimed in shock.
"Wait! You are not Owen! Who the hell are you?!"
"I know it's been a while since we last spoke, but have you really forgotten my voice already?" Yuan said.
"We've met before...?" Zaaran muttered before falling into a pondering silence.
Eventually, he spoke again, "You! I remember! You are the bastard who killed Kulas! Tian Yang!"
"Took you long enough, you son of a bitch!" Yuan laughed out loud.
"I should be the one laughing! I thought you had perished long ago, but it seems like I am fated to end you with my own hands!" Zaaran also burst out laughing.
"What happened to Owen, you little bastard?" Zaaran asked a moment later.
"I will tell you, but under one condition," Yuan said.
"You are in no position to make any demands!" Zaaran roared.
"Even though I have what you want? The blood of a Transcendent?"
"How the hell do you know that?"
"What do you think?"
After a moment of silence, Zaaran asked, "What do you want?"
"I want to fight you!" Yuan passionately announced. "Come meet me at the Demonic Realm and fight me!"
Zaaran fell silent again, seemingly stunned speechless by Yuan's request.
But before Zaaran could respond, Yuan continued, "Why are you so quiet? Don't tell me you're afraid of me, an insignificant human? Worried that I might defeat you again, you pathetic little worm?"
"I ACCEPT YOUR CHALLENGE, YOU ARROGANT LITTLE BASTARD! SEVEN DAYS! I WILL BE THERE TO END YOUR INSIGNIFICANT LIFE IN SEVEN DAYS!"

sentences.text: "Oh?" A smile tugged at Yuan's lips when he saw what Owen pulled out of his spatial ring.
"I thought you didn't need to rely on that thing to deal with me," he said with a mocking smile.
"Shut the hell up, you damn monster!" Owen roared as he controlled the treasure, causing it to hover before him.
"I wouldn't use that treasure if I were you," Yuan said while shaking his head.
"And why the hell not?!
If you think you can fool me—"
"Because I will have to fight you seriously, and I don't want to accidentally kill you."
Owen stared at him with wide eyes and in stunned silence.
"Hahaha!" He burst out laughing a moment later.
"Even if you are somehow hiding more power, you will never match—"
Owen abruptly halted his speech and even nearly choked on his own laughter when an unfathomable aura suddenly exploded from Yuan's body.
"Y-You!"
His gaze shifted between Yuan and his treasure nonstop.
"That power!
Impossible!"
While Owen was in a daze, Yuan controlled the millions of glowing swords in the sky, combining them into a single, behemoth sword.
<Divine Judgment!>
The sword descended toward Owen with immense speed, but the target himself was too shocked to even realize it.
By the time he realized, it was already too late.
The massive sword plunged into Owen from the top of his head and continued to fall until it pieced through the entire island.
However, while it appeared as if his body had been cleanly cleaved in two, the blade did not actually sever him and only left him pinned in place instead.
An immense amount of Demon Sealing Aura rushed into Owen's body, and despite his desperate attempt to fight back, he was sealed almost instantly.
When Owen was sealed and turned into a stone statue, his control of the treasure was disrupted, and it fell to the ground with a soft thud.
Yuan picked up the treasure and muttered, "As much as I want to see the power of this thing, I have a promise to keep."
After putting away the treasure, Yuan grabbed Owen's petrified body and jumped into the crimson sea together.
<Water Tunnel!>
Yuan used Water Tunnel for the first time, traversing through the Bloody Expanse and returning to Selena and the others in the blink of an eye.
"Here's Owen, as promised," Yuan said as he emerged from the crimson sea, rising from its depths in a manner similar to the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.
"He's not dead... right?" Helena looked at Owen's petrified body with a deep frown.
"No, he's just sealed.
I can unseal him right now if you want."
"Do it." Helena said with a cold smile on her face, even cracking her knuckles in excitement.
"I'm unsealing him now."
Yuan unsealed Owen the next moment.
"You bastard!
I will—"
Owen immediately began hurling curses loudly, but the moment he saw Helena and Angela hovering before him, his entire body stiffened.
"H-How?
How the hell are you outside Death Paradise?!" Owen screamed in disbelief, still thinking that he was in Bone Atoll.
Although the sky was dark, a prime characteristic of Death Paradise, Owen's mind was too occupied with Helena and Angela's presence to notice it.
'I need to run!' Owen subconsciously began to run, but his attempt was halted before it could even begin.
"Don't even think about leaving, you little traitor."
Helena suddenly grabbed him by his neck before his body could even move.
"W-Wait!
I can explain!" Owen hastily said.
"I'll listen to you... once I exhaust some of this anger!"
However, before Helena could start her torture session, Yuan said to her, "Before you kill him, let me ask him some questions."
Then he said to Owen, "If you answer my questions, I will ask them to spare you."
"I-I will answer them!
All of them!" Owen quickly replied.
"What was your master's goal?
Why did you want the Transcendents' blood?"
"I don't know!
The Demon God didn't tell me anything besides to acquire their blood!"
"What?!
You are working with the Demon God?!" Selena and the others were immediately alarmed by his words.
However, Yuan quickly explained, "He just thinks that he's working with the Demon God.
I highly doubt the Demon God is really behind him.
If the Demon God really needed your blood, he wouldn't resort to such schemes."
"Where is my blood, anyway?" Helena glared at him.
"I-It's in my spatial ring..."
"What were you going to do after acquiring it?" Yuan asked after snatching his spatial ring.
"I need to deliver it to my master in the Boundless Expanse..." he said.
"And how are you going to do that?" Angela asked.
"I was going to contact my master to update him, but before I could do that, he appeared before me." Owen said, pointing at Yuan with his eyes.
"How do you contact him?
Through this?" Yuan showed Owen his own treasure.
He silently nodded.
"Is that so?
Well, that's all I need to know."
Yuan turned around, as if ready to leave.
"Wait!
What about your promise?!"
"Oh, right.
I almost forgot." Yuan turned to face Helena and asked, "Can you spare him?"
"No." Helena instantly refused.
Yuan looked at Owen and shrugged in a nonchalant manner, "I tried."
"B-Bullshit!
You didn't even put in the slightest effort!" Owen roared loudly.
"Why should I?
I only said I'd ask them, and that's exactly what I did.
Whether they are willing to spare you or not is not up to me."
"I'll excuse myself now.
If you need anything from me, you can let Selena or Angela know.
As for the blood I gave him... you can keep it," Helena said to Yuan, preparing to drag Owen away.
"N-No!
Spare me!!
Please!!!" Owen started begging for mercy.
"You can ask Selena because I will also join Helena," Angela then said.
Without another word, the two of them vanished into the void, dragging Owen away with them.
"What are you going to do now?" Selena suddenly appeared beside Yuan and asked him.
Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was still in her cocoon, and then looked at Owen's treasure in his grasp.
"I am going to see who's behind this whole thing," he said.
"You're going to contact the one supporting Owen?" Selena's eyes widened at his words, even swallowing nervously.
After all, he was going to contact someone who might be on equal terms with the Demon God.
Some time later, Yuan began examining the treasure in detail.
Unsurprisingly, the system had no information on the treasure.
However, just from his own examination, Yuan could tell that it was mostly a communication treasure with some offensive function.
Eventually, Yuan activated the treasure and tried to contact the Eternal behind everything.
Soon, a voice entered Yuan's head.
"What do you want?"
Yuan's eyes widened with shock and disbelief after hearing this voice because he actually recognized it.
"Why are you staying silent?" The voice returned moments later when Yuan didn't respond, sounding annoyed.
"Hahaha!" Yuan suddenly burst out laughing.
"Have you gone insane?" "I knew we'd meet again one day, but I never expected it would be in this manner, Zaaran!" Yuan said.
The Eternal behind Owen was none other than Zaaran, who had turned Kulas into a giant and started the first major war in the Nine Heavens.
"How the hell do you know my name?!" Zaaran exclaimed in shock.
"Wait!
You are not Owen!
Who the hell are you?!"
"I know it's been a while since we last spoke, but have you really forgotten my voice already?" Yuan said.
"We've met before...?" Zaaran muttered before falling into a pondering silence.
Eventually, he spoke again, "You!
I remember!
You are the bastard who killed Kulas!
Tian Yang!"
"Took you long enough, you son of a bitch!" Yuan laughed out loud.
"I should be the one laughing!
I thought you had perished long ago, but it seems like I am fated to end you with my own hands!" Zaaran also burst out laughing.
"What happened to Owen, you little bastard?" Zaaran asked a moment later.
"I will tell you, but under one condition," Yuan said.
"You are in no position to make any demands!" Zaaran roared.
"Even though I have what you want?
The blood of a Transcendent?"
"How the hell do you know that?"
"What do you think?"
After a moment of silence, Zaaran asked, "What do you want?"
"I want to fight you!" Yuan passionately announced.
"Come meet me at the Demonic Realm and fight me!"
Zaaran fell silent again, seemingly stunned speechless by Yuan's request.
But before Zaaran could respond, Yuan continued, "Why are you so quiet?
Don't tell me you're afraid of me, an insignificant human?
Worried that I might defeat you again, you pathetic little worm?"
"I ACCEPT YOUR CHALLENGE, YOU ARROGANT LITTLE BASTARD!
SEVEN DAYS!
I WILL BE THERE TO END YOUR INSIGNIFICANT LIFE IN SEVEN DAYS!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2454 Sheltered by the Absolute Power
paragraphs: "I'm so scared," Yuan replied in a sarcastic tone after hearing Zaaran's words.
"Just you wait! I will kill—no! I will turn you into my puppet and have you serve me for the rest of your life, just as Kulas had done!"
"You talk too much, Zaaran. Hurry up and get your ass here so I can finally punch that ugly face of yours!" Yuan laughed madly.
Zaaran offered no response. In the next instant, Owen's treasure detonated, releasing a violent surge of Eternal Essence that blasted outward like a bomb.

Zaaran probably thought it would harm Yuan a little, but he could've never anticipated that his actions would actually benefit Yuan, who absorbed all of the Eternal Essence and turned it into his own strength.
Though it wasn't much, Yuan needed as much Eternal Essence as he could before fighting Zaaran.
Even though he was the one who picked the fight, Yuan realized that he might have rushed things a little too much out of passion and anger.
Not only does he not know Zaaran's prowess, but he wasn't sure he could defeat an Eternal in his current state, especially when the Absolute Power wasn't there to suppress the Eternal's powers.

However, even if he wasn't confident he could defeat Zaaran, and there was a chance things might turn out badly for him, Yuan had no intention of backing away from a fight he started, especially when his opponent was Zaaran, one of the first Eternals to offend him.
"You... what have you done?" Selena asked, staring at Yuan with a dumbfounded expression.
Though she hadn't heard their conversation, the look on Yuan's face—and the fact that the treasure had exploded right in his face—was more than enough to tell her things had gone very, very wrong.
"Oh, it's nothing serious. I just picked a fight with the bastard, and he agreed, so we'll be fighting in seven days from now."
"What?!" Selena exclaimed in shock. "Why would you do that? This being is potentially as powerful as the Demon God, no?"
"Who knows? I will find out when I fight him." Yuan casually shrugged.
"But why?" Selena asked again.
"Because I already know this Eternal, and I have a grudge with it."
"What about us?" Lev suddenly asked.
Yuan turned to look at them and said, "This is a battle you won't be able to participate in, so just stay here and wait for my return."
"Supreme Ruler Grant... you can return to the Crimson Continent if you want, as your presence is no longer necessary—even though you haven't been of any use at all."
"Really?!" Supreme Ruler Grant's face immediately brightened with delight and relief.
"Just make sure you remember never to invade my world because I won't spare you for a second time."
Supreme Ruler Grant vigorously nodded his head.
"I swear upon the Demon God's name that I won't even think about invading your world! Then, I will leave now!"
Without hesitation or waiting for another moment, he turned around and started flying away at maximum speed, as if he were worried that Yuan might suddenly change his mind.
In the blink of an eye, Supreme Ruler Grant vanished from their sights.
"That's not the direction to the Crimson Continent, though." Selena eventually remarked.
"I'm sure he'll figure it out." Yuan said.
"Anyway... I have something I must do before Zaaran gets here..."
Yuan slowly lifted his head, his gaze rising toward the heavens, but his focus wasn't the sky itself. Instead, he seemed to be looking at something beyond it.
"Deemo! I know you're watching this! How long do you intend to stay quiet?!" Yuan roared out loud.
"Deemo?" Selena raised an eyebrow at this unfamiliar name, unaware that it was the Demon God's true name.
In the very next moment, an unfathomable presence descended—one that did not merely engulf Death Paradise, but spread across the entirety of the Demonic Realm.
"This presence...?!" Selena's entire body stiffened as she instantly recognized it, her expression turning deathly pale as fear overtook her features.
Lev trembled as well, but his fear was instinctive—an involuntary reaction to the overwhelming presence. In contrast, Selena's terror was born from experience, making it far more profound.
Selena turned to look at Yuan, who remained as calm as before. In fact, he was probably the only person in the world who could remain calm at this moment.
Before she could utter a single word, a silhouette materialized a few meters in front of Yuan like a phantom.
It bore the shape of a human, yet its entire form was pitch black—like a figure carved from the void itself. Its head was smooth and round, devoid of hair, and its face... was completely featureless.
"What do you want from me now?" Deemo spoke first.
"Are you seriously asking me that? As if you don't already know the situation," Yuan replied.
"..." Deemo fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "Once again, you are putting my world in danger—"
"Now hold it right there."
Yuan suddenly interrupted.
"Let's not act like I started this, okay? An Eternal was scheming in your world long before I even entered the stage."
"Hell, do you even know what's happening? Don't tell me you are actually oblivious to something that is occurring in your own world?"
Yuan narrowed his eyes at Deemo, his brows lifting slightly. He had always assumed that Deemo was aware of everything happening within his own world—but perhaps that wasn't entirely true.
"This may be my world, but I do not pay attention to it every second. There are things even I am unaware of," Deemo finally responded.
His words left not only Yuan stunned. Even Selena stood there in shock at the revelation.
"Why are you so surprised? It's not like this world is the only thing that requires my attention. In fact, it's the least of my concerns right now."
Deemo shook his head.
"Anyway, fill me in. I know that another Eternal is involved, but I do not know the details."
However, Yuan didn't immediately respond, as he didn't want to give up such information for free.
Seeing Yuan remain silent, Deemo sighed.
"If you tell me, I will consider the favor you owe from repaid," he said a moment later.
Yuan nodded and explained the situation to him, revealing that Zaaran had been scheming in his world.
"That's the gist of it. Do you know why Zaaran would want to acquire their blood?" Yuan wasn't expecting anything, but to his surprise, Deemo actually nodded his head and said, "I have an idea."
"Why?"
"Why do you care? It's not something you need to worry about, anyway."
"Because if Zaaran wants something, I want to take it away from him."
Although Deemo did not have any facial features, if he did, his eyebrows would lift at Yuan's words.
"Are you going to do anything about Zaaran scheming in your world?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"I want to, but I also want to watch you fight him, so I will wait until you are done," he said.
"By saying that, you think I will lose to Zaaran?" Yuan frowned slightly.
"Don't tell me you actually think you can beat Zaaran?"
"To be frank, I have no idea how strong Zaaran even is." Yuan shook his head.
"What do you think? How strong is that bastard? Don't tell me that he's even stronger than you."
"Hahaha!" Deemo burst out laughing. "Stronger than me? He's nowhere near as strong as me!"
"What about Saaruk? Is he stronger than Saaruk?"
"I haven't fought Saaruk, but I think they're close."
"So he's pretty powerful..." Yuan mumbled.
"Anyway, I will be fighting him in seven days."
"Seven days? There's no way he'll arrive at this place in such a short time with his real body, so he'll probably come here as an avatar."
"Is that so?"
Yuan felt a little relieved upon learning this, as it meant that Zaaran likely won't be fighting at his full strength.
"Have you fought an Eternal before? Besides me, that is." Deemo suddenly asked.
"I have, but I have never fought one that didn't have their strength restricted by the Absolute Power."
"Then you'll be in for a surprise," Deemo chuckled.
"But I fought with you?"
Deemo shook his head.

"While that may have been a life-or-death battle for you, it doesn't even qualify as a fight—a spar for me. If anything, it was no different from playing with a child. I said this before, but if I really wanted to kill you, I could've done so with a single breath. You're underestimating Eternals a little too much, mortal."
"However, I can't blame you, given you've spent most of your life sheltered by the Absolute Power."
"Spent most of my life sheltered by the Absolute Power...?" Yuan repeated in a low voice.
As much as he wanted to rebuke such a claim, Yuan knew that it was the truth, so he had no choice but to silently accept it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2455 Deemo's Assistance
paragraphs: "Whether I can defeat Zaaran or not... we will find out in seven days," Yuan said after a moment of silence.

"Seven days? You will have at least seven years to prepare since time flows differently on this side of the universe, and as far as I am aware, Zaaran's territory is on the other side," Deemo suddenly said.
"Really? That's great news."
Yuan immediately turned to look at Selena and said, "Can you bring me to the other territory, where there is more Demon God's Ordeal?"
However, Selena remained silent, her gaze fixated on Deemo, almost as if she was afraid to speak in his presence.
"If you want that energy, I can make some for you," Deemo suddenly said.
But instead of thanking him, Yuan glared at him with a suspicious gaze.
"Why would you do that for me? I don't want to owe you another favor," Yuan swiftly said.
Deemo shook his head and explained, "Relax, I won't ask you for anything in return since I am doing this for my own curiosity."
He then wondered inwardly, 'A human that is fundamentally different from the ones in this world... what would happen if he ascended? Will he achieve what I have tried to create in the past?'
Although Yuan only became more suspicious of Deemo's interior motives, there was really no reason for him to refuse since he already planned on absorbing more Demon God's Ordeal.
"If you're really doing it for free, then I have no reason to refuse," Yuan nodded his head a moment later, accepting Deemo's assistance.
"Whenever you are ready."
Yuan took a deep breath before declaring in a resolute voice, "Ready."
In the next instant, Deemo raised his arm and pointed at Yuan, creating Demon God's Ordeal out of thin air and enveloping him within it.
Yuan automatically entered his demon form and started absorbing the energy like a black hole.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining Demon God's Ordeal!>
<Your Demonic Awakening has strengthened!>
'Watching it up close is definitely more entertaining,' Deemo thought to himself as he analyzed every change occurring within Yuan.
Selena watched in silence for several months before suddenly speaking aloud, "Demon God... I should have probably asked you this question before, but why did you turn everyone into monsters?"
The Demon God did not even react to her, much less respond, almost as if she was nonexistent in his eyes.
"Demon God! I need to know why! I deserve to know the truth!" Selena continued trying to seek answers. "I'm even willing to give you my life after learning the truth!"

At last, the Demon God replied, still keeping his gaze fixed on Yuan. "What use would I have for your life? You're one of the very few who have transcended humanity. You ought to value your life far more than that."

However, upon hearing those words, Selena instantly flew into a rage. "HOW DARE YOU EVEN UTTER SUCH WORDS! DON'T ACT LIKE YOU KNOW ABOUT THE VALUE OF OUR LIVES WHEN YOU'VE KILLED SO MANY OF US!" she roared, her voice blazing with fury.
At that moment, Selena was so consumed by rage that she could barely restrain herself from attacking Deemo.
Deemo spoke again, his voice as calm as a still pond, "I am merely speaking about the lives of you as a Transcendent. Those who failed to ascend are worthless and deserve to perish."
"Bullshit! If that were true, why did you kill more than half of us?! I know we attacked you first, but still—!" Selena clenched her fists so hard her bones shattered, blood gushing from her hands.
Deemo finally turned to look at her with his featureless face and said, "Who said I killed them?"
"What...?" Selena's eyes widened with disbelief, doubting her own ears.
"You're telling me that they're still alive? Even though I—and the others watched you vaporize them?"
However, Deemo did not respond and returned to focusing on Yuan, who was absorbing his Demon God's Ordeal with an increasingly faster pace.
'How is his body able to absorb so much energy? Are the humans from his world truly that different from the people in this world? Or is the energy simply not as effective on them?'
Ever since Yuan—Tian Chenyu—appeared in the Demonic Realm and fought him, Deemo's interest in the humans of the Nine Heavens had grown.

No, it would be more accurate to say that Tian Chenyu was the very reason Deemo began paying attention to the humans of the Nine Heavens at all. However, because of the Absolute Power, and the vast distance between them, Deemo had yet to actually act on that interest. Otherwise, he would have long since begun experimenting on them.
Suddenly, a thought flashed in Deemo's head.

'Even after my experiment succeeded and I have created beings that transcended humanity, I was not satisfied by the outcome and continued to create more energy in the pursuit of creating a perfect being...'

The Demon God's Ordeal that Deemo was supplying Yuan suddenly changed, becoming something entirely different. Not only was it more powerful than the original energy, but it was several times more chaotic.
"AAAAH!" Yuan began screaming in agony almost immediately, his voice sending chills down even Selena's spine.
"Master..." Lev swallowed nervously.
"Hahaha!" Deemo burst out laughing like a maniac. "Let's keep at this until either you succeed or die!"
"Deemo... you... bastard!"
Even as he was experiencing unimaginable pain, Yuan still somehow managed to curse at Deemo. <Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining ???>

Time continued to pass, and five years had gone by since Yuan began his ascension. Although that span passed in the blink of an eye for Deemo, it felt like an eternity for Yuan, as the pain did not diminish even after all those years.
After another year, Yuan's screams abruptly ceased, as if he had died. Seeing this, Deemo halted the flow of energy and examined Yuan with narrowed eyes.
"This bastard... he's survived it!" he exclaimed with excitement as Yuan's aura started to change.

sentences.text: "Whether I can defeat Zaaran or not... we will find out in seven days," Yuan said after a moment of silence.
"Seven days?
You will have at least seven years to prepare since time flows differently on this side of the universe, and as far as I am aware, Zaaran's territory is on the other side," Deemo suddenly said.
"Really?
That's great news."
Yuan immediately turned to look at Selena and said, "Can you bring me to the other territory, where there is more Demon God's Ordeal?"
However, Selena remained silent, her gaze fixated on Deemo, almost as if she was afraid to speak in his presence.
"If you want that energy, I can make some for you," Deemo suddenly said.
But instead of thanking him, Yuan glared at him with a suspicious gaze.
"Why would you do that for me?
I don't want to owe you another favor," Yuan swiftly said.
Deemo shook his head and explained, "Relax, I won't ask you for anything in return since I am doing this for my own curiosity."
He then wondered inwardly, 'A human that is fundamentally different from the ones in this world... what would happen if he ascended?
Will he achieve what I have tried to create in the past?'
Although Yuan only became more suspicious of Deemo's interior motives, there was really no reason for him to refuse since he already planned on absorbing more Demon God's Ordeal.
"If you're really doing it for free, then I have no reason to refuse," Yuan nodded his head a moment later, accepting Deemo's assistance.
"Whenever you are ready."
Yuan took a deep breath before declaring in a resolute voice, "Ready."
In the next instant, Deemo raised his arm and pointed at Yuan, creating Demon God's Ordeal out of thin air and enveloping him within it.
Yuan automatically entered his demon form and started absorbing the energy like a black hole.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining Demon God's Ordeal!>
<Your Demonic Awakening has strengthened!>
'Watching it up close is definitely more entertaining,' Deemo thought to himself as he analyzed every change occurring within Yuan.
Selena watched in silence for several months before suddenly speaking aloud, "Demon God...
I should have probably asked you this question before, but why did you turn everyone into monsters?"
The Demon God did not even react to her, much less respond, almost as if she was nonexistent in his eyes.
"Demon God!
I need to know why!
I deserve to know the truth!" Selena continued trying to seek answers.
"I'm even willing to give you my life after learning the truth!"
At last, the Demon God replied, still keeping his gaze fixed on Yuan.
"What use would I have for your life?
You're one of the very few who have transcended humanity.
You ought to value your life far more than that."
However, upon hearing those words, Selena instantly flew into a rage.
"HOW DARE YOU EVEN UTTER SUCH WORDS!
DON'T ACT LIKE YOU KNOW ABOUT THE VALUE OF OUR LIVES WHEN YOU'VE KILLED SO MANY OF US!" she roared, her voice blazing with fury.
At that moment, Selena was so consumed by rage that she could barely restrain herself from attacking Deemo.
Deemo spoke again, his voice as calm as a still pond, "I am merely speaking about the lives of you as a Transcendent.
Those who failed to ascend are worthless and deserve to perish."
"Bullshit!
If that were true, why did you kill more than half of us?!
I know we attacked you first, but still—!" Selena clenched her fists so hard her bones shattered, blood gushing from her hands.
Deemo finally turned to look at her with his featureless face and said, "Who said I killed them?"
"What...?" Selena's eyes widened with disbelief, doubting her own ears.
"You're telling me that they're still alive?
Even though I—and the others watched you vaporize them?"
However, Deemo did not respond and returned to focusing on Yuan, who was absorbing his Demon God's Ordeal with an increasingly faster pace.
'How is his body able to absorb so much energy?
Are the humans from his world truly that different from the people in this world?
Or is the energy simply not as effective on them?'
Ever since Yuan—Tian Chenyu—appeared in the Demonic Realm and fought him, Deemo's interest in the humans of the Nine Heavens had grown.
No, it would be more accurate to say that Tian Chenyu was the very reason Deemo began paying attention to the humans of the Nine Heavens at all.
However, because of the Absolute Power, and the vast distance between them, Deemo had yet to actually act on that interest.
Otherwise, he would have long since begun experimenting on them.
Suddenly, a thought flashed in Deemo's head.

'Even after my experiment succeeded and I have created beings that transcended humanity, I was not satisfied by the outcome and continued to create more energy in the pursuit of creating a perfect being...'
The Demon God's Ordeal that Deemo was supplying Yuan suddenly changed, becoming something entirely different.
Not only was it more powerful than the original energy, but it was several times more chaotic.
"AAAAH!" Yuan began screaming in agony almost immediately, his voice sending chills down even Selena's spine.
"Master..." Lev swallowed nervously.
"Hahaha!" Deemo burst out laughing like a maniac.
"Let's keep at this until either you succeed or die!"
"Deemo... you... bastard!"
Even as he was experiencing unimaginable pain, Yuan still somehow managed to curse at Deemo.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining ???>
Time continued to pass, and five years had gone by since Yuan began his ascension.
Although that span passed in the blink of an eye for Deemo, it felt like an eternity for Yuan, as the pain did not diminish even after all those years.
After another year, Yuan's screams abruptly ceased, as if he had died.
Seeing this, Deemo halted the flow of energy and examined Yuan with narrowed eyes.
"This bastard... he's survived it!" he exclaimed with excitement as Yuan's aura started to change.

chapters.title: Chapter 2456 Zaaran's Arrival
paragraphs: Although Yuan's entire presence had vanished—just like his screams—his aura returned moments later. It was faint at first, but it was clearly evolving, transforming into something otherworldly.
"He's... ascending?" Selena muttered in a dazed voice after realizing this.
Unlike Supreme Ruler Dena, who had wrapped herself in a cocoon, a thin veil of semi-transparent golden aura now covered Yuan's entire body like a shimmering blanket.

"Show me... what kind of being you'll become after this. Will you ascend... or will you perish at the final step?" Deemo muttered, staring at Yuan with unrestrained excitement, his body trembling nonstop like that of an eager child.

Deemo wanted to witness Yuan's ascension from beginning to end, but unfortunately, he had no choice but to divert his attention. Mere days after Yuan began his ascension, Deemo sensed a familiar presence approaching his world. It was none other than Zaaran, who had finally arrived to fight Yuan.
"Haaa..." Deemo let out an irritated sigh before his faceless figure vanished into thin air.
After leaving the Demonic Realm and Yuan's side, Deemo confronted Zaaran, blocking his advances.
"D-Deemo!" Zaaran instantly halted before him.

"Uh... this is..." Zaaran, who had spent his entire journey to the Demonic Realm consumed by rage and fantaising how he would torture Yuan, froze in confusion, as he forgot to think of an excuse to give Deemo for his sudden appearance. Although nearly seven years had passed in the Demonic Realm, only seven days had gone by for him.
"I am here to..."
"Save your breath, Zaaran. I know what you're doing here," Deemo interrupted him with a cold sneer.
"You do?!" Zaaran exclaimed in shock.
He thought he had managed to escape Deemo's surveillance while he schemed within the Demonic Realm, after all.

"I knew you were ambitious, but to scheme in my own territory... Do you have a death wish?" Deemo's voice was solemn, heavy with the urge to strangle Zaaran's neck. "I... have no idea what you're talking about!" Zaaran chose to play dumb. "Oh? You don't? So you're saying you didn't try to fool one of my own people into stealing blood from my creations by pretending to be me?"
"That's absurd! What proof do you have?! Even as a Prime Eternal, you can't just hurl baseless accusations! Are you trying to start a war?!" Zaaran shouted.
"The one you traveled all this way to fight told me himself, so there's no point in playing dumb, Zaaran," Deemo said with a shake of his head.
"What?! Don't tell me you're working together?!"
"Working together? To achieve what? If I wanted to kill you for taking a shit in my territory, I could easily achieve that by myself!" Deemo declared, his voice booming with arrogance.
"Then why are you blocking me? It was that bastard who challenged me to a fight first."
"He's not ready to fight you right now—or more specifically, he's not in the condition to."
"What are you talking about?"

"I'm saying that I will not interfere in your fight with him. However, you must wait until he is ready. That is your punishment for scheming in my world and trying to steal my hard work," Deemo elaborated.

Zaaran fell silent. He wasn't exactly afraid of Deemo, but he was definitely nervous in his presence. And since he'd already offended Deemo, it would be wise not to anger him further. Although there was a chance that Yuan might not survive his ascension and fight Zaaran, Deemo did not reveal such information to him.
"How long will this take?" Zaaran eventually asked.
"Who knows?" Deemo shrugged.
"You...!" Zaaran wanted to complain but decided against it.
After several weeks of silence, Zaaran couldn't endure his curiosity any longer and asked, "Why are you helping that bastard, anyway? What is your relationship with him?"
"You're misunderstanding the situation. I am not helping him," Deemo said.
"What?"
"He is currently undergoing an experiment of mine, so I cannot allow you to disturb him," Deemo admitted.
"He willingly agreed to be your experiment...?"
"Something like that."
Zaaran didn't respond, but he definitely doubted Deemo's claim.

"How are your experiments progressing?" Deemo suddenly asked, changing the subject. "Will you have anything worthwhile to show at the upcoming event, or are you going to squander the opportunity like last time?"
"That's—"

"Oh, you don't actually have to answer me. After all, if your experiments were going smoothly, you wouldn't resort to trying to steal my work." Deemo interrupted Zaaran before he could even say anything.
"You..." Zaaran trembled in anger, but he unfortunately did not have any comebacks.
After a brief silence, Zaaran forced himself to calm down before asking in a tense, curious tone, "Don't tell me... you're planning to use him as your subject in the event?"

"Hm?" Deemo let out a surprised noise, as if he just realized something. "That's actually not a bad idea. If it's him, he'll definitely make things entertaining. He has all the qualifications to participate, too."
Zaaran's jaw dropped at Deemo's words, and he even felt like kicking himself for having given him the idea.
However, Deemo shook his head a moment later and said, "Unfortunately, since he came from 'that' place and technically not mine, I won't be able to use him."
'No, he's definitely usable...' Zaaran thought to himself. 'After all, how would the others know his origin if I don't mention it? And if I make him my slave, he'll become my property!'
"I wouldn't do that if I were you," Deemo suddenly commented, almost as if he could read Zaaran's thoughts.
"Why would you say—"
In the middle of Zaaran's question, Deemo suddenly shifted his attention back to Yuan.
"He's almost done!"
Without another word, Deemo left Zaaran and returned to Yuan's side to witness his ascension up close.
Zaaran stayed in the starry sky, not daring to enter Deemo's territory without permission. But since he could see everything from his location, it made no difference.
Meanwhile, Yuan slowly opened his eyes. <Your Demonic Awakening has successfully evolved!>

chapters.title: Chapter 2457 Path to Eternity
paragraphs: When Deemo altered the energy flowing into Yuan, his consciousness flickered, and he blacked out for a brief moment before slipping into a half-conscious state, akin to being caught between sleep and wakefulness.
Although Yuan screamed in agony, he wasn't even aware of it, and his cries were nothing more than a raw, instinctive response to the overwhelming pain.
'Where am I...?' Yuan wondered to himself as it felt like his soul was aimlessly drifting in space, similar to when he was in the phenomenon during his ascension to the God Ascension realm.
However, unlike back then, he couldn't control where he was going.

'Damn... what the hell did that bastard do to me? Did I die?" Yuan started to wonder if he had died and his soul was traversing through the river of reincarnation, where those who died with their souls intact must go to begin their cycle of reincarnation.
Unfortunately, even if he really died, there was nothing he could do but wait for his reincarnation.

After drifting for what felt like millions of years, Yuan suddenly sensed a presence in the distant void. Though it had only just entered his awareness, its power was unfathomable—growing ever more overwhelming the closer he drifted toward it.
However, the moment he reached a certain distance, Yuan was abruptly halted, as if he had run headfirst into an invisible wall.

There was an invisible barrier before him, one that was similar to the ones he had to break through during his ascension. Yet, it felt fundamentally different and not something he could forcefully bypass.
<You have discovered the Path to Eternity>
A familiar sound suddenly resounded inside Yuan's head.
'Path to Eternity...? As in the path of becoming an Eternal?' Yuan wondered to himself.
After receiving the notification, Yuan's consciousness began to sharpen, and he could suddenly sense the presence beyond the barrier with far greater clarity.
'This presence! It's the same as the one beyond the 1,000th layer during my ascension to the God Ascension Realm!' Yuan quickly recognized this presence.
Suddenly, Yuan felt his consciousness being dragged back to his body.
<Your Demonic Awakening has evolved, becoming Transcended Demon Awakening>
<You have begun walking the Path to Eternity>
<Progress: 10%>
Yuan opened his eyes, a vicious, ruthless light flickering within them, giving him an aura of infinite malice.

He glanced down at himself, and the first thing he noticed was that the crystal that was embedded in his chest had vanished. Yet he could still feel its energy coursing through him, as though its power had been released and merged entirely into his body.

His skin grew paler, resembling Selena and the others. His hair returned to black, but it became so dark it seemed to devour any light that touched it. As for his eyes, he had to use his divine sense to see them, and they had turned almost entirely black, with golden pupils.

'I look even more demonic than before... No, I look exactly like Selena and the others. Does this mean I have turned into a Transcedent? I don't feel much different, though,' he thought to himself, not feeling any different than before.
Then he lifted his head to look at Deemo, who was hovering a few meters away from him. Despite Deemo's featureless face, Yuan could somehow tell that he was smiling at this moment.
"Looks like you have succeeded in your ascension," Deemo remarked.

"However..." Deemo continued after a brief moment of silence, "Something feels different. You look like a Transcendent, but you do not have any of their powers. In fact, besides your appearance, I cannot tell if anything has changed."
Yuan narrowed his eyes at Deemo and said, "Maybe it has something to do with you changing the energy. What the hell was that, anyway?"
"It's fundamentally similar to the original energy but would theoretically create something even stronger—more perfect than Transcendents."
"I thought Transcendents are already perfect beings!" Selena suddenly said.
"While you are above humans, I would not call you perfect beings. In fact, you are quite far from it."
"Then what the hell are we?!"
"A being beyond humanity, yet not a god—an existence that exists between the two," Deemo said calmly. "You are also a successful experiment, but not necessarily an ideal one."
"That doesn't make any sense!" Selena shouted angrily.
"I'm not surprised. This is beyond your understading, after all." Deemo shook his head before turning to look at Yuan again.
"Anyway, we can figure this out later... once you survive your fight against Zaaran—if you can."
Yuan's body trembled after being reminded of his fight with Zaaran.
"Is he here?"
Deemo nodded.
"I will take you to him now."
Without any warning, Deemo teleported Yuan into the starry sky to where Zaaran was waiting.
"Tian Yang!" Zaaran unleashed a deafening roar after seeing Yuan and snapping out of his daze.

"Zaaran... I was expecting you to come here with your real body, not your avatar. I hope it's not because you are underestimating me," Yuan narrowed his eyes at Zaaran, who took the form of an avatar.

"Don't give yourself too much credit, you bastard. It would take too long and too much effort for me to come here in my real body, so I came here in my avatar. Although I won't be able to use my full strength in this form, it will be more than enough to deal with an insignificant ant like you!" Zaaran explained.
Yuan silently analyzed Zaaran to the best of his abilities. From what he could tell, Zaaran's avatar was definitely stronger than Saaruk when he fought him. However, he couldn't tell by how much.
Meanwhile, Zaaran was also examining Yuan. Although it did not show on his face, Zaaran was shook to the core by what he saw.
'This bastard! It hasn't even been that long since we last fought, and he's grown this much?!'

It had been at least several hundred million years since Tian Yang fought Zaaran, who had taken full control of Kulas' body. While that span was enough for many eras to rise and fall and for the cultivation world to advance tremendously, it was little more than a fleeting moment to an Eternal, who had existed for billions—if not trillions—of years.

When Tian Yang fought Zaaran back then, he'd just entered the recently discovered God Ascension Realm, and while Yuan was at a similar cultivation right now, his actual prowess was countless times stronger, so much so that he could easily kill a thousand Tian Yangs in the blink of an eye.
Not only that, but Yuan's aura was entirely different.
'It's not the same, but he has a scent that is similar to us Eternals! How is that possible?!' Zaaran cried inwardly as he continued to discover new things about Yuan through his examination.
'Don't tell me he's acquired an Eternal's body—or is in the process of completing one?!'
"So... when are you two going to fight?" Deemo suddenly spoke aloud, interrupting their thoughts.
"What's the rush?" Zaaran coldly sneered. "It won't take even a minute for me to kill him."
Yuan pretended to clean his ear with his pinky as he responded to Zaaran's provocation, "You talk too arrogantly for someone who'd already lost to me once."
"That doesn't count!" Zaaran shouted. "I was not only in someone's body, but I couldn't even use a single percent of my prowess back then!"
Yuan shrugged, "A loss is a lost, regardless of the circumstances. Once you lose to me again in this fight, you won't be able to make any more excuses."
"And once you lose, I will turn you into my slave and force you to fight for me for the rest of your pathetic life!" Zaaran bellowed as his aura surged with an overwhelming amount of Eternal Essence.

"We'll see about that!" Yuan laughed as he made the first move, striking at Zaaran with Eternal Essence and nearly eighty percent of his full strength from the very start. He knew he couldn't afford to hold back against an Eternal, especially not without Absolute Power's protection.

"This is—!" Zaaran's eyes widened in shock and disbelief. He'd known Yuan could wield Eternal Essence from the very beginning, but he hadn't imagined he was capable of commanding so much of it. In fact, he'd initially planned to meet Yuan's strike head-on, yet abandoned the idea at the very last second and dodged instead.
It wasn't just Zaaran who was stunned by Yuan's Eternal Essence either, as even Deemo visibly flinched when Yuan revealed it.
'He's wielding about a trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, but his soul is nowhere near that old!' Deemo cried inwardly.

Unlike humans, who measured cultivation in levels and realms, Eternals measured their strength in terms of time—how long they'd cultivated Eternal Essence. In most cases, the older an Eternal was, the stronger they were, simply because they'd had more time to cultivate. Moreover, unlike humans, most Eternals were born equal in talent and thus advanced at roughly the same pace.

It would take too long and too much effort for me to come here in my real body, so I came here in my avatar.
Although I won't be able to use my full strength in this form, it will be more than enough to deal with an insignificant ant like you!" Zaaran explained.
Yuan silently analyzed Zaaran to the best of his abilities.
From what he could tell, Zaaran's avatar was definitely stronger than Saaruk when he fought him.
However, he couldn't tell by how much.
Meanwhile, Zaaran was also examining Yuan.
Although it did not show on his face, Zaaran was shook to the core by what he saw.
'This bastard!
It hasn't even been that long since we last fought, and he's grown this much?!'
It had been at least several hundred million years since Tian Yang fought Zaaran, who had taken full control of Kulas' body.

While that span was enough for many eras to rise and fall and for the cultivation world to advance tremendously, it was little more than a fleeting moment to an Eternal, who had existed for billions—if not trillions—of years.

When Tian Yang fought Zaaran back then, he'd just entered the recently discovered God Ascension Realm, and while Yuan was at a similar cultivation right now, his actual prowess was countless times stronger, so much so that he could easily kill a thousand Tian Yangs in the blink of an eye.
Not only that, but Yuan's aura was entirely different.
'It's not the same, but he has a scent that is similar to us Eternals!
How is that possible?!' Zaaran cried inwardly as he continued to discover new things about Yuan through his examination.
'Don't tell me he's acquired an Eternal's body—or is in the process of completing one?!'
"So... when are you two going to fight?" Deemo suddenly spoke aloud, interrupting their thoughts.
"What's the rush?" Zaaran coldly sneered.
"It won't take even a minute for me to kill him."
Yuan pretended to clean his ear with his pinky as he responded to Zaaran's provocation, "You talk too arrogantly for someone who'd already lost to me once."
"That doesn't count!" Zaaran shouted.
"I was not only in someone's body, but I couldn't even use a single percent of my prowess back then!"
Yuan shrugged, "A loss is a lost, regardless of the circumstances.
Once you lose to me again in this fight, you won't be able to make any more excuses."
"And once you lose, I will turn you into my slave and force you to fight for me for the rest of your pathetic life!" Zaaran bellowed as his aura surged with an overwhelming amount of Eternal Essence.
"We'll see about that!" Yuan laughed as he made the first move, striking at Zaaran with Eternal Essence and nearly eighty percent of his full strength from the very start.
He knew he couldn't afford to hold back against an Eternal, especially not without Absolute Power's protection.
"This is—!" Zaaran's eyes widened in shock and disbelief.
He'd known Yuan could wield Eternal Essence from the very beginning, but he hadn't imagined he was capable of commanding so much of it.
In fact, he'd initially planned to meet Yuan's strike head-on, yet abandoned the idea at the very last second and dodged instead.
It wasn't just Zaaran who was stunned by Yuan's Eternal Essence either, as even Deemo visibly flinched when Yuan revealed it.
'He's wielding about a trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, but his soul is nowhere near that old!' Deemo cried inwardly.
Unlike humans, who measured cultivation in levels and realms, Eternals measured their strength in terms of time—how long they'd cultivated Eternal Essence.
In most cases, the older an Eternal was, the stronger they were, simply because they'd had more time to cultivate.
Moreover, unlike humans, most Eternals were born equal in talent and thus advanced at roughly the same pace.

chapters.title: Chapter 2458 Fighting Zaaran
paragraphs: "Bastard, how did you acquire so much Eternal Essence as a mere mortal?!" Zaaran questioned Yuan after hastily avoiding his attack.
Although the attack wasn't powerful enough to destroy his avatar, it would have undoubtedly damaged it had he attempted to block it.
"Does it really matter how I acquired it?" Yuan calmly responded.

"A trillion years worth of Eternal Essence isn't a massive amount, but it's not insignificant, either! There's no way a human can acquire so much without the help of another Eternal! Who is the one helping a bastard like you?!" Zaaran shouted.
"Your mom," Yuan replied with a serious look on his face.
"My... what?"
Yuan's unexpected answer left Zaaran stunned speechless.
Since Eternals were born from the void, the very concept of "parents" didn't apply to them, so Yuan's remark would have gone over the heads of most of their kind.
However, Zaaran—familiar with humans and their customs—recognized the insult almost immediately. His body trembled with fury, and his aura erupted like a volcano.
"You little bastard! How dare you insult me as if I am a mortal!"
An immense amount of Eternal Essence that surpassed Yuan's trillion year's worth gushed from Zaaran's avatar.
"About a trillion and a hundred billion years, huh?" Deemo muttered to himself.

Once an Eternal's accumulation of Eternal Essence surpassed a certain threshold—typically around a trillion years—differences of a few thousand, or even a few million years, became negligible. Although Eternal Essence was immensely powerful, allowing Yuan to overwhelm higher-level opponents with even a small amount, it was only possible against mortals and beasts, and the same did not hold true when facing Eternals.

After unleashing his Eternal Essence, Zaaran made his move, releasing a devastating wave of energy that surged toward Yuan like a tidal wave... one that was massive enough to easily consume an entire world or two.
Yuan confronted Zaaran's attack with an attack of similar fashion, releasing more Eternal Essence than before since he hadn't gone all out yet.
"He was still hiding more Eternal Essence?!" Zaaran exclaimed in shock when Yuan's attack completely cancelled out his own.
Of course, Zaaran wasn't worried that he might lose since he was also holding back plenty of Eternal Essence, as he did not want to kill Yuan by accident.
Meanwhile, Deemo felt a shiver in his real body when he watched a human who wasn't even a True God clash against an Eternal without losing.
'This is it! This is what a perfect being should be capable of!' He trembled with excitement after seeing what he envisioned to be the perfect being existing befoe his very eyes.
To Deemo, a perfect being was someone that surpassed common sense—someone who could achieve the impossible.
Although the Transcendents he created were immensely powerful in their own right, none of them could wield Eternal Essence and fight Eternals like Yuan, who was still very far from being a True God.
"There's still so much room for improvements!" Deemo suddenly shouted loudly.
'What would happen once he reaches True God? What about Absolute God? What if someone who could wield Eternal Essence without being an Eternal becomes one? Oh, the possibilities!'
Deemo, who had spent a lot of effort and time trying to create perfect beings, could barely restraint himself from experimenting on Yuan at this moment.
In fact, Deemo saw potential in Yuan—in Tian Chenyu long ago, hence why he didn't kill Tian Chenyu or destroy his soul, as he was capable of doing both with ease.
However, it wasn't just Deemo who was excited about Yuan. Even his opponent, Zaaran, could hardly contain his excitement.
In his eyes, Yuan was guaranteed to lose to him and become his subject, and the thought of having such an extraordinary slave sent chills throughout his entire being.
'Once I make him into my slave and have him participate in the upcoming event, I will no longer be a laughing stock! The only issue here is...'
Zaaran glanced at Deemo with the corner of his eyes.
'Will Deemo allow me to take him, or will he try to snatch that brat away from me?'
Zaaran was aware that he had no way of defeating Deemo, even if he was currently there with his real body, so if Deemo stole Yuan away from him, there was nothing he could really do but cry about it.
'Not only am I unable to defeat him, but we are currently in his territory, so he technically owns Tian Yang...'
Among Eternals, there existed a widely accepted rule that everything within one's territory belonged to its owner. The only exception was the Nine Heavens, a space that could not be claimed.

Although anyone could declare ownership over it, with the Absolute Power residing there, such claims held no weight and would only be laughed at. In practice, it was a lawless domain—a free-for-all until someone seized the Absolute Power.
As he clashed with Yuan, Zaaran pondered excuses and justifications he could use to stop Deemo from taking Yuan away, should it come to that.
"You're slowing down, Zaaran! Something on your mind?!" Yuan suddenly shouted, halting Zaaran's thoughts.

"Yes! I am thinking about how boring this is!" Zaaran laughed in a mocking fashion before continuing, "We both know that you won't be able to defeat me, so why don't you stop wasting my time and submit to me already? I will make your life a little less miserable if you willingly submit!"
"Are you still dreaming right now?" Yuan sneered coldly. "Why don't I wake you up a little then?!"
Yuan suddenly pointed at Zaaran and unleashed another wave of Eternal Essence, but this time, it was different.
The energy carried a bone-chilling cold, so absolute that everything in its path froze solid—even the very fabric of space itself seemed to halt and crystallize under its touch.
"This power is?!" Zaaran's eyes widened with shock and disbelief as Shiva's Eternal Frost created an icy path toward his direction.
Had he been paying attention, he might have avoided it, but not only was he distracted, Yuan's sudden use of a technique belonging to another Eternal caught him completely off guard.
In the end, Zaaran was unable to avoid all of the attack and was struck in the arm.
"Arg!" Zaaran released a painful cry.
"Oh?" Yuan raised an eyebrow after seeing Zaaran's reaction.
He knew that Zaaran's curse that had affected Kulas was weak to Yin elements, but he didn't know the being himself was also weak to it.
"You! That power!" Zaaran roared, his voice trembling in anger and disgust.
"That is Shiva's power! Why the hell can you wield her power?!?!" "Why do you care? Don't tell me she's your lover or something?" Yuan mocked.
"Bastard!!!" Zaaran's aura exploded as he unleashed his full strength, his Eternal Essence almost two trillion years, nearly double that of Yuan's Eternal Essence.
'Shit!' Zaaran immediately regretted attacking with his full strength out of anger because he didn't believe Yuan would be able to survive it.
When Deemo saw this, he instinctively moved in to protect Yuan. After all, it would be far too wasteful to let him die there.
However, Deemo halted himself almost instantly after he started moving when he noticed the calm look on Yuan's face.
