chapters.title: Chapter 2459 Spirit Tree’s Awakening
paragraphs: Moments before Zaaran unleashed his deadly attack, a notification appeared before Yuan.
<Spirit Tree has awakened>
<Spirit Tree has completed its evolution>
<Spirit Tree has evolved into Tree of Eternity>
'Tree of Eternity?' Yuan raised an eyebrow at the unfamiliar name.
The Spirit Tree was originally acquired by Tian Yi, but it was not something he found. Rather, it was given to him by one of the Nine Divine Supremes.
When it was given to him, the Divine Supreme explained to him its name and purpose. Yet, it was not the Tree of Eternity, but the Tree of Beginning.
According to the Divine Supreme, the Tree of Beginning was not only the first living organism in existence, but also the origin of spiritual energy.

The Tree of Beginning was meant to grant Yuan an inexhaustible supply of spiritual energy once fully matured. Moreover, it served as a crucial component for forging an entirely new physique—one that had never been discovered by the humans of the Nine Heavens.
Tian Yi had prepared the Tree of Beginning for his future reincarnation, and as far as Yuan understood, if things were no longer unfolding as intended... then it meant his fate itself had shifted.
'My fate has changed, and I can no longer rely on what my previous incarnations had prepared for me. Yet, I don't feel nervous for some reason...' Yuan thought to himself.
The next moment, Yuan taunted Zaaran, causing him to unleash a devastating attack that was nearly double Yuan's full prowess.
Even though there was a good chance this attack could kill him, Yuan felt oddly calm, almost as if he could instinctively tell that he would survive it.
<Tree of Eternity senses a tremendous amount of Eternal Essence>
<Tree of Eternity spreads its roots throughout your body>
The next moment, two trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence clashed against Yuan's body.
Knowing that he couldn't block or avoid the attack, Yuan didn't even bother attempting anything.
<Your Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has temporarily evolved, turning into Eternity Constitution>
<Eternity Constitution has activated, absorbing the Eternal Essence>
Before Zaaran's Eternal Essence could even touch Yuan, it was already being absorbed.
"That is?!" Deemo's real body trembled upon witnessing the scene of Yuan absorbing Zaaran's Eternal Essence.
<Eternity Constitution has absorbed two trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence>
<The absorbed Eternal Essence has been stored inside the Tree of Eternity>
<The Tree of Eternity has begun refining its Eternal Essence>
In the blink of an eye, Zaaran's attack was swallowed by Yuan.
The Eternal Essence disappeared so fast that it seemed as if it vanished into nothingness.

Normally, when Yuan absorbed energy, it was a gradual process, like slowly filling an empty tank with water. But this time, it was as if the entire contents had been dumped in at once, filling it instantly.
"What the fuck?! Where did my Eternal Essence go?!" Zaaran exclaimed in shock and disbelief, looking like he'd just witnessed a ghost.
He thought it might have been absorbed, but when he examined Yuan, he could not sense two trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence within him.
"What is going on?!" Zaaran turned to look at Deemo, wondering if he had anything to do with it.
However, Deemo shook his head and spoke in an adamant voice, "I had nothing to do with it, so you can stop looking at me."
"Then what the hell happened?! There's no way my attack vanished into thin air!" Zaaran shouted angrily, feeling utterly confused.
While Zaaran was confused, Yuan unleashed his attack.
However, he didn't just attack with his trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence.
<Tree of Eternity has activated>
<You have tapped into the Tree of Eternity's storage>
<You have consumed two trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence>
<Shiva's Eternal Frost!>
"Where the hell is this power coming from?! Don't tell me you used my power—ARGH!"
Zaaran cried out loud in pain as three trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence crashed into his avatar.
"It hurts! It burns!! Aaaahhh!!!"
The attack was so powerful that it scattered Zaaran's avatar moments later.
"I... lost...?" Zaaran's voice that was full of disbelief echoed in the void.
"This cannot be happening..."
He never imagined that he would lose to Yuan, much less be defeated in such a fashion.
"This is... impossible..." Zaaran's voice dwindled to a faint whisper, growing weaker with each passing moment—until it vanished entirely, along with his very presence.
Silence lingered in the void long after Zaaran's defeat.
Yuan remained still, quietly trying to comprehend the nature of his newfound power while Deemo observed him in silence.
Eventually, Deemo's voice resounded, "Congratulations on defeating Zaaran."
Yuan turned to face him and said, "There's nothing to celebrate. I merely defeated his avatar. I doubt that was even half of his true prowess."

"So what? It doesn't change the fact that you, a mere mortal, have defeated an Eternal. That is not something anyone can achieve. In fact, this may be the first time since the beginning of time that a human has defeated an Eternal."
Yuan narrowed his eyes and revealed, "This is not my first time fighting and defeating an Eternal. In fact, I put several of them to sleep before."
"That is entirely impossible," Deemo shook his head, speaking in a firm tone.
"So you are calling me a liar?" Yuan frowned.

"No, I am saying that you have misunderstood the situation. Even with that attack you used to defeat Zaaran, it would be impossible to defeat an Eternal in their real body. In fact, you'd need at least ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence to even injure the weakest Eternal out there."
"What? But I know I put those Eternals to sleep!" Yuan exclaimed.
"You can believe what you want, but I have no reason to deceive you."
After a brief pause, Deemo continued, "As for Zaaran... that avatar was only about ten percent of his true capability."

"What?! There's no way!" Yuan cried out in disbelief before explaining his reasoning. "I fought with Saaruk's avatar before, and he claimed to be using twenty percent of his true prowess, and he was much weaker than Zaaran just now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2460 Human Clones
paragraphs: "Did you just say Saaruk?" Deemo muttered in a somewhat surprised voice.
Then, he burst out laughing, "Saaruk is a compulsive liar. Everything he says has to be taken with a grain of salt."
Yuan raised his eyebrows at this new information and asked, "Isn't he a powerful Eternal? Even Shiva said Saaruk was one of the more powerful Eternals."

"Shiva... I haven't heard that name in a long time," Deemo murmured, a hint of nostalgia in his tone. "Anyway, Shiva's information is probably outdated, as she was sealed away ages ago. Saaruk was indeed quite strong once, but he's grown lazy and has long since been surpassed by many others."
"Is that so..." Yuan fell silent, unsure what to think about this information.
"You..." Deemo suddenly started talking, but abruptly halted, as if he was hesitant on something.
Eventually, he continued, "How would you like to become my subject—"
"I refuse." Yuan rejected Deemo before he could even finish his sentence.

"Let me finish," Deemo said in an annoyed tone. "If you become my subject and allow me to experiment on you, I will help you complete your Eternal Constitution, and I am even willing to be your backing, so no Eternal will dare to mess with you."
"I refuse," Yuan rejected again without an ounce of hesitation in his voice.
"I want to hear your reasoning," Deemo demanded.
"It's quite simple, really. I don't want to serve anyone, especially not someone who experimented on an entire world, treating human lives as nothing more than sacrificial lambs."
Even though Yuan knew that his refusal could offend Deemo and potentially get himself killed, his voice was as calm as a still pond and without an ounce of fear.
Deemo fell silent to ponder again, as he was reluctant to give up on someone as valuable as Yuan.
"No matter what you offer me, I will not become your experiment," Yuan realized what Deemo was trying to do and said aloud.
"Fine, I won't experiment on you, nor am I asking you to become my subject for real. Instead, I want you to become my subject in name and participate in a certain event for me," Deemo said.
"What?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, looking bewildered.
"In return, I will owe you a favor," Deemo continued.

We Eternals, with nothing to do but cultivate and bored out of our minds, decided to create something to ease that boredom," Deemo began. "That was when we chose to create our own worlds and humans, nurturing them just to see what would happen. As time passed, more and more Eternals joined the game, each crafting their own world. Eventually, it turned competitive, everyone claiming their world and their humans were superior to the rest."
"To prove their humans were superior, the Eternals made them fight, and thus began what we call the Eternals' Reckoning—"
"Wait, wait, wait!" Yuan suddenly shouted with a bewildered look on his face.
"What do you mean Eternals created humans and are making them fight each other?!"
"Does this mean there are other worlds out there with humans besides the Nine Heavens and the Demonic Realm?!"
"Well..." Deemo paused briefly before continuing, "there used to be. However, over time, as the Eternals experimented on humans in pursuit of something stronger... humanity gradually went extinct."
"That doesn't make any sense. If Eternals created humans in the first place, can't they just make more?"
"I guess it would be more accurate to say that we had cloned them instead of creating them."
"What in heaven's name...?" Yuan's face became even more confused.
"Although Eternals are powerful, we are not omnipotent, and creating humans is beyond our capabilities. The best we were able to do was clone the humans that already existed."
"Why can't you just clone them again? Did something happen to them?" Yuan then asked.
Deemo nodded.
"They were a miracle created by the universe, existing long before even my world. Unfortunately, they were all wiped out in a certain incident."
"Why don't you just clone the human clones?" "You think we haven't tried that? It's simply impossible, as they would always come out inhuman. In fact, you have seen them before.

"Don't tell me... magical beasts?!" He cried out loud.

"That... I am unsure."

"The Divine Heaven's origin is not known... or more precisely, nobody but one being knows."
"The Absolute Being." Yuan muttered.

"Correct, as it was the Absolute Being's property, and nobody is foolish enough to stick their nose into his business. However, if we think logically, it is unlikely that any 'true' humans are left in this universe, including the ones from your world. As I said, they were all killed, and not even the Absolute Being can create humans out of thin air."
"This is... a lot for me to digest." Yuan muttered before closing his eyes and taking several deep breaths.

"Anyway, that is the reason I experimented on my humans and treated them as if they were worthless," Deemo continued. "Because they are not authentic humans, merely fakes we created for our entertainment."
"That doesn't make it okay," Yuan quickly replied. "It doesn't change the fact that they have a soul and are conscious. Even if they are clones, they have emotions, can feel and think."
"..." Deemo fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 2461 Ending The Transcendents' Punishment
paragraphs: "Haaa..." Yuan let out a long sigh, then muttered in a low voice. "The more I learn about you Eternals, the more I despise your kind. Whether it's treating humans as tools or using us for your own amusement... I hate all of it."

"Don't talk as if we're the only ones who do such things," Deemo said, shaking his head. "I've watched humans for longer than you've been alive. They also treat their own kind like tools, kill each other over trivial matters, even enslave one another. In what way are you any better than us Eternals? It's nothing but hypocrisy."
"Not only are you humans not any better than us, but I'd even argue that you're worse than us in many ways," Deemo sighed. "I bet you've killed plenty of humans yourself."
"That's..." Yuan opened his mouth but could not think of any comebacks.
Sure enough, Yuan had taken many lives—both in his past and current life. Whether they deserved it or not was another matter entirely; it didn't change the simple fact that he had killed.

"Or what? Are you saying that only humans can kill humans? In that case, then what about magical beasts being hunted by humans? What about the animals enslaved by humans? Humans also play god when they have the chance. At the end of the day, our kind doesn't matter. The strong make the rules, and the weak obey. That is all that truly matters." Yuan closed his eyes and sighed.

"There's no point in arguing philosophy. What truly matters to me is what is right and what is wrong. Humans... Magical beasts... Eternals... Regardless of their identity, the wrong should be punished."
"What is right and what is wrong...? The strong are always right, and the weak are wrong. That is the rule of this world—this universe!" Deemo declared.
After a moment of silence, Deemo spoke again, "Let's cease this debate that will go nowhere. Let me hear your answer. Will you become my subject and fight for me?"

Yuan sneered. "How does fighting for you benefit me at all? A mere favor from you hardly seems worth it." "Of course it will benefit you. The winner of the event will receive an enormous amount of Eternal Essence—at least ten trillion years' worth. If we win, I'll give that Eternal Essence to you, which will surely help you fight against Eternals."

Yuan raised an eyebrow. "What's the point of you participating if you're just going to hand over all the rewards to me? And who's providing the Eternal Essence, anyway? It's not some treasure you can just toss around."

"Reputation and bragging rights," Deemo replied calmly. "As for the Eternal Essence, it comes from all participating Eternals. Each one must pay a trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence just to enter."
"When is it going to start?" Yuan asked after a moment of silence. "I swear, if you say something stupid like a billion years—"
"It will start in a hundred years—ninty nine years and three hundred days to be exact."
"I will think about it," Yuan then said.
"If you're thinking about finding another Eternal to fight for, don't bother. You'll only be wasting your time," Deemo suddenly said.
"And why is that? Not saying that's what I was thinking. I am just asking out of curiosity," Yuan said.
"Sure you are..." Deemo shook his head.

Yet, he still entertained Yuan and explained, "It's because we are only allowed to use our 'creation' to participate. Since you can transform into a demon, I can claim that you're one of my creations."
"Is that so?" Yuan mumbled.
"Anyway, I'll let you know later. I still need some time to think about it."
Deemo nodded, "Take as much time as you need, as long as you decide before the event."
"By the way, is this event the reason Zaaran wanted the Transcendents' blood?" Yuan suddenly asked, recalling Zaaran.
"Yes, he probably wanted to use their blood to strengthen his own creation."
"Zaaran's creations... I have a good guess about what they might be..." Yuan mumbled, recalling the existence of the Giant Race.
As far as he knew, the Giant Race possessed immense strength and durability, but lacked the regeneration that demons had.
'If the Giant Race also had the demons' ridiculous regeneration, they'd become quite the terrifying existence,' Yuan thought to himself.
"I'm done answering your questions," Deemo suddenly declared. "If you want to know more, you can ask me after you agree to become my subject."
"Wait! One last thing! And it's not a question!" Yuan hastily said.
"What is it?"
"Can you give back the Transcendents their freedom?" "How is that not a question?"
"It's a request. If you free them, it'll definitely change my opinion of you... for the better, which will make me more likely to help you," Yuan said with a sly smile.

Deemo silently glared at Yuan with his featureless face. He understood perfectly well what Yuan was trying to do. Although he disliked being taken advantage of, he was willing to tolerate it for the sake of his goal.
"Very well. I will end their punishment for attacking me. It has been long enough, and I had planned to do so soon even without your request," he said.
"Then I'll send you back now."
The next moment, Deemo teleported Yuan back to the Demonic Realm.
"Master Yuan!" Lev cried out loud after seeing Yuan's return.
Selena looked around, clearly searching for the Demon God. However, Deemo didn't go with Yuan.
"Where is the Demon God?" Selena asked him a moment later.
"He's gone," Yuan said.
"How long have I been gone?" he then asked.
"Not long. You've only been gone for three years," Lev answered.
"Three years? It didn't feel longer than a few days..." Yuan muttered.
"Anyway..."
Yuan turned to look at Selena and said with a smile, "I have some good news for you."
Selena raised an eyebrow, a puzzled look on her face.
"The Demon God has agreed to end your punishment. You're no longer confined to Death Paradise, so you're free to leave."
"What...?" Selena's jaw instantly dropped at his words.

chapters.title: Chapter 2462 Ending The Transcendents' Punishment(2)
paragraphs: "C-Can you repeat that for me?" Selena muttered with a dazed look on her face, unable to believe what she'd just heard.
"I said the Demon God has ended your punishment, so you can leave Death Paradise," Yuan repeated.
"Why would he do that? Did you...?" Selena's eyes trembled as they stared at him.
Yuan nodded, "I just tried asking him, and it somehow worked out."
"Th-thank you! Truly!" Selena subconsciously bowed her head to him, something she hadn't done since becoming a Transcendent.
"There's no need to thank me. I didn't really do anything."
Yuan turned to look at the crimson cocoon nearby and approached it.
"Dena..." Yuan had considered asking Deemo to assist Dena with her ascension, but ultimately decided against it, feeling that doing so would wound her pride.
"Knowing her, she'd rather die trying than succeed with help. If I asked Deemo to assist her, she'd probably hate me for life, even if it was for her own good," Yuan sighed softly.
He then turned to Lev and said, "I intend on leaving this place soon."
"You mean Death Paradise? Where will you go next? I will follow you wherever you go!" Lev declared as he proudly patted his chest.
However, Yuan shook his head and said, "No, I will be leaving this world to return to my own. I have been here for long enough."
"Back to your own world...? Then what about me?" Lev stared at him with a dumbfounded face.
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Do you want to follow me back to my world?"
"Can I really follow you?!" Lev's eyes widened with surprise.
Yuan silently nodded.
"I want to!" Lev quickly agreed. "I no longer have a family or home in this world, so it doesn't matter where I go."
"What about your revenge?" Yuan suddenly reminded him of his reason for wanting to leave the Deprived Crimson Valley.
"That's..." Lev closed his eyes and became silent.
A minute later, he opened them again, his eyes flickering with resolve.
"It happened so long ago that I doubt that the bastard is still alive. Unless I encounter him, I will just consider him dead."
"Alright." Yuan nodded.
"Then what about her?" Lev suddenly pointed at Supreme Ruler Dena.
"Well... In that state, I don't think we'll be able to bring her with us."
Suddenly, as if reacting to his words, the cocoon trembled.
"Hm?"
Noticing the subtle movement, Yuan raised an eyebrow and approached the cocoon.
"Dena? Can you hear me?" he called out to her.
The cocoon remained motionless.
"I guess you don't want to come with me, after all."
The cocoon trembled again.
Yuan smiled and said, "Remember our promise? I said that I'd show you my world the next time I came back to the Demonic Realm."
The cocoon did not stop trembling, even growing more active.
Yuan then said, "There's no need to rush your ascension, Dena. It's not like I am going to leave right now."
"We're not?" Lev muttered. "Then what are we going to do now?"
Yuan turned to him and said, "To leave this world and return to mine, we first need to remove the seal blocking the gateway that connects our worlds."
"Although I don't know if it can be removed from this side, I have to try."
Yuan turned to look at Selena and asked her, "What are you going to do now that you have regained your freedom?"
Selena smiled and said, "I'm going to spend some time exploring this world before visiting yours." Yuan's jaw dropped.

"You... want to visit my world?" he swallowed nervously. He didn't believe Selena would necessarily wreak havoc there—but neither could he fully trust that she wouldn't. With her immense power, she could easily cause unimaginable destruction.
"What's with that reaction? You don't want me to visit your world? Or do you not trust me?" Selena approached him and said, sounding a bit offended.
Yuan sighed, "To be frank, I cannot trust anyone besides Dena and Lev to visit my world."
"Is that so? Then how do I gain your trust?" Selena then asked.
"Uh... give me some time to think about it."
Selena nodded and said, "In that case, I will leave you alone for now. Then tell me where you're going, so I can find you once—"
Selena suddenly stopped talking and asked, "Do you still have Helena's blood?
Yuan nodded.
"Keep it with you. I'll find you once I am done."
"Done? With that?" Yuan asked.
"I need to speak with my sisters and let them know that we're free," she said.
"Are you actually real sisters?" She shook her head.
"No, my entire family died during the Great Cataclysm. With that said, we're pretty much family after everything we experienced."
"I see..."
"Then I'll see you guys later. It was fun being with you guys."
Without another word, Selena vanished into thin air like a ghost.
"Where are we going now?" Lev then asked.
"Back to Crimson Continent."
Shortly later, Yuan used Void Manipulation to travel, bringing Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev with him.
Meanwhile, somewhere in Death Paradise, Selena arrived at the portal leading to Helena's personal world.
The instant she stepped inside, a bone-chilling scream of agony tore through the air and assaulted her ears, followed by laughter from another voice.
Selena calmly followed the direction of the screams.
"Please! Spare me and kill me! I was wrong!" Owen cried out loud.
"Hahaha! It's too soon to be begging for mercy, you traitorous bastard!" Helena laughed madly as she continued to torture Owen with unimaginably cruel methods.
Suddenly, she halted and turned around.
"Selena!" "Selena?" Angela, who was also there, approached her.
"What are you doing here? What happened to that human brat?" she asked.
"It's a long story..."

"We have nothing but time. Come, let's have some fun torturing him." Angela grabbed Selena's hand and dragged her toward Owen, who was nailed to a tree, his body blood-soaked and twisted like a spiral.

Yuan sighed, "To be frank, I cannot trust anyone besides Dena and Lev to visit my world."
"Is that so?
Then how do I gain your trust?" Selena then asked.
"Uh... give me some time to think about it."
Selena nodded and said, "In that case, I will leave you alone for now.
Then tell me where you're going, so I can find you once—"
Selena suddenly stopped talking and asked, "Do you still have Helena's blood?
Yuan nodded.
"Keep it with you.
I'll find you once I am done."
"Done?
With that?" Yuan asked.
"I need to speak with my sisters and let them know that we're free," she said.
"Are you actually real sisters?" She shook her head.
"No, my entire family died during the Great Cataclysm.
With that said, we're pretty much family after everything we experienced."
"I see..."
"Then I'll see you guys later.
It was fun being with you guys."
Without another word, Selena vanished into thin air like a ghost.
"Where are we going now?" Lev then asked.
"Back to Crimson Continent."
Shortly later, Yuan used Void Manipulation to travel, bringing Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev with him.
Meanwhile, somewhere in Death Paradise, Selena arrived at the portal leading to Helena's personal world.
The instant she stepped inside, a bone-chilling scream of agony tore through the air and assaulted her ears, followed by laughter from another voice.
Selena calmly followed the direction of the screams.
"Please!
Spare me and kill me!
I was wrong!" Owen cried out loud.
"Hahaha!
It's too soon to be begging for mercy, you traitorous bastard!" Helena laughed madly as she continued to torture Owen with unimaginably cruel methods.
Suddenly, she halted and turned around.
"Selena!" "Selena?" Angela, who was also there, approached her.
"What are you doing here?
What happened to that human brat?" she asked.
"It's a long story..."
"We have nothing but time.
Come, let's have some fun torturing him." Angela grabbed Selena's hand and dragged her toward Owen, who was nailed to a tree, his body blood-soaked and twisted like a spiral.

chapters.title: Chapter 2463 Dethroning Qian Chu
paragraphs: Selena calmly gazed at Owen, who was treated like some kind of testing dummy, and said, "I have some news for you. Once you hear it, I doubt you will still want to waste your time on him."
"Wasting our time on him?" Angela raised her eyebrows, looking confused.

Angela and Helena then exchanged glances with each other. They have known her for the majority of their lives, so even though Selena wore a calm expression on her face right now, they could tell that she was extremely delighted for some reason.
"What happened, Selena? I have never seen you so happy before," Helena eventually questioned.
Hearing her words, Selena could no longer contain her excitement and smiled brightly.
"The Demon God has ended our punishment. We're free to leave Death Paradise now," she revealed.
"What?!"
Both Angela and Helena exclaimed simultaneously, not daring to believe their ears.
"How is that possible?!" Helena questioned after snapping out of her daze.
Selena proceeded to explain the situation to them.
"That human brat asked the Demon God to free us, and the Demon God just agreed?! That sounds too good to be true!" Helena said afterward.
"I have to agree with her, Selena," Angela shook her head and sighed. "Did you even confirm that we are free before you came here to tell us?"
"Uh..." Selena fell silent for a moment before responding in a stiff tone, "I didn't."
"What?! You came here to tell us this news without even confirming it yourself?!" Helena exclaimed in disbelief.
"Because I wanted to experience it together..." Selena sighed.
"That's..."
The two fell silent as they examined Selena's calm yet emotional expression.
"Alright... Let's go and see whether that brat was telling the truth or not," Angela said a moment later.
Helena nodded, and they all left the world shortly later, leaving Owen behind.
Soon, they arrived at the border of Death Paradise.
"So... who wants to try leaving first?" Angela asked out loud.

Due to the Demon God's punishment, if they tried to leave Death Paradise even for a second, they would experience unfathomable pain nonstop for a million years. One might think they could simply endure the pain, but they wouldn't get far out of Death Paradise before being teleported back to their prison.
"I will go first since I am the one who's telling you to trust him," Selena said with a resolute face.
However, as Selena moved toward the border, Helena suddenly grabbed her hand and said, "No, let's do it together."
Helena followed Selena, leaving Angela behind, silently staring at them.
Eventually, Angela sighed and said, "Wait, I'll go with you."
Moments later, the three of them hovered right at the edge of Death Paradise. "Here we go..."
After taking a deep breath, they took the final step and left Death Paradise for the first time in billions of years.
The three of them froze outside Death Paradise, their hearts racing with the expectation that they would soon experience unimaginable pain for defying the Demon God's punishment.
Yet, even after a full minute, none of them felt any pain.
They exchanged gazes with each other, their faces looking completely dazed.
"We're... outside?"
"I'm... not experiencing any pain..."
"Me neither..."
After they fully digested the situation and a long moment of silence, they celebrated with joy.
"It's true! We're no longer confined within Death Paradise!" Helena cried tears of joy.
"Hahaha! That damn brat! I shouldn't have doubted him!" Angela said.
"Un." Selena nodded, causing the river of tears from her eyes to fall faster.
Once they calmed down, Angela asked, "How did he do it? I find it hard to believe that he simply asked the Demon God to free us, and the Demon God agreed.
Selena shook her head and said, "There's no point dwelling on it. It doesn't matter how he did it. The only thing that matters is that we owe him for helping us regain our freedom."
Helena and Angela nodded their heads in agreement.
"So, what should we do now that we're free?" Angela then asked.
"We can do whatever we want," Helena said. "I am going to continue torturing that traitor for a little longer then explore the world."
"I am also going to explore the world," Angela said.
Selena then said, "Me too, but once I am bored of this place, I intend on visiting the other world, where humans still exist."
"The other world...?" Helena and Angela stared at her with wide eyes. "You mean that brat's world? Are you sure that's a good idea?"
"I don't plan on going without receiving his permission," Selena shook her head. "If he doesn't allow it, then I will just go elsewhere."
She lifted her head to look at the sky.

"When we left this world and went to confront the Demon God, I realized just how small our world truly was. That vast, boundless space that exists beyond our world... I want to explore as much of it as I can."
"Then I will go with you," Angela said.
Helena nodded, "Wherever you go, we'll go with you."
"Alright."
Meanwhile, at the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, two distinct groups of people stood before each other, looking like they were prepared to go to war.
"Qian Chu! I am here today to claim what is rightfully mine!" Yan Hara loudly declared.
"What is rightfully yours? What could you possibly be talking about?" Qian Chu sneered.

"I am talking about your position as the Demon Sealing Clan's leader!" "Hah!" Qian Chu coldly laughed. "My position rightfully belongs to you? Based on what? You didn't even qualify to be a Supreme Demon Sealer, yet you want to become the leader? You must be out of your mind!"
"The Leader's right. What qualifications do you have to even dare make such a claim?!"
Those on Qian Chu's side shouted.
"Haven't you heard?! Senior Yan has inherited the Divine Paragon's legacy!" Those supporting Yan Hara began shouting back.
"That's right! If anybody should be the leader, it should be her! Not some cold-hearted bastard like Qian Chu!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2464 Dethroning Qian Chu(2)
paragraphs: "The Divine Paragon's legacy?! That's just a baseless rumor you've been spreading as a part of your scheme to usurp the Clan Leader's position!" "I even saw those bastards at the Demon Sealing Grotto spreading this bullshit! There's no way it's real!"
Qian Chu's group exclaimed angrily, refusing to believe the rumors.
"Why the hell would we make up something that can easily be disproven?! It's a fact that Senior Yan has acquired the Divine Paragon's techniques through his legacy!"

"That's right! We have witnessed it ourselves! Senior Yan has definitely received the Divine Paragon's legacy! Not only that, but she has been fixing the relationship between the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto!"

"Meanwhile, Qian Chu has done absolutely nothing for the Demon Sealing Clan since he acquired his position! Even worse, when we needed him, he vanished for years without a word! How can we trust someone like that?!"
"With the demons and demon worshippers growing more active lately, we need someone we can trust to lead us! And that person is Senior Yan!"
Yan Hara's group and Qian Chu's group argued back and forth while the two of them silently stared at each other.
"Enough." Qian Chu eventually spoke, blanketing the place with his powerful presence.
"What do you think you're doing? Threatening us now that your position is in danger?" Yan Hara muttered, fighting his presence with her own.
"In danger? My position was never in danger!" Qian Chu let out a cold chuckle.
"So what if you're the Divine Paragon's successor? Even if it were true, there's no rule stating that the Divine Paragon's successor will automatically become the Clan Leader!" he said.
Yan Hara opened her mouth, but no words came out.
'He's... right...' she thought inwardly.

Although the Divine Paragon was the first leader of the Demon Sealing Clan and created for him, it wasn't as though he founded the organization, and most of the clan's rules were actually established only after his disappearance.
In other words, the Demon Sealing Clan did not truly belong to the Divine Paragon, but the Demon Sealers that followed him.
Qian Chu continued speaking a moment later, "If you want my position as the Clan Leader, you must challenge me properly."
"What are you trying to say?" Yan Hara asked with narrowed eyes.
Qian Chu smiled and said, "As one of our elites, you should know very well what I'm trying to say."

"There are two ways to become—or rather, replace—the current Clan Leader. The first is by gaining the support of at least seventy percent of the Demon Sealing Clan's members. And while you've managed to gather a fair number of followers, it's nowhere near enough."
"The second method is—"

"The Demon Slaying Parade," Yan Hara cut in. The Demon Slaying Parade she mentioned was an event where the Clan Leader and their challenger compete in a race to hunt a group of demons, and victory belongs to whoever seals all of the demons first.
Of course, they would not be hunting real demons but artificial demons.
"So, are you challenging me through the Demon Slaying Parade?" Qian Chu questioned her.
"D-Don't do it, Senior Yan!"
Yan Hara's support group quickly said.
"I bet it's a trap!"
Yuan Hara closed her eyes and said, "Although I may not have enough support at my side, that is only true for the Demon Sealing Clan."
"What?" Qian Chu raised an eyebrow.
"The Demon Sealing Grotto. I have the majority of the Demon Sealing Grotto's support, including their top Demon Sealers," she clarified.

"Hahaha!" Qian Chu burst out laughing. "The Demon Sealing Grotto?! Are you that desperate? So what if you have their support? Even if the entire Demon Sealing Grotto is supporting you, since they do not belong to the Demon Sealing Clan, it does not matter!"

"Nothing to do with the Demon Sealing Clan?" Yan Hara muttered. "So what if they're from a different organization? It doesn't change the fact that they are Demon Sealers and many of their original members came from the Demon Sealing Clan."
After a slight pause, Yan Hara continued, "I intended on revealing this once I become the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan, but I might as well say it now."
She took a deep breath and said, "The Demon Sealing Grotto has agreed to merge with the Demon Sealing Clan, becoming one again.
"What? The Demon Sealing Grotto? I thought we were at war with them?"
The members of Qian Chu's group started mumbling to each other. Even amongst Yan Hara's group, there were many who were surprised by this information.
Suddenly, a loud voice rang out from outside. "W-We have a problem! We have a huge problem!" Everyone in the library turned toward the sound just in time to see a guard rushing in.
"What's the matter?" someone asked.
"Th-The Demon Sealing Grotto! The Demon Sealing Grotto is invading us! And it's not just a few of them! It looks like they brought everyone!" The guard exclaimed.
"What?!"
Everyone there turned to look at Yan Hara.
"B-But you just said that they planned to merge with us?! What is the meaning of this, Yan Hara?!"
"I knew it! You were just spewing lies!"
However, Yan Hara remained calm and asked the guard, "Are you sure they're here to invade us? Did they say they were going to do so?"
"T-That's..." The guard opened his mouth, but was utterly speechless.
In truth, he escaped in fear the moment he saw the Demon Sealing Grotto.
Without saying a word, Yan Hara turned around and started walking outside.
Qian Chu and the others watched in silence for a moment before following her.
Outside, Zhou Yanfei and the entire Demon Sealing Grotto had gathered, encircling the gates of the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library.
Some time later, Zhou Yanfei and the others could see a massive group of people coming out of the library.
"What is the meaning of this, Zhou Yanfei? Are you looking to start an all-out war with us today?" Qian Chu's voice resounded before they could even see his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2465 Dethroning Qian Chu(3)
paragraphs: "An all-out war?" Zhou Yanfei chuckled at Qian Chu's words. "I'm sure that's what you want, considering that you have been scheming against our Demon Sealing Grotto ever since you came into power."
"That's slander!" Qian Chu's supporters shouted angrily.

"Slander?" Zhou Yanfei calmly shook his head. "It's a fact that our Demon Sealing Grotto has suffered far more casualties and abnormalities ever since Qian Chu became Clan Leader—missing members, random ambushes, and more."
"How can you blame Leader Qian for any of that?!"
"Right?! It's just that the members of the Demon Sealing Grotto are lacking in ability!" Qian Chu's supporters retorted.
"I heard that the Demon Sealing Grotto's headquarters was recently attacked by demons. Are you going to blame that on Leader Qian, too?!"
"You're too much, Demon Sealing Grotto! Look at how lowly you've fallen!"
Zhou Yanfei and the rest of the Demon Sealing Grotto remained silent as Qian Chu's supporters hurled insults at them.
Eventually, Zhou Yanfei stared at Qian Chu and said, "I—We did not come here today to argue with you or the Demon Sealing Clan."
"Then why are you here today?"
Zhou Yanfei walked to stand in front of Yan Hara and suddenly lowered his head, bowing to her respectfully.
The members of the Demon Sealing Grotto behind him followed his gesture, bowing to her.
"We are here today to show our support for Yan Hara, who will lead the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto in the near future.
The entire place fell silent.
Even though Yan Hara had already mentioned the Demon Sealing Grotto's desire to merge with the Demon Sealing Clan, many of them did not actually believe her, most of them being Qian Chu's supporters.
Yan Hara turned to face Qian Chu and said, "Since we are already here, I no longer see a reason to hide this any longer."

"Qian Chu, although I do not know what you're scheming, I am certain that you do not care about the Demon Sealing Clan or have any interest in sealing demons. As a matter of fact, I know that you're working for the demons!"
"What?!"
Zhou Yanfei and most of the people there expressed shock after hearing Yan Hara's outrageous claim.
However, for some reason, many of Qian Chu's supporters did not have such a reaction, most of them looking eerily calm.

"Me? Working for demons?" Qian Chu mumbled before bursting out in laughter. "Yan Hara, your claims are getting more and more outrageous! You must truly be out of your mind! What evidence do you have that I am working for demons?! If you really think you can force me out of my position with such slander, think again!"
Yan Hara remained calm and said, "Unfortunately, I do not have any solid evidence that you're working for the demons, but even so, I never intended to rely on this information to bring you down."
"Then why even bother mentioning it?! If anything, it puts your credibility to question!"
"I mentioned it just purely to let you know that I know about it," said Yan Hara.
A smile suddenly tugged at her lips and said, "Qian Chu, I challenge you to the Demon Slaying Parade. If you lose, you will have to give up being the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan."
Qian Chu smiled and said, "Then if you lose, you will hand over the Divine Paragon's demon sealing techniques."
"What?! Don't do it, Yan Hara! We don't need to do something so risky when we can just remove him by force!" Zhou Yanfei exclaimed.

"Senior Zhou is right, Senior Yan! The Divine Paragon's legacy can't be handed to someone who might be colluding with demons! They'll definitely try to destroy them!" her supporters echoed. Yan Hara shook her head and sighed.

"If I'm going to lead the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto in the future, I need to prove myself properly. As much as I hate to admit it, Qian Chu is right that merely inheriting the Divine Paragon's legacy doesn't automatically qualify me to be the Clan Leader. That is why I will challenge him for his position."
She turned to face them and asked loudly, "Or do you think that I will lose him?!"

"That's not it, Yan Hara." Zhou Yanfei said. "It is not that we doubt your abilities. We just don't want anything to go wrong and lose you. After all, the Demon Slaying Parade isn't exactly a safe event."
"Don't worry, I will be fine." Yan Hara said with a confident smile on her face.
She turned to stare at Qian Chu in the eyes the following moment and said, "I agree to your terms."
"Then we will commence the Demon Slaying Parade exactly one month from now!" After saying that, Qian Chu turned around and disappeared back into the library with his supporters.
"Why would you make a wager involving the Divine Paragon's legacy, especially with that hateful bastard Qian Chu of all people?" Zhou Yanfei asked Yan Hara with a worried face.

paragraphs: "No matter what Qian Chu is planning, I will beat him at his own game and become the leader!" Yan Hara confidently declared, and her supporters loudly cheered.
Zhou Yanfei sighed.
"In any case, let's start preparing for the Demon Slaying Parade. There is also something I need to talk to you about."
"Is it regarding the Demon Sealers that have gone missing lately?" Yan Hara asked with a solemn face.

He nodded and said, "Our members have been disappearing in the same manner as those women abducted by the demons. As much as we'd like to keep everyone within the safety of our headquarters, we cannot simply ignore the chaos caused by the demon worshippers."
Yan Hara then said, "It's not just the Demon Sealing Grotto. Our members have also started disappearing recently."
"And they're mostly members who support Senior Yan!" One of her supporters said.
"Is it a coincidence, or is he..." Zhou Yanfei mumbled.
"Let us discuss this elsewhere," Yan Hara interrupted.
Zhou Yanfei nodded.
Moments later, Yan Hara and Zhou Yanfei went somewhere private to continue their discussion while the others went to prepare for the Demon Slaying Parade.
It didn't take long before news of Yan Hara challenging Qian Chu to the Demon Slaying Parade spread.
Although the Demon Sealing Clan had long since faded from relevance, the recent return of demons and the growing activity of demon worshippers had caused their name to surface once more.
"Fuck! Why the hell are the Demon Sealers messing around when the demons have returned?! If they want to fight, they should do it after dealing with the demons!"
"These Demon Sealers have completely forgotten their purpose after so many years of being inactive!"

"The Demon Worshippers destroyed my village recently! If the Demon Sealers weren't fighting amongst themselves, my family might have survived!" Because of the ongoing chaos, many outsiders questioned why they were fighting amongst themselves during such a critical time, with most of the criticism being directed toward Yan Hara for initiating the conflict.

Somewhere within Ninth Heaven, a tall, slender woman with long black hair approached a towering, broad-shouldered figure and asked, "Master, is it true that something is happening at the Demon Sealing Clan?
"You also heard about it? Are you interested in the drama? How unusual for you, Meixiu."
Meixiu showed a slight smile and said, "I know someone who is closely related to them, after all. What is the Demon Slaying Parade that I heard about?"

"Sorry, but I don't know anything about the Demon Sealing Clan. However, I heard that it's an event which will be open to the public. Do you want to go? You have been training nonstop with barely any breaks for many years now," said Keling, her master.
Meixiu pondered for a moment before nodding her head, "I want to go."
In the Demonic Realm, after leaving Death Paradise, Yuan used Water Tunnel to travel to a part of the Blood Expanse that was closest to their destination.
"Where are we going, anyway?" Lev asked once they returned to the Crimson Continent.
"Blood Monastery," Yuan calmly replied.
"What? Isn't that the place where previous Supreme Rulers are honored? We're basically returning to the City of Blood. Do you think Supreme Ruler Grant has made it back yet?"
"I guess we'll find out once we get there."
Some time later, they returned to the City of Blood.
Before they'd left, their battle had reduced the entire city to ruins, filling its land with massive craters.

After they left, the Supreme Adviser brought its residents back and had them repair the city. With tens of millions of residents—many of them being in the Immortal Realm and False Gods—working on restoring the city at once, it didn't take long before they filled all of the craters and rebuilt the houses. Yet, the city looked nothing like it had in the past and basically had become an entirely new city.

"Hm? What are they doing?" Yuan asked out loud when he used his divine sense to sweep the city and noticed that pretty much the majority of its residents were gathered at the Supreme Ruler's headquarters.
Lev examined the situation for a moment before responding, "I believe it is a funeral... for the Supreme Ruler."
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Supreme Ruler Grant is dead? But he was alive when we parted," he muttered.
"Either they think he's dead, or it's actually meant for the Supreme Ancestor," Lev then said.
"Oh, right. I forgot about him," Yuan remarked with a chuckle.
"I don't want to disturb them, so let's wait until they are done."
"But the funeral usually lasts for a hundred ye—"
"We don't have time for that," Yuan interrupted before entering the city.
At the Supreme Ruler's headquarters, the Supreme Adviser was giving a speech to those gathered.
"We are gathered here today to honor and remember the Supreme Ancestor, our 13th Supreme Ruler—"
Shortly after the Supreme Adviser began his speech, two figures descended before him.
"Y-You are—!" The Supreme Adviser fell back on his buttocks from shock and fear after seeing Yuan's face.
"I'm back," Yuan calmly said.
"You may be back, but where is Supreme Ruler Grant?!" The Supreme Adviser began frantically looking around for Supreme Ruler Grant.
"Don't tell me you killed him!" When the Supreme Adviser could not find Supreme Ruler Grant, he instantly turned to Yuan and accused him of murdering the Supreme Ruler.
Yuan shook his head and said, "No, he should be on his way back here as we speak."
After a moment of silence, the Supreme Adviser asked him, "Then why have you returned? Can't you see that we're in the middle of a funeral?"

"Relax, we're not here to cause trouble. I am just here for the key to the Blood Monastery," Yuan replied. "The Blood Monastery?! Are you trying to desecrate the resting place of our Supreme Rulers?!" the Supreme Adviser exclaimed, staring at Yuan with a look of disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2467 Bloody Monastery
paragraphs: "Not only have you completely destroyed our city, but you even kidnapped our Supreme Ruler! Even if you have the prowess to kill us all, I won't let you desecrate the Blood Monastery!" The Supreme Adviser stood tall before Yuan, acting tough. Unfortunately, his body betrayed him by trembling uncontrollably.
Yuan shook his head and calmly spoke in a reassuring tone, "You can calm down because I have no intention of desecrating the Blood Monastery. I am only trying to get home—to my own world."
"What?" The Supreme Adviser raised his eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
"The gateway that connects our world is located in the Blood Monastery, and in order to get home, I have to use that," Yuan elaborated.
"How did you get here in the first place? Can't you just return using that method?" The Supreme Adviser questioned.
"No, because that is a one-way traveling method."
The Supreme Adviser fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "Do you swear on your soul that you'll not destroy the Blood Monastery and leave this world as soon as possible?"
Yuan nodded, "I swear I won't purposefully destroy the Blood Monastery and will leave as soon as possible."
'Won't purposefully...?'
The Supreme Adviser noticed Yuan's specific choice of words but decided not to pursue it.
"Come with me. I'll take you to the Blood Monastery."
The Supreme Adviser said a few words to the people there before leaving with Yuan and Lev.
Some time later, the Supreme Adviser brought them to a location situated outside the City of Blood—a small and modest building that was built with bricks that appeared to have been dyed with blood.
The Supreme Adviser walked to the door and retrieved a crimson key from his spatial ring before unlocking it.
If the key hadn't been used and someone were to try to force their way inside, a powerful formation that protected the area would have activated, unleashing Demon God's Wrath upon the offender.
Yuan and Lev followed the Supreme Adviser inside, where a crimson statue of an unfamiliar figure loomed at the far end, and directly before it, a portal stood open.
Without saying a word, the Supreme Adviser entered the portal, with Yuan and Lev entering a moment later.
Since Yuan had been to the Blood Monastery before, he wasn't worried about any traps.
Upon entering the portal, they were teleported to the real Blood Monastery that existed somewhere within the Crimson Continent.
A massive, cathedral-like structure loomed just ahead, its doors already open, as though it had been expecting them.
Surrounding them was nothing but empty air, making it seem as though they stood upon an island adrift in the sky.
The Supreme Adviser walked to the entrance before halting his movements and speaking in a solemn voice without turning around, "Is the Supreme Ruler really alive?"
"Yes, we didn't touch him. In fact, he was barely useful and just followed us around."
"I understand."
The Supreme Adviser nodded and continued walking, disappearing into the dark halls ahead.

After walking in complete darkness for several minutes, they emerged into a dim, spacious chamber. At its center stood the same statue as before, encircled by fourteen coffins positioned in a deliberate pattern, as though they were bowing in reverence before it. "Why are there fourteen coffins? I thought only the deceased were honored here," Lev couldn't help but ask aloud. Since Supreme Ruler Dena and Supreme Ruler Grant were both still alive, it made no sense to have so many coffins, especially when Supreme Ruler Grant was the fourteenth Supreme Ruler.
Yuan answered in the Supreme Adviser's stead. "A coffin is created shortly after someone becomes a Supreme Ruler and placed here, whether they're dead or still alive."
"In fact, all of these coffins are empty, as not a single Supreme Ruler died of natural causes."
Since demons could only die if they are completely annihilated, it was essentially impossible for them to have a corpse to put into these coffins.
"We are here. Where is the gateway that you speak of?" The Supreme Adviser turned to Yuan and questioned.
Yuan turned to look at the state in the middle of the room and pointed at it before suddenly shooting out some Demon Sealing Aura.
"What do you think you are doing?!" The Supreme Adviser cried out loud, thinking that Yuan was trying to destroy the statue.
However, when the Demon Sealing Aura struck the statue a moment later, it suddenly vanished into the statue rather than dispersing from impact.
After a brief moment of eerie stillness, the Bloody Monastery suddenly began to tremble.
At the same time, the space above them rippled violently, unveiling a massive portal that stretched across the entire ceiling.
"My god!" The Supreme Adviser stared at the portal in shock and disbelief, wondering how long it had been there.
Meanwhile, Yuan did not immediately enter the portal. Instead, he stood still, silently examining it.
'Since the seal was created from the Nine Heavens' side, I can barely see it from this side...'
Fortunately, it was likely that he could still remove the seal from this side. Unfortunately, it would take much longer than necessary.
Yuan turned to the Supreme Adviser and said, "Thanks. You can leave now."
"Hell no!" The Supreme Adviser immediately shouted. "Who knows what you're going to do here during my absence? I will stay here until you are gone!" He declared.
Yuan gave a nonchalant shrug and said, "Suit yourself."
The next moment, Yuan approached the portal and started working on the seal.
Meanwhile, somewhere within the Seventh Heaven—where the sealed gateway to the Demonic Realm lay hidden—one of the guards stationed there noticed the seal beginning to crack ever so slowly.
"L-Look! The seal to the Demonic Realm is breaking!!!"
The guard who noticed it first immediately shouted to alert the others. However, they only slowly turned toward him with unimpressed expressions, clearly not believing a single word he said.
"I swear on my soul! Just look!" the guard frowned, hurriedly pointing toward the seal.
Yet the others still remained unconvinced. Shaking their heads, they began lecturing him instead.
"I know you're bored, but this isn't the kind of joke you should be making."

chapters.title: Chapter 2468 Demon Slaying Parade
paragraphs: "Fuck! I am not joking! Just look! There are cracks on the seal! If I am joking, I will give you guys my paycheck for the next decade!" The guard shouted angrily.
Hearing this, the other guards finally turned toward the entrance to the Demonic Realm—a pair of enormous gates bound by nine golden chains and surrounded by a semi-transparent barrier.
At first glance, the barrier itself appeared perfectly intact. However, the moment they inspected the golden chains more closely, their expressions changed.
One of the chains had developed visible cracks, despite having remained flawless for millions of years.
"I-It's true! There are cracks on one of the seals!" The guards immediately began to panic.

"Fuck! What should we do?!"
"There's only one thing to do! Contact the Demon Sealers!"

Two of the guards swiftly retrieved communication jade slips from their Spatial Rings and contacted their respective superiors—one reaching out to the Demon Sealing Clan, while the other informed the Demon Sealing Grotto.
"We have an emergency! One of the seals on the entrance to the Demonic Realm has been damaged!"
"What do you mean it has been damaged?! Are you under attack?!"
"No! It just cracked by itself!"
"Damn it! Why does something like this have to happen while the Stairway to Heaven is still missing?! And with the Demon Slaying Parade approaching, no less!" the Demon Sealer sighed in frustration.

"Fortunately, this is likely nothing more than minor deterioration caused by age," he continued. "The seal has existed since the Demonic Era, and we already knew it had been gradually weakening over time."
"So what should we do?" asked the guard.
"Nothing. Just keep doing your job and watch over it."
"I understand..."
In the end, both guards received nearly identical responses and were instructed to simply remain vigilant and continue monitoring the seal.

As for the Demon Sealers, neither bothered informing their superiors about the situation, deeming it insignificant. Besides, everyone was already overwhelmed with preparations for the Demon Slaying Parade and the growing activities of the demon worshippers.
Time continued to pass, and as the days drew closer to the Demon Slaying Parade, more and more cracks began appearing across the seal.
"Hey... what did the Boss say? Are you sure we can ignore it?" One of the guards asked when he saw that one of the chains was covered in cracks and appeared to be on the verge of shattering.
"It's fine," said the guard who contacted the Demon Sealers. "The Boss assured me that it's normal and that they are already aware of—"
Clang!
Suddenly, one of the golden chains shattered, startling everyone there.
"Uh... I think you should contact the Boss again."
The guards contacted the Demon Sealers for the second time shortly later.
"Senior, one of the seals has shattered!" "What? It shattered? What about the other seals? There should be nine of them."
"The other eight are fine."
"Then ignore it. We will deal with it once the Demon Slaying Parade ends."
"I understand..."
After closing the call, the guard said to the others, "He said to ignore it."
"Mine said the same," said the other guard.
The guards looked at the eight remaining seals in silence.
"I guess it will be fine as long as the others are—"
Before the guard could even finish his sentence, two more seals began to crack simultaneously.
The guards exchanged silent glances with each other, wondering if they should contact their Bosses again.

"Any news on the Stairway to Heaven? It's been gone for a few years now.
"I don't know about the Stairway to Heaven, but I heard that the Celestial Emperor has already hired the God of Creation to forge us a new one."
The visitors chatted with each other while they waited for the event to begin.
"And how long would that take? If it's even possible to make a new one. There's a reason why the Stairway to Heaven has remained our only realm-traversing treasure since its creation."
"To think the Stairway to Heaven was created millions of years ago. Whoever made it was way ahead of their time!"
A different topic was being discussed in another area.
"When was the last time the Demon Slaying Parade occurred?"
"Several thousand years ago, I think."
"The Demon Slaying Parade has happened seven times since the Demon Sealing Clan's creation, most of them happening shortly after their founder suddenly disappeared without announcing a successor."
"Who is this Yan Hara? I have never heard of her until today."
"From what I've heard, she's a Master Demon Sealer, not even a Supreme Demon Sealer."
"And she's challenging the leader? Why would she do that?"

"According to rumor, she holds a grudge against Qian Chu because she blames him for her failure during the Supreme Demon Sealer Qualifications." "What? If that's true, how pathetic." "Women, am I right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2469 Demon Slaying Parade(2)
paragraphs: "What should we do, Senior Yan? Quite frankly, I don't think the seal will last long enough for us to even do anything about it, let alone fix it."
"Fix it?" Yan Hara sneered. "If we could fix it, we would have done so long ago! If the seal breaks, we can only try to ward off the demons that will come pouring out until he comes to reseal it!"
"He? Who is this person that can reseal the Demonic Realm?" The Demon Sealer looked at Yan Hara with his eyebrows raised in a puzzled manner.
"..." Yan Hara remained silent for a moment before responding in a nonchalant tone, "Don't worry about it."

Then, she continued, "Have all of the Demon Sealers in the Seventh Heaven head to the entrance to the Demonic Realm in case the seal really breaks. Unfortunately, there's nothing we can do right now."
"What if the seal really breaks and demons come pouring out?" The Demon Sealer asked in a nervous tone.
"Although Demon Sealers have gotten weaker compared to before, the rest of the world has become stronger, so even if the Demon Clan invades, we won't be as powerless as before."
"But just in case, have someone notify the Celestial Emperor of the situation. He is the only one who can traverse the Nine Heavens without the Stairway to Heaven right now."
"I understand."
Once the Demon Sealer left, Yan Hara looked at the communication jade slip in her grasp with a slightly worried face. "Where are you right now, Yuan?" she mumbled in a low voice.

Yan Hara tried to contact Yuan, but her message would immediately bounce back to her, meaning that the other end could not receive it, and this would only happen if they were in a place too far away, or in a place that blocked communications.
"The only thing I can do now is focus on the Demon Slaying Parade and take down Qian Chu! If I don't do so, the Demon Sealers will never be able to work together!"
Meanwhile, at the Bloody Monastery, Yuan was still working on the seal.
"How much longer is this going to take?" asked the Supreme Adviser.
"I should be done in a few more years," Yuan calmly replied.
Although only two weeks had passed in the Nine Heavens, it had been over a decade since Yuan started working on removing the seal.
Suddenly, the Supreme Adviser turned to face the entrance, where a silhouette could be seen entering the chamber.
"S-Supreme Ruler!" The Supreme Adviser cried out loud when he realized it was Supreme Ruler Grant.
"Oh? Looks like you made it back safely," Yuan remarked without looking back.
"You... Why are you here? I thought you were at Death Paradise?" Supreme Ruler Grant asked with a puzzled frown on his face.
He returned to the City of Blood very recently, but immediately came to the Bloody Monastery after learning about Yuan's presence.
"I was, but now I am here."
"What happened after I left?"
"Why do you care? It's none of your business, anyway."
"...Then why are you here? And what the hell are you doing?"
Supreme Ruler Grant looked at the massive portal on the ceiling.
"Don't you dare say that it's none of my business because this is very much my business!"
"Explain it to him, Lev."

Lev nodded and quickly said, "What you are looking at is the gateway between our world and his world. However, it is sealed from the other side, and he is trying to undo the seal so that he could return to his world."
"The gateway to his world...?" Supreme Ruler Grant muttered in a low voice with a pondering expression on his face.
Yuan suddenly said, "If you are thinking about invading my world..."
"No, I am not!" Supreme Ruler Grant quickly cut him off.
"I was just wondering how long this gateway has been here since this is my first time hearing of such a thing."
"Since Dena was in power, I suppose."

"Speaking of Dena..." Yuan continued after a brief moment of silence. "I want you to remove the law that prevents us from uttering her name, as well as mine. Nobody should be killed over uttering a name."
Supreme Ruler Grant then said, "But I wasn't the one who created this rule."
"Why does it matter? I just want you to remove it." "Not until the one who made it is dead."
"Is that so? Then who made the rule? Owen?"
Supreme Ruler Grant nodded.
"How troublesome," Yuan sighed. "That bastard probably won't die for a long time..."
"Why is that?"
"He's being kept alive so that he could be tortured."
"Don't tell me the ones torturing him are..." Supreme Ruler Grant swallowed nervously.
"Oh, right. Speaking of the Transcedents, don't be surprised if you see them around. They're no longer imprisoned within Death Paradise."
"WHAT?!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed in shock.
Even though he was the Supreme Ruler, he was terrified of the Transcendents' unfathomable prowess.
"Relax, it's not like they are unreasonable serial killers. As long as you don't offend them, nothing will happen."
"That's right. As long as you don't offend us, we won't kill you."
A familiar voice suddenly resounded behind Supreme Ruler Grant, greatly startling him.
Supreme Ruler Grant swiftly turned around to see three pale beauties standing behind him, appearing out of nowhere like ghosts.
"H-How?! How did you get in here?! I know I locked the doors behind me!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed.
"Oh, that? It broke when we tried to get inside. It was by accident. I swear," Selena said in a calm voice.
Yuan turned around and asked them, "What are you guys doing here? I doubt you explored the entire world already."
"We decided to put that on hold for now," Selena said. "Have you thought about what we could do to gain your trust?"
"We?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Yes, since we want to visit your world together."
Yuan fell silent with a solemn expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 2470 Demon Slaying Parade(3)
paragraphs: Yuan fell silent to ponder about the Transcendents visiting the Nine Heavens. Since Cultivation God was the apex in the Nine Heavens, suddenly throwing an Absolute God into it would undoubtedly cause mayhem.
However, it wasn't necessarily entirely bad, as it could help advance the cultivation world since it proved that Cultivation God wasn't the peak.
'If it was just one of them, I would be able to manage, but all three of them?' Yuan sighed inwardly.
The risks were too high, especially considering their chaotic nature.
"What are you even worried about?" Angela suddenly asked aloud.
"I'm worried that you might cause havoc and I won't be able to stop you in time," Yuan responded with his true feelings and worries.
"Why would we cause havoc? We're not barbarians or demons." Helena sneered, feeling a little offended.
"Well... you didn't exactly give me a good first impression..." Yuan sighed.
Angela and Helena immediately fell silent after hearing such words, as neither of them could deny that they were aggressive to him in the beginning.
Meanwhile, Selena had been staring at Lev this entire time, seemingly lost in thought.
"Hmph! Why do we even need your permission to visit your world?" Angela suddenly sneered. "It's not like you own that world, after all."
"It may not be my world, but if I allow you to enter it and you start slaughtering people, then every life lost there will be my fault," Yuan said, shaking his head.
"Can you swear that you won't harm anyone while you are there?" Yuan asked.
"That's..."
None of them could bring themselves to make such an oath outright. After all, beings at their level could accidentally kill someone with something as trivial as a sneeze.
Selena suddenly stepped forward and said, "What if I agree to be your servant while I am there? If you have complete control over me, you wouldn't need to worry about me being unpredictable."
"What are you saying, Selena?!" Angela and Helena snapped their heads to stare at her in shock and disbelief.
Even Yuan looked at her with raised eyebrows, surprised by her proposal.
"There's no need to lower yourself to the point of becoming his servant just to visit his world!" Helena said, trying to convince her that it was a terrible idea.
"If this is how you think you can repay him for freeing us..." Angela spoke with a frown, "This isn't it."
Yuan then said, "She's right. You don't have to repay me.
Selena shook her head and said, "This isn't just about repaying you."
"Then what is it about?"
Selena opened her mouth but closed it a second later without uttering a word.
"It's a secret," she eventually said.
"Is that so?" Yuan muttered before closing his eyes to ponder.
"If you become my servant, I will definitely be more at ease with you traveling my world, but I don't know if that will help me trust you."
"Then what do you want from me?" "Help me clean up some trash," Yuan then said, dumbfounding her.
"You want me... to clean up trash?" she muttered in a daze.
"Hey! You're going overboard! There's no way—" Angela said.

"I don't mean literal trash—the kind you see lying on the streets," Yuan said, shaking his head. "My world was invaded by Forsaken in the past, bringing unimaginable terror with them. Things are far better now after I wiped out most of them, but some still remain."
He then looked at Selena and continued, "You may visit my world, but while you're there, you must eliminate every last Forsaken. How does that sound?"
"Deal!" Selena agreed to his request almost instantly.
"Ah, what about them?"
Her gaze pointed at Angela and Helena.
"I will be frank with you," Yuan spoke. "I do not trust them one bit."
"Wha—"
Angela and Helena's jaw dropped at his words.
But Yuan wasn't finished speaking, and he continued, "Not only do they clearly have bad tempers, but they are the type that believes violence solves everything."
"How could I sleep peacefully knowing that not just one, but two of them are loose in the world?
"Bastard! You're treating us like rabid dogs!" Helena shouted while pointing at him.
"If you're going to treat us like that, I will bite you like one!" Angela stomped her feet angrily.
"You see what I mean?" Yuan sighed as he shook his head.
Selena gazed at the two with a disappointed yet understanding gaze.
"As much as I appreciate you trusting me, I cannot leave them behind and explore alone, so unless you trust all of us, I will stay here with them."
"Selena..."
They looked at her with softened expressions, appearing as though they were on the verge of tears.
After a moment of silence, Angela turned to face Yuan and spoke with a resolute face, "Then I will also agree to become your servant—at least for as long as we are there."
"Angela?!" Helena's eyes widened with surprise.
Angela shrugged and explained her decision, "It's not like we are going to be his servants for real, and it will only last until we leave. It will be over by the time we even realize it."
Helena took a moment to digest Angela's reasoning.
After finding it to be quite logical, Helena nodded and said to Yuan, "Just like Angela, I am willing to be your servant for as long as I am there."
"I think you're forgetting about something else," Yuan said.
"We're still..."

Angela had to think for a second before realizing what Yuan wanted from them and spoke out loud, "I swear on my soul that I won't purposefully kill anyone, and I will try to avoid causing trouble as much as possible."
Hearing Angela's words, Helena quickly repeated the same words.
"Alright." Yuan nodded in acknowledgment.
The next moment, he began drawing his blood, creating three watermelon-sized spheres and hovered them before the Transcendents.
Angela and Helena hesitated at first, but when they saw Selena drinking all of it without hesitation, they exchanged glances with each other before following suit.

"My world was invaded by Forsaken in the past, bringing unimaginable terror with them.
Things are far better now after I wiped out most of them, but some still remain."
He then looked at Selena and continued, "You may visit my world, but while you're there, you must eliminate every last Forsaken.
How does that sound?"
"Deal!" Selena agreed to his request almost instantly.
"Ah, what about them?"
Her gaze pointed at Angela and Helena.
"I will be frank with you," Yuan spoke.
"I do not trust them one bit."
"Wha—"
Angela and Helena's jaw dropped at his words.
But Yuan wasn't finished speaking, and he continued, "Not only do they clearly have bad tempers, but they are the type that believes violence solves everything."
"How could I sleep peacefully knowing that not just one, but two of them are loose in the world?
"Bastard!
You're treating us like rabid dogs!" Helena shouted while pointing at him.
"If you're going to treat us like that, I will bite you like one!" Angela stomped her feet angrily.
"You see what I mean?" Yuan sighed as he shook his head.
Selena gazed at the two with a disappointed yet understanding gaze.
"As much as I appreciate you trusting me, I cannot leave them behind and explore alone, so unless you trust all of us, I will stay here with them."
"Selena..."
They looked at her with softened expressions, appearing as though they were on the verge of tears.
After a moment of silence, Angela turned to face Yuan and spoke with a resolute face, "Then I will also agree to become your servant—at least for as long as we are there."
"Angela?!" Helena's eyes widened with surprise.
Angela shrugged and explained her decision, "It's not like we are going to be his servants for real, and it will only last until we leave.
It will be over by the time we even realize it."
Helena took a moment to digest Angela's reasoning.
After finding it to be quite logical, Helena nodded and said to Yuan, "Just like Angela, I am willing to be your servant for as long as I am there."
"I think you're forgetting about something else," Yuan said.
"We're still..."

Angela had to think for a second before realizing what Yuan wanted from them and spoke out loud, "I swear on my soul that I won't purposefully kill anyone, and I will try to avoid causing trouble as much as possible."
Hearing Angela's words, Helena quickly repeated the same words.
"Alright." Yuan nodded in acknowledgment.
The next moment, he began drawing his blood, creating three watermelon-sized spheres and hovered them before the Transcendents.
Angela and Helena hesitated at first, but when they saw Selena drinking all of it without hesitation, they exchanged glances with each other before following suit.

chapters.title: Chapter 2471 Demon Slaying Parade(4)
paragraphs: <Selena has accepted your blood>
<You have turned 'Selena' into a Demonic Servant>

'So they are still considered a Demonic Servant, huh?' Yuan thought inwardly after seeing the notification, wondering if everyone in the Demonic Realm was classified as one, regardless if they are a Transcendent or not.
<Angela has accepted your blood>
<You have turned 'Angela' into a Demonic Servant>
<Helena has accepted your blood>
<You have turned 'Helena into a Demonic Servant>
"Satisfied now, you pervert?" Angela suddenly remarked.
Yuan looked at her with a raised eyebrow, looking stunned by her random comment.
"Ahem." He cleared his throat before asking them, "When do you plan on visiting my world?"
Selena turned to the others and asked, "What do you two think?"
"I will let you decide," Helena said.
"If I have to be honest, I am more interested in his human world than our own," Angela said.
Selena nodded, "I agree, so let's save the best for last."
Yuan then said, "I still have a couple of years left here, but I doubt that will be enough for you."
"If I have to be honest, besides the Crimson Continent, there isn't much to explore. I know Death Paradise like the back of my hands, and the Bone Atolls are mostly water."
'Exploring the Crimson Continent?' Supreme Ruler Grant swallowed nervously at her words.
Yuan then said, "It'll be easier if you follow me now because once I leave and return to my world, I intend on sealing the gateway again.
"Why don't you just leave it open? If you're worried that demons might invade your world, we can make it so that nobody beside us can approach this place," Selena said.

"Um... this is the Bloody Monastery, where we honor our Supreme—" The Supreme Adviser opened his mouth to speak but hastily shut his mouth after hearing Supreme Ruler Grant's voice echo inside his head.
"Shut the hell up, you imbecile! Do you know who they are?! If we offend them, the Bloody Monastery being destroyed will be the least of our worries!"
Fortunately for them, the Transcedents didn't even spare a glance for the Supreme Adviser, treating him as if he were invisible.

"I am not just worried about demons invading my world," Yuan shook his head. "I also don't want my people to accidentally visit this world—at least not until we clean up all of the Forsaken in my world and explain the truth to them, which will take some time."

Selena pondered for a moment before responding, "In that case, I will go with you now and help you clean up the trash to speed things up. In the meantime, I will explore this place as much as possible."
"No rush."
Selena and the others left shortly later while Yuan continued working on the seal.
Meanwhile, two years later—or two days in the Nine Heavens, the Demon Slaying Parade officially began.

A Demon Sealer appeared on the platform before hundreds of thousands of spectators and announced, "The Demon Sealing Clan welcomes everyone gathered here today. Before we begin the Demon Slaying Parade, we will briefly explain its purpose and offer some insight for those unfamiliar with the details."

He continued, "The Demon Slaying Parade was created after our founder, the Divine Paragon, suddenly vanished. In the past, Demon Sealers would fight one another for his position, and the event was established to make the process less violent and ensure that only those truly qualified could become leaders."

"During the Demon Slaying Parade, the participants—the current leader of the Demon Sealing Clan and the challenger—are given one week to seal as many demons as possible. In order for the challenger to become the next leader, they must seal more demons than the current leader."
"The current leader of the Demon Sealing Clan is Qian Chu, who..."

The Demon Sealer then went on to recount some of Qian Chu's background and accomplishments for the spectators. "The one challenging Leader Qian for his position is Master Demon Sealer Yan Hara, who..." He proceeded to list a few of Yan Hara's deeds as well, but as one of Qian Chu's supporters, he presented them in a way that made it seem as though she had accomplished very little.
Shortly afterward, Qian Chu stepped onto the stage to a wave of applause. Yan Hara appeared soon after, only to be met with loud boos from the crowd.
"Yan Hara, stop messing around and do your job properly!
"While you are trying to usurp a position you don't qualify for, the demon worshippers are running amok!"
"You have already failed to become a Supreme Demon Sealer, so what makes you think you can become the leader?!"
Some of the spectators even started cursing at her.
"Ignore these ignorant bastards, Senior Yan!"
"You got this, Yan Hara!"
"Take down that fraud, Qian Chu!"
"Show them the prowess of Divine Paragon's successor!"
Of course, there were also some who supported her.
"What did you just say? Divine Paragon's successor?"
When those who were unaware of her identity inquired about it.

"That's right! The Divine Paragon was the founder of the Demon Sealing Clan and the very reason we aren't living as slaves to demons today! Senior Yan is his rightful successor!" her supporters exclaimed.
"How is that possible? I thought the Divine Paragon vanished without a successor during the Demonic Era."
"Senior Yan found his legacy, recovering his lost techniques."
"Just because she found his legacy doesn't mean she's a legitimate successor."
"Except the Divine Paragon himself left behind a record stating that whoever finds his legacy first will become his successor."
While the audience argued back and forth, Yan Hara and Qian Chu stood before a portal that would lead them to the battlefield.
"I hope you're ready to lose, Yan Hara. You, who is neither in the God Ascension Realm nor a Supreme Demon Sealer, will never win against me!"

Yan Hara coldly sneered, "When it comes to dealing with demons, it's our Demon Sealing Aura and techniques that truly matter. I will show you the prowess of the Divine Paragon's techniques, so you better keep your eyes open, you traitor."
