chapters.title: Chapter 2472 The Demon Slaying Parade Begins!
paragraphs: "The Divine Paragon's techniques? Oh, right. I never thanked you for retrieving them," Qian Chu spoke with a cold smile. "Thanks to you, I will be able to enjoy them after this."
"Speaking as if you've already won, huh?" Yan Hara shook her head.
After a brief moment of silence, a mysterious smile tugged at Yan Hara's lips before she spoke, "Oh, right... I heard that you're neither human nor a demon."
The smile on Qian Chu's face instantly faded at her words, replaced by a deep frown.
"Where... and whom did you hear that from?" he muttered in an enraged voice.
Even though she'd deliberately provoked him, Yan Hara was taken aback by Qian Chu's reaction.

She had never seen him so furious before. His face twisted so violently with rage it looked as though he were watching his entire family being slaughtered before his eyes—as if Yan Hara had just touched his reverse scale.

But rather than answering Qian Chu's question, Yan Hara pressed further," Seeing your reaction, I guess that information was genuine. If you're neither human nor demon, just exactly what are you? An artificial demon? A doll? A golem? A zombie? A—"

"SHUT THE HELL UP!" Qian Chu roared, his voice rippling through the entire arena. His outburst was so sudden and loud that it instantly silenced the crowd, and everyone turned to stare at him with dumbfounded faces.
For a brief moment, the entire arena fell so silent that even a whisper could have been heard from miles away.

Many moments passed, but Qian Chu didn't say another word, much less explain his outburst. Once it became clear he had no intention of doing so, the crowd pretended it had never happened and resumed talking—only in noticeably quieter tones. In fact, everyone was essentially whispering now, mistakenly assuming Qian Chu had been irritated by their earlier noise.
As for Yan Hara, she let the matter drop and stayed quiet until the Demon Slaying Parade began a few minutes later. Though an amused smile lingered on her face the entire time.
Eventually, the announcer declared, "Thank you all for your patience! The Demon Slaying Parade will now officially begin! The one-week will start once the participants enter the battlefield!
Without another word, Qian Chu moved first, stepping into the portal.

Yan Hara took a deep breath and followed. When she emerged on the other side, she found herself in a familiar place—the Demons' Valley, also known as the Valley of Demons, a site the Demon Sealing Clan often used for examinations and training.
Yan Hara looked around, but Qian Chu, who had entered just seconds earlier, was nowhere to be seen.
But she wasn't surprised, as she knew in advance that they would be separated from the start.
After taking a few seconds to examine her surroundings with divine sense, Yan Hara wasted no time and immediately chased after the nearest demon.

Of course, the demons used for the event weren't real, but artificial demons. However, that didn't mean Yan Hara could relax either, as these artificial demons were created specifically for the Demon Slaying Parade and had been tuned to their maximum difficulty.
Barely five minutes after the Demon Slaying Parade began, Yan Hara encountered her first demon and started on sealing it.
"Looks like Yan Hara has encountered her first demon—a Lower Demon!" The announcer spoke with enthusiasm for the spectators.

"There are a total of one hundred and one demons dwelling within the Valley of Demons, but not all of them are equal! There are seventy Lower Demons, twenty Elite Demons, seven Superior Demons, three Demon Generals, and a single Demon Emperor!"

"There are five different ranks of demons, and each of them grants a variety of points! Lower Demons grant one point, Elite Demons grant three points, Superior Demons grant ten points, Demon Generals grant twenty points, and last but not least—two hundred points for the Demon Emperor!"

"There are two strategies to the Demon Slaying Parade! The participants can either farm all of the weaker demons and slowly amass points, or go straight for the strongest ones for the most points! Of course, if one has the capability, then it would be wiser to go for the latter strategy!"
"Oh! Looks like the Clan Leader is going for the second strategy as he completely ignores the Lower Demons and goes straight for the Superior Demon!"
Half an hour later—

"The Clan Leader has finally caught up to the Superior Demon and begun sealing it, but in the meantime, Yan Hara has already hunted seven Lower Demons and in the middle of fighting her eighth! And it's even an Elite Demon!

"Good lord, look how fast that woman is sealing those demons! Is it really as easy as she makes it seem?" The spectators were left in awe by Yan Hara's swift hunting, only needing two to three strikes before completely sealing the demons.

"Of course it's not as easy as it seems! Even a Supreme Demon Sealer would need a dozen strikes to seal a Lower Demon! And the demons are all at the first level of God Ascension while she's a mere Immortal, so she's at a disadvantage!"
"Are the techniques she's using the Divine Paragon's lost techniques?"
"Of course not! She's not even using any demon sealing techniques and merely using her demon sealing aura to seal the demons!"
"What's the difference?"
"Using demon sealing techniques will make one's demon sealing aura stronger while being more efficient. It works exactly like spiritual energy and martial techniques."
The Demon Sealers among the spectators took the opportunity to educate the uninformed audience—while subtly boasting about their own practices and expertise.
"At this pace, I doubt they will need an entire week to seal all of the demons," one of the spectators remarked.
"I would be surprised if they manage to kill even half of them in a week," said a Master Demon Sealer.

"The higher-ranking demons will not only take much more effort but time to seal. Look at the Clan Leader for example. He's been fighting the Superior Demon for nearly an hour now, yet he still hasn't managed to seal it."
"Is that so..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2473 Two Seals Remaining
paragraphs: "What do you think, disciple? Is it up to your expectations?" Keling, who was sitting in the crowd with Meixiu, asked her.
Meixiu responded, her gaze focused on Yan Hara, "I think they are still underestimating Yan Hara's prowess."
"Really? How can you tell?" "From experience," she spoke with a dazzling smile that instantly attracted multiple gazes from nearby.
"I know someone who is an expert, and Yan Hara is giving me similar vibes."
"An expert? You mean that one guy named Yuan?" Keling muttered with a raised eyebrow.
"How do you know? I never mentioned that he was a Demon Sealer," Meixiu remarked with slightly widened eyes.
Keling rubbed her eyes and sighed aloud, "My dear disciple, for the last several years, whenever you mention someone, it's mostly this Yuan fellow."
Meixiu blushed at her words and fell silent.

Keling continued, her voice tinged with intrigue, "My useless brother also mentions him a lot. I cannot wait to meet him myself to see just what the hype is about. When do you think I will be able to see him?"
"Hard to say... he's got a lot on his plate."
"Hmph. I bet that's just an excuse. If I had a boyfriend, I would visit him as much as possible." Keling spoke with her large, muscular arms crossed in front of her chest.
"You should just find a new partner, disciple—someone who will truly value you. I bet I can easily find a dozen just from this crowd alone."
Meixiu shook her head and calmly said, "He is the only one for me, even if I had to wait another lifetime for him."
"Haaaa..." Keling sighed again, heavier this time. "I'm jealous. Truly jealous. If only I could find a boyfriend who cares about me as much as you care about him.
Suddenly, Keling noticed someone speaking to Meixiu using voice transmission and intercepted it.
"Excuse me for bothering you, but I cannot help but—"
"Scram, you damn toad! My disciple is too good for you! And she's already taken!" Keling interrupted before shooting them away.

The voice immediately stopped, but that did not stop others from trying to speak with Meixiu. "Just ignore them," Meixiu calmly said, as if she was used to it. "I have already put up a barrier, so their voices won't even reach me."
Meanwhile, the Demon Slaying Parade continued.

"After just two hours, the Clan Leader has finally sealed the Superior Demon! As expected of Leader Qian—only he could accomplish it so quickly! Normally, it would take a dozen Master Demon Sealers several days to seal one!" The announcer continued to glaze Qian Chu without shame.
"Meanwhile, Yan Hara has moved onto her 20th Lower Demon! Although she has more points than the Clan Leader at this moment, what will she do once she runs out of weak demons to earn points?!"
Of course, the announcer didn't forget to subtly mock Yan Hara.
"Haha! She's only going for the weakest demons! I wouldn't want someone so cowardly to be the Clan Leader!"
"What a coward! It was impressive at first, but she's clearly nowhere near the Clan Leader's level!"
The crowd began mocking Yan Hara out loud.

"Who dares to badmouth Senior Yan?! So what if she's going for the easier points first?! This is a legitimate strategy!" Her supporters immediately shot back with their own rebuttals. With the two groups clashing, it didn't take long for fights to break out in the audience—though each scuffle was quickly quelled and ended almost as soon as it began.
"Is she really purposefully just going for the weakest demons?" Meixiu mumbled in a puzzling voice.
"What do you mean?" Keling asked with a puzzled face. "It might just be my imagination, but she looks a bit irritated to me," Meixiu explained.
"Is that so...?" Keling focused on Yan Hara's face.
"Looks normal to me. Isn't that how we all look when we're seriously focused on something?" she commented a moment later.

Meanwhile, within the Valley of Demons, Yan Hara was silently cursing. 'I knew these sons of bitches would play dirty! They actually dumped me in the area with the highest number of Lower Demons! Aside from that one Elite Demon, I haven't seen a single demon that isn't a Lower Demon!'

It wasn't that Yan Hara was purposefully hunting Lower Demons. In reality, there were only Lower Demons in her vicinity. Of course, she could have ignored them and searched for higher-ranking demons, but with plenty of time remaining—and these being easy points—she decided she might as well wipe out all the Lower Demons first.
Unbeknownst to Yan Hara, they hadn't just thrown her into the area with the most Lower Demons, and they had actually concentrated nearly all of them there. But she would soon come to realize this.

The first day of the Demon Slaying Parade passed in a blur. Yan Hara had hunted thirty Lower Demons and eight Elite Demons, earning fifty-four points. Qian Chu, meanwhile, had hunted three Superior Demons, four Elite Demons, and four Lower Demons, for a total of forty-six points—slightly behind Yan Hara.
Although they encountered demons quite fast in the beginning, it quickly slowed down.

Meanwhile, an entire year had passed in the Demonic Realm, and Yuan had made significant progress on the seal. In just a year, he had broken another seal, leaving only two remaining before the gateway's seal would be fully removed and the Nine Heavens and Demonic Realm reconnected.
"Heavens! Another has broken!"
"There's no way it'll hold until the end of the Demon Slaying Parade!" "We can only hope it holds out until some Demon Sealers arrive at least..."
The guards, who had done nothing but stare at the seal with bated breath, felt their hearts lurch the instant another layer shattered.
A few hours later, they finally breathed a sigh of relief as Demon Sealers began arriving at the scene.
However, that relief quickly vanished when every Demon Sealer who appeared wore an expression of sheer terror at the situation.

sentences.text: "What do you think, disciple?
Is it up to your expectations?" Keling, who was sitting in the crowd with Meixiu, asked her.
Meixiu responded, her gaze focused on Yan Hara, "I think they are still underestimating Yan Hara's prowess."
"Really?
How can you tell?" "From experience," she spoke with a dazzling smile that instantly attracted multiple gazes from nearby.
"I know someone who is an expert, and Yan Hara is giving me similar vibes."
"An expert?
You mean that one guy named Yuan?" Keling muttered with a raised eyebrow.
"How do you know?
I never mentioned that he was a Demon Sealer," Meixiu remarked with slightly widened eyes.
Keling rubbed her eyes and sighed aloud, "My dear disciple, for the last several years, whenever you mention someone, it's mostly this Yuan fellow."
Meixiu blushed at her words and fell silent.
Keling continued, her voice tinged with intrigue, "My useless brother also mentions him a lot.
I cannot wait to meet him myself to see just what the hype is about.
When do you think I will be able to see him?"
"Hard to say... he's got a lot on his plate."
"Hmph.
I bet that's just an excuse.
If I had a boyfriend, I would visit him as much as possible." Keling spoke with her large, muscular arms crossed in front of her chest.
"You should just find a new partner, disciple—someone who will truly value you.
I bet I can easily find a dozen just from this crowd alone."
Meixiu shook her head and calmly said, "He is the only one for me, even if I had to wait another lifetime for him."
"Haaaa..." Keling sighed again, heavier this time.
"I'm jealous.
Truly jealous.
If only I could find a boyfriend who cares about me as much as you care about him.
Suddenly, Keling noticed someone speaking to Meixiu using voice transmission and intercepted it.
"Excuse me for bothering you, but I cannot help but—"
"Scram, you damn toad!
My disciple is too good for you!
And she's already taken!" Keling interrupted before shooting them away.
The voice immediately stopped, but that did not stop others from trying to speak with Meixiu.
"Just ignore them," Meixiu calmly said, as if she was used to it.
"I have already put up a barrier, so their voices won't even reach me."
Meanwhile, the Demon Slaying Parade continued.
"After just two hours, the Clan Leader has finally sealed the Superior Demon!
As expected of Leader Qian—only he could accomplish it so quickly!
Normally, it would take a dozen Master Demon Sealers several days to seal one!" The announcer continued to glaze Qian Chu without shame.
"Meanwhile, Yan Hara has moved onto her 20th Lower Demon!
Although she has more points than the Clan Leader at this moment, what will she do once she runs out of weak demons to earn points?!"
Of course, the announcer didn't forget to subtly mock Yan Hara.
"Haha!
She's only going for the weakest demons!
I wouldn't want someone so cowardly to be the Clan Leader!"
"What a coward!
It was impressive at first, but she's clearly nowhere near the Clan Leader's level!"
The crowd began mocking Yan Hara out loud.
"Who dares to badmouth Senior Yan?!
So what if she's going for the easier points first?!
This is a legitimate strategy!" Her supporters immediately shot back with their own rebuttals.
With the two groups clashing, it didn't take long for fights to break out in the audience—though each scuffle was quickly quelled and ended almost as soon as it began.
"Is she really purposefully just going for the weakest demons?" Meixiu mumbled in a puzzling voice.
"What do you mean?" Keling asked with a puzzled face.
"It might just be my imagination, but she looks a bit irritated to me," Meixiu explained.
"Is that so...?" Keling focused on Yan Hara's face.
"Looks normal to me.
Isn't that how we all look when we're seriously focused on something?" she commented a moment later.
Meanwhile, within the Valley of Demons, Yan Hara was silently cursing. 'I knew these sons of bitches would play dirty!
They actually dumped me in the area with the highest number of Lower Demons!
Aside from that one Elite Demon, I haven't seen a single demon that isn't a Lower Demon!'
It wasn't that Yan Hara was purposefully hunting Lower Demons.
In reality, there were only Lower Demons in her vicinity.

Of course, she could have ignored them and searched for higher-ranking demons, but with plenty of time remaining—and these being easy points—she decided she might as well wipe out all the Lower Demons first.
Unbeknownst to Yan Hara, they hadn't just thrown her into the area with the most Lower Demons, and they had actually concentrated nearly all of them there.
But she would soon come to realize this.
The first day of the Demon Slaying Parade passed in a blur.
Yan Hara had hunted thirty Lower Demons and eight Elite Demons, earning fifty-four points.
Qian Chu, meanwhile, had hunted three Superior Demons, four Elite Demons, and four Lower Demons, for a total of forty-six points—slightly behind Yan Hara.
Although they encountered demons quite fast in the beginning, it quickly slowed down.
Meanwhile, an entire year had passed in the Demonic Realm, and Yuan had made significant progress on the seal.
In just a year, he had broken another seal, leaving only two remaining before the gateway's seal would be fully removed and the Nine Heavens and Demonic Realm reconnected.
"Heavens!
Another has broken!"
"There's no way it'll hold until the end of the Demon Slaying Parade!" "We can only hope it holds out until some Demon Sealers arrive at least..."
The guards, who had done nothing but stare at the seal with bated breath, felt their hearts lurch the instant another layer shattered.
A few hours later, they finally breathed a sigh of relief as Demon Sealers began arriving at the scene.
However, that relief quickly vanished when every Demon Sealer who appeared wore an expression of sheer terror at the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2474 The Final Seal to the Demonic Realm
paragraphs: "W-What the hell is this?! Why are there only two seals left?!" The first Demon Sealer to the scene exclaimed in shock after seeing the situation.
"There should be nine! Nine!! What the hell happened here?!"
The Demon Sealer's first suspicion fell upon the guards. After all, for seven seals to suddenly vanish without a trace this quickly was simply impossible unless someone had tampered with them.
"Tell me the truth! Are you imbeciles responsible for this?!" The Demon Sealer pointed at the guards and shouted.
"What kind of nonsense is that?!" The guards exclaimed, looking absolutely bewildered by the Demon Sealer's random accusation.
"If we were responsible, why the hell would we even report it?!" They started defending themselves with logical takes.
"Moreover, none of us could even get through the barrier to reach the seals!"
"You've gone too far with that baseless accusation, Demon Sealer!" After hearing their words, the Demon Sealer realized his mistake and quickly apologized, "I'm sorry for jumping to conclusions."

"That was more than just jumping to conclusions! You were being straight delusional!" "Enough of this. I only care about one thing right now—whether you can fix the seals or not," one of the guards asked the Demon Sealer, who immediately wore a dumbfounded look on his face.
"Me? Fix the seals?" The Demon Sealer pointed at himself and repeated out loud in a dazed voice.
"If you cannot even fix it, why are you here?" asked another guard.
"To hold off the demons until we receive help—if they come!" The Demon Sealer said in a terrified voice.
"What?! So we're really just going to let the demons return and invade our world again?!"
"There must be something we can do!"
The Demon Sealer shook his head and said, "Unfortunately, only the Divine Paragon can seal the Demonic Realm, and he's long gone."
"Why does it have to be the Divine Paragon? There are plenty of powerful Array Masters out there who are capable of sealing things," asked one of the guards.

"Do you really think you're the first one to think of that? We've had multiple level 9 Array Masters try, but not a single one of them could keep the Demonic Realm sealed for longer than half a day! Meanwhile, the Divine Paragon's seal has remained intact for multiple eras!" The Demon Sealer explained in a loud voice, sounding offended.
"T-The seal! It's starting to shatter again!" One of the guards suddenly shouted.
"What?!"
The Demon Sealer snapped his head to look at the seals, and sure enough, one of the two remaining seals had begun to crack.
"Damn it! The situation is far worse than I was told!" he gritted his teeth as he retrieved a communication jade slip before talking into it.

"We need all of the Demon Sealers in the Seventh Heaven to make their way to the entrance to the Demonic Realm as soon as possible! There are only two seals remaining, and one of them is breaking as I am speaking!"
"Tell the guys at the Demon Sealing Grotto to come as well! This isn't the time to fight amongst ourselves! If the Demonic Realm is unsealed, we're looking at another war with the demons!"

Once the Demon Sealers understood how dire their situation truly was, every single one of them within the Seventh Heaven dropped whatever they were doing and headed over to the Demonic Realm's entrance.
Of course, this included those spectating the Demon Slaying Parade.
"What's going on? Why are so many of them suddenly leaving? Are they already bored?"

The Demon Sealers' sudden, mass departure immediately drew the crowd's curiosity, not to mention all of them had deep frowns on their faces as they left. This caused many to wonder if something had happened that required their urgent attention.
"I bet it's the demon worshippers again. They've been so active lately.
"Hey, where are you going? Did something happen?" Someone decided to ask, but they were completely ignored. "Rude bastards."
Although they were curious, they soon put it out of their minds and turned their attention back to the Demon Slaying Parade.
The second day of the Demon Slaying Parade came to end in the blink of an eye.

"Once again, Yan Hara has decided to completely ignore the higher-ranking demons in favor of hunting the Lower Demons for easy points! However, she won't be able to keep up with this tactic once they are all gone and only the high-ranking demons remain!" The announcer said out loud, his voice laced with open disdain.
Meanwhile, Yan Hara finally realized the situation.
'These dirty, foul bastards! If you're going to cheat, at least make it less obvious! To think they'd try and waste my time like this!"

Although Yan Hara was annoyed by Qian Chu's antics, she wasn't worried in the slightest—in fact, she felt excited. 'I can't wait to see their faces when I win even with all their cheating,' she laughed inwardly as she continued sealing demons at a remarkable pace.
As the second day came to an end, so did one of the last two seals to the Demonic Realm.
"O-One! There is only one seal remaining!" One of the guards started screaming in terror.
"Shut the hell up! We can see that!" The Demon Sealer angrily shouted.
"Screw this!" Another guard suddenly shouted, "I didn't sign up to fight demons! I quit!" Without another word, he flew away, disappearing from the others' sight.
Once the first guard ran away, the others quickly followed, and in the blink of an eye, only the Demon Sealer remained at the site.
"These cowardly bastards..."
Although the Demon Sealer was angry at the guards for running away, he also understood their feelings, as the urge to flee was gnawing at him as well.

"I didn't become a Demon Sealer just to run from demons! Besides... if they invade our world again, it won't matter where we flee, as nowhere will be safe!" The Demon Sealer clenched his fists so hard that blood began to drip from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 2475 The Full Unsealing of the Demonic Realm
paragraphs: "What's the situation here?!"
The Demon Sealers that appeared shortly later asked.
"As you can see for yourselves, there is only one seal remaining, and even that has begun to crack," explained the one who arrived first.
"What?! One seal?! I was told there were two seals!" One of them exclaimed in shock.
"There was. Now there is one. That's just how dire the situation is."
"What should we do?"
"What is there to do but brace ourselves for the worst?"
"To think we will have to fight demons on a wide scale again..."
"At least the world isn't as weak as it was during our first war with demons."

"And do you think the demons have just been sitting around all this time? There's a good chance they've been cultivating in seclusion, waiting for the day the seal finally breaks!" one of them sighed aloud.

"How many demons could possibly remain? If I remember correctly, the Demonic Realm was originally created by the first demon as a hideout. I'd wager most of them were already eradicated by the Divine Paragon long ago."
It was still common knowledge that the Red Tyrant had created the Demonic Realm in the Nine Heavens, but that belief was merely an ancient assumption.
Very few people knew the actual truth—that the Demonic Realm was not created at all, but was an entirely separate world where demons had originally come from.
"Demons are incapable of procreation, right?"
"I have never heard or seen a demon child before, so..."
Unbeknownst to them, that claim was only half true. While demons were indeed capable of reproducing, such a thing only applied to those who had not yet become Forsaken.
And since only the Forsaken had ever invaded the Nine Heavens, it wasn't strange that no one had ever seen a demon child before.
"Heavens!" Someone suddenly shouted. "The last seal is breaking!"
"What?!"

Everyone turned toward the entrance to the Demonic Realm. Although they had long expected the seal to eventually break, none of them had anticipated it happening so soon, as not even half a day had passed since the last one broke.
"Is everyone here yet?! Is this every Demon Sealer in the Seventh Heaven?!"
The Demon Sealers hastily gathered in front of the entrance to the Demonic Realm, preparing to fight at any moment.
However, while the Demon Sealers' attention remained fixed on the seal, numerous silhouettes silently closed in from the distance, gradually surrounding them without their knowledge.
By the time someone noticed their presence, it was already too late.
"D-DEMONS! DEMONS ARE HERE!"
The Demon Sealer who noticed their presence alerted the others.
"What?!"
The Demon Sealers quickly spread their divine sense to see hundreds—if not thousands of demons surrounding them.
"W-What the hell?! Why are there so many demons?!"
"Where the hell did they come from?!"

"Hahaha! Look over there! The intel was right—the seal to the Demonic Realm really is on the verge of breaking!" Meanwhile, the demons were jumping for joy at the sight of the failing seals. Not only were they fully aware of the situation, someone had clearly informed them in advance. Yet the only ones who should have known about the weakening seals were the Demon Sealing Clan, the Demon Sealing Grotto, and the guards who had fled. "Someone tipped the demons off about the seals!"
"Damn it! Which bastard did this?!"
"Whoever informed them betrayed all of humanity!" The Demon Sealers quickly grasped the situation and exploded with rage.
"Kill them all and open the seal to the Demonic Realm! We're finally going home!"
The demons didn't waste any time and began attacking the Demon Sealers shortly after their arrival.
Not only did the demons outnumber the Demon Sealers, but they were also all in the Immortal Realm with a few God Ascension sprinkled within.
In the blink of an eye, the area turned into a battlefield. "Instead of killing them, we should turn them into livestock!"
"There's no need for livestock! Once the Demonic Realm is opened, we'll dominate this world again! There will be no shortage of food, and we'll be able to feast as much as we want!"
There were just over three hundred Demon Sealers at the site, but they were falling at a terrifying pace. Within minutes, nearly half had been killed or devoured by the thousands of demons.
Suddenly, the final seal to the Demonic Realm shuddered—then shattered into countless fragments that dissolved into the air.
A powerful ripple swept across the battlefield, briefly halting the demons' slaughter as it drew all of their attention.

However, even though all of the seals were gone, there was still a powerful barrier that prevented others from approaching the entrance itself. Without a word, one of the demons abruptly attacked the barrier, throwing its full strength against it—only for the barrier to remain utterly unmoved. Seeing this, the others followed suit, hurling their attacks at it with all their might.
Gradually, fine cracks began to spread across its surface.
The Demon Sealers desperately wanted to stop them, but they could do nothing except watch, as every ounce of their strength was already spent just trying to stay alive.
Eventually, the barrier shattered, revealing an open, unobstructed path to the Demonic Realm. "Home! I can finally go home!" the demons cried as they surged toward the entrance.

Hundreds of demons swarmed toward the entrance, but they all froze as a human hand suddenly emerged from within, clamping around the throat of the foremost demon, just a single step away from crossing over.
The demon being choked instinctively clawed at the hand around its neck, but no matter how much strength it used to break free, the human hand remained unmoving.
At the same time, the hand slowly emerged from the entrance, revealing an arm, then a shoulder. Eventually, a human figure stepped out of the portal, his expression perfectly calm.

"Y-You are—!" The demons' eyes widened in shock and disbelief when they saw his familiar face. No matter how many years had passed, none of them could ever forget the terror one man had once inflicted on them all.
After a brief, stunned silence, a piercing shriek of terror tore through the air.
"D-Divine Paragon?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2476 The Divine Paragon's Resurrection
paragraphs: After leaving the Demonic Realm and returning to the Nine Heavens, Yuan swept the scene with a calm gaze.
"Huh..." he muttered before speaking out loud.
"I wasn't expecting such a magnificent crowd to welcome my return. Did you stinking fiends really miss me that much?"
"D-Divine Paragon?! Are you really the Divine Paragon?! I thought you were dead!" One of the demons there suddenly cried, his voice trembling with fear and disbelief.
A cold smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he responded, "I guess life must have been quite comfortable for you bastards to have forgotten about this handsome face of mine."
The demon in Yuan's grasp suddenly turned into a stone statue.
"Listen carefully, you cockroaches." Yuan began speaking again, his voice cold and deliberate.
"I, the Divine Paragon, have returned!"
Then, he tightened his grasp that was choking the sealed demon, shattering it into countless pieces.
After a brief moment of silence, the demons snapped out of their daze and, without hesitation, turned to flee as if their lives depended on it, their faces twisted with absolute terror.
"Where do you think you're going?! Didn't you come here for me?!"
<Demon Sealing Zone!>
In an instant, a massive barrier was erected around them, imprisoning all of the demons before they could escape.
However, Yuan didn't completely seal them, merely restricting their movements.
The Demon Sealers stared at Yuan with gawking expressions on their faces, seemingly unable to believe what they were witnessing,
"D-Divine... Paragon...? Is it really you?" one of them finally asked, looking as though he were dreaming. Yuan turned to him in silence.
During the time he was unsealing the Demonic Realm, he had wondered whether the 'Divine Paragon' should truly return after so long—especially when, in reality, that man had already died.
In the end, Yuan decided to resurrect the Divine Paragon, as it would help him achieve his goals with the most efficiency.
'If I want the Demonic Realm and the Nine Heavens to live in harmony in the future, the Divine Paragon must return...' Yuan thought inwardly.

As the pioneer of Demonic Sealing Techniques, the first leader of the Demon Sealing Clan, and the savior of the human race during the Demonic Era, there was nobody more qualified to unite demons and humans than the Divine Paragon.
After a moment of silence, Yuan nodded his head with a gentle smile on his handsome face.
"Sorry it took so long, but I have returned," he said.
Unsure of what to say or how to react to the Divine Paragon's return, the Demon Sealers could only weep in silence, their faces smeared with tears and snot.
Eventually, one of them shouted at the top of his lungs, "The Divine Paragon has returned!"
The others quickly followed.
"The Divine Paragon has returned!"
"The Divine Paragon has returned!!"
"The Divine Paragon has returned!!!"

Suddenly, one of the demons spoke in a puzzled tone, "Why... Why are you coming out of the Demonic Realm?! I thought you sealed it after coming out of the place! So how the hell are you coming out of it now when the seal just broke?!"
It was a valid question, and even the Demon Sealers fell silent to listen to Yuan's explanation.
Yuan closed his eyes, giving the feeling that he was reminiscing about a distant past.
He spoke a few seconds later, "Indeed, I sealed the Demonic Realm. However, after wandering around, I realized that a second entrance existed when I accidentally stumbled upon it."
"Is that why you suddenly vanished and have never been seen since then?!"
"Does this mean you've been in the Demonic Realm this entire time?!
The Demon Sealers asked with dumbfounded faces. Nobody could've ever imagined that the Divine Paragon would disappear to the Demonic Realm after sealing it.

"W-Wait! What about your legacy?! A Demon Sealer by the name of Yan Hara had claimed to have found your legacy! Does this mean she's a fraud?!" One of the Demon Sealers from the Demon Sealing Grotto asked.
Yuan looked at him and asked, "Does one have to be dead to leave behind their legacy?"
"Uh... no?

"After sealing the Demonic Realm, I hid some of my techniques behind just in case something were to happen to me before I could eradicate all of the demons, or if the demons were to return long after I perish. That must have been found by this Yan Hara person," Yuan said, pretending not to know her.
"I see..."
"Your Reverence, what about the Demonic Realm? Now that the seal has been undone, more demons will invade our world soon. We should reseal it as soon as possible."
Yuan nodded, "I was the one who undid the seal in the first place, so I will reseal it soon."
"Anyway, let's go somewhere else to talk. I have a lot of questions about the current state of the world," Yuan then said.
"What about the demons?" asked one of the Demon Sealers.
Yuan snapped his fingers, and every demon trapped within the Demon Sealing Zone instantly turned to stone, then crumbled into dust.
"What demons?" he remarked with a smile after casually eradicating thousands of demons in the blink of an eye, erasing any doubt that he was the Divine Paragon in the process.
The Demon Sealers could only stare in awe, looking like a bunch of children before their idol.
A moment later, Yuan created a temporary barrier around the Demonic Realm before leaving with the Demon Sealers.
Shortly after they left, more figures emerged from the Demonic Realm. It was Lev and the others.
"So this is his world, huh...?" Selena muttered, her eyes flickering with excitement and intrigue.
Helena and Angela also took in their surroundings, wearing the same mix of curiosity and wonder.
"Let's not linger and leave before more people show up," a certain voice spoke, snapping the Transcedents out of their daze.
"Right, but where do we go?" Selena asked.
"Follow me," said the Demon Annihilation Sword, leading five figures away from the entrance after opening a hole in the barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 2477 The Divine Paragon's Resurrection(2)
paragraphs: After departing with the surviving Demon Sealers, Yuan was brought to the headquarters of the Demon Sealing Clan located there.
Throughout the entire journey, the Demon Sealers couldn't stop staring at him.
To them, the Divine Paragon was a legendary figure from the distant past—one of the most important individuals in all of history.
Seeing him with their own eyes was like discovering a priceless treasure thought to have gone extinct long ago.
"He looks just like the statue in the Grand Library..." "Of course he does!"
Inside the headquarters, the Demon Sealers treated Yuan as though he were an emperor himself—personally opening doors for him and even dusting off chairs before he sat down.
"So, how long have I been gone? And how has the world been doing since my disappearance?" Yuan questioned as sipped on the most valuable tea the Demon Sealers had prepared for him.
"Your Reverence, it has been millions of years since your disappearance, and the world has changed quite drastically since your era."

The Demon Sealers proceeded to recount all of the major events that had occurred since the Demonic Era—from the splitting of the Divine Heavens to the countless incidents that had drastically reshaped their world.
"Nine Heavens, huh..." Yuan muttered, pretending to be surprised by the revelation.
"So, how do people travel between the realms these days?" Yuan asked afterward.

"Well..." the Demon Sealers explained, "we used to have something called the Stairway to Heaven, which allowed passage throughout the Nine Heavens. Unfortunately, after certain individuals attacked it, the Stairway vanished without a trace and hasn't reappeared since."
"Does that mean traveling between realms is not possible right now?"

"That is correct for the time being, as nobody but those with flying treasures capable of traveling in the starry sky can leave their realm. However, the Celestial Emperor has recently reassured us that they are working on resolving this issue soon with a new treasure."
"Is that so..."
Although no one knew what had happened to the Stairway to Heaven, Yuan knew exactly where it had gone and how to bring it back.
When he had created the Stairway to Heaven as the God of Creation, he had embedded a defensive mechanism within it.

Whenever the structure came under a sufficiently powerful attack, it would conceal itself and retreat to a hidden location. Minor attacks that couldn't even scratch it would simply be ignored, but anything capable of potentially damaging the Stairway to Heaven would automatically trigger the mechanism.
Not only that, but it would not reappear until its owner deactivated the mechanism, so if Yuan were dead, the Stairway to Heaven would remain gone forever.

One might think someone could stumble upon it by accident, but the Stairway to Heaven possessed another safeguard, and it would immediately relocate itself whenever it sensed a presence other than its master's nearby.
And beyond that, a third mechanism rendered the entire structure completely invisible and undetectable.
If all of these mechanisms were to fail... there would be more of them just in case.
Although this much caution may seem overboard, the Stairway to Heaven wasn't just a treasure meant for traveling the Nine Heavens.
It also functioned as his personal storage, containing countless priceless and even extinct treasures that he'd acquired throughout multiple lifetimes.
"How's the Demon Sealing Clan doing?" Yuan suddenly asked.
An awkward silence quickly filled the room as the members of the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto exchanged uneasy glances with one another.
No one wanted to be the one to tell the Divine Paragon that his Demon Sealing Clan had become disarray—splitting into two factions that were now openly at war with each other.
"What's wrong? Why aren't any of you speaking?" Yuan pressed when nobody responded.
"That's..."
In the end, the Demon Sealers revealed the truth to him, as nobody dared to lie to him, even if the revelation wasn't good and could potentially anger him.

"I see," Yuan murmured, closing his eyes, his expression calm and unreadable. "I can't say I didn't expect it. The Demon Sealing Clan was never an official organization—just something pieced together by a bunch of random people who followed me on their own accord," he said a moment later.
"However, it still saddens me that Demon Sealers are spending more time fighting amongst themselves than demons, defeating their purpose."
Hearing his words, the Demon Sealers there all fell to their knees and apologized in union, "We were wrong! Please punish us as you see fit!"

Yuan shook his head and sighed. "What good would punishing you do now? It'd just be a waste of time and effort. Just stop fooling around and focus on being a Demon Sealer. That said, you might not have to stay a Demon Sealer for much longer, as you'll no longer have a reason to be one."
"By saying that... Do you mean you'll eradicate all of the demons once and for all?" He nodded.
"Yes, I intend on killing every single demon in this world," he declared.
However, he decided not to reveal the truth about the Demonic Realm until he achieved his goal.

The Demon Sealers swallowed nervously at hearing what was essentially their dream. Had anyone else said such words, they wouldn't have believed it so readily, but coming from the Divine Paragon himself, they accepted it without hesitation.
"What are the other Demon Sealers doing right now?" Yuan then asked.
"That's..."
When Yuan mentioned the others, the Demon Sealers immediately realized that they had been so occupied by his presence that they forgot to notify the others of the situation. "T-They are currently..."
They told him about the situation and about the Demon Slaying Parade.
"Demon Slaying Parade?" Yuan muttered this unfamiliar name and inquired for more information, and the Demon Sealers provided the information.
"I see..." He mumbled. "So this Yan Hara—who has received my legacy—is fighting for the Clan Leader's position..."
Yuan suddenly stood up and said, "Let's go."
"Umm... where to...?"
"Where else? I want to take a look at my successor and the current leader of the Demon Sealing Clan!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2478 Yan Hara’s Prowess
paragraphs: At the Demon Slaying Parade, the spectators and the other Demon Sealers continued watching the event without being aware of the Divine Paragon's return, as the Demon Sealers in the Seventh Heaven had forgotten to pass on the information.
Although they eventually realized, Yuan asked them to keep his return a secret so as to not cause a major disturbance, and they all obliged without question.
Meanwhile, the Demon Slaying Parade entered its fourth day of the event. By now, all of the Lower Demons and even Elite Demons have been sealed, leaving only the higher-ranking demons.
Although Yan Hara had the advantage during the first three days, Qian Chu quickly caught up when she couldn't find any demons on the fourth day.
'What is going on?! I cannot find a single demon!' Yan Hara cried inwardly.

While their event field was massive and would take several days of nonstop traveling to cover, the demons shouldn't be so hard to find, especially since the demons were programmed to approach the participants. Yet, in Yan Hara's case, it was more like the demons had been programmed to avoid her!
As for Qian Chu, it was needless to say that he did not have such an issue, and he would encounter demons one after another with barely any down time.
"What's Yan Hara doing?! She's been avoiding demons for half a day now after sealing the Lower and Elite Demons!"
"Is she really avoiding them? It looks like she's trying to find them but is failing to do so in my eyes..."
"She probably doesn't know that all of the weakest demons have been sealed."
"That doesn't make any sense at all. There's no way she'd challenge Qian Chu if that's all she's capable of."
"She would if she's mentally challenged!"
The spectators had split opinions on Yan Hara.
"Qian Chu, you crafty bastard!" Yan Hara suddenly shouted out loud, "I can't believe that you're so terrified of losing that position to me that you'd cheat like this!"
Her voice rippled throughout the Valley of Demons, reaching Qian Chu, who was on the other side.
However, there were no sounds for the displays watched by the spectators, so they were unaware of what she said except for a few that managed to read her lips.

Yet, even knowing what she said, nothing was done, as nobody could prove that she was being genuine or just slandering Qian Chu out of anger. Of course, in order to not make things too obvious, the demons didn't avoid Yan Hara for too long, and near the end of the fourth day, they started appearing for her.
After nearly an entire day of acquiring zero points, Yan Hara was ecstatic when she finally encountered a demon, even if it was just a Superior Demon.
"Die!"
She lunged at it with enthusiasm, unleashing not only her Demon Sealing Aura but, for the first time in the Demon Slaying Parade, a full Demon Sealing Technique.
A terrifying surge of Demon Sealing Aura—nearly triple what she'd shown thus far—erupted from Yan Hara's body, revealing to everyone that she had been holding back this entire time.
"Divine Demon Sealing Strike!"
Sha!

With just a single strike, Yan Hara completely sealed a Superior Demon that had the cultivation of second-level God Ascension, shocking all of the Demon Sealers watching. "Heavens! Did she just seal a Superior Demon with one strike?!"
"That amount of Demon Sealing Aura is far superior than the Clan Leader's! And there's a good chance that she's still hiding more of it!"
Yan Hara's supporters could hardly contain their excitement after witnessing Yan Hara's prowess for the first time.

Many of them initially followed her because of her status as the Divine Paragon's successor, but after seeing her in action for the first time, their support for her became even more resolute and justified.
Meanwhile, all of Qian Chu's followers wore deep, worried frowns on their faces. None of them have anticipated Yan Hara being this powerful.
"Hm? Isn't that a Superior Demon? The same kind that took the Clan Leader two full hours to seal? And she did it in a single strike—faster than when she dealt with the weakest demons?"
When they saw this, the spectators—at least those who weren't paid by Qian Chu's supporters—immediately realized that something was amiss.
After all, Yan Hara had just proved that she could deal with the high-ranking demons as easily as the low-ranking ones, so it made no sense for her to avoid them in the beginning.

Eventually, those who read her lips when she cursed at Qian Chu understood the situation—that Yan Hara never purposely avoided the high-ranking demons and that only low-ranking demons were available for her.
"Unbelievable! Is the Clan Leader really cheating during the Demon Slaying Parade?!"
It didn't take long before Qian Chu became a target for the audience.
"There's no way! I bet it's Yan Hara who's cheating!"
Of course, Qian Chu's supporters fiercely fought back, even if their defenses made no sense.
"How could she be cheating?!"
"She definitely snuck a treasure inside! I bet she won't be able to repeat what she just did!"
Yet, Yan Hara proved them wrong again during her next encounter with a Demon General.
"Demon Sealing Zone!"
"Swords of Eternal Torment!"
Yan Hara unleashed the Divine Paragon's lost techniques for the first time to the public.
Although Yan Hara couldn't seal the Demon General with a single strike, she was able to face it without any trouble, and several minutes later, the Demon General turned into a stone statue.
"Hahaha! Do you see that?! That is the Divine Paragon's true successor!"
After witnessing her overwhelming prowess, her supporters could not contain their excitement and rose to their feet, applauding loudly for her.
Qian Chu's supporters exchanged silent gazes with each other, looking like they'd just fell face-first into a pile of dog shit.
"Looks like we have to do 'that'..." one of them sighed in a low voice.

I bet it's Yan Hara who's cheating!"
Of course, Qian Chu's supporters fiercely fought back, even if their defenses made no sense.
"How could she be cheating?!"
"She definitely snuck a treasure inside!
I bet she won't be able to repeat what she just did!"
Yet, Yan Hara proved them wrong again during her next encounter with a Demon General.
"Demon Sealing Zone!"
"Swords of Eternal Torment!"
Yan Hara unleashed the Divine Paragon's lost techniques for the first time to the public.
Although Yan Hara couldn't seal the Demon General with a single strike, she was able to face it without any trouble, and several minutes later, the Demon General turned into a stone statue.
"Hahaha!
Do you see that?!
That is the Divine Paragon's true successor!"
After witnessing her overwhelming prowess, her supporters could not contain their excitement and rose to their feet, applauding loudly for her.
Qian Chu's supporters exchanged silent gazes with each other, looking like they'd just fell face-first into a pile of dog shit.
"Looks like we have to do 'that'..." one of them sighed in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 2479 Yan Hara's Prowess(2)
paragraphs: "Yan Hara... she's become so powerful that I don't even recognize her anymore..."
The Demon Sealers familiar and close with Yan Hara were stunned speechless by her overwhelming prowess, feeling like they were witnessing the birth of a new legend.
Meanwhile, the public spectators and Qian Chu's supporters were left in awe by the Divine Paragon's techniques.
"So those are the techniques that made the Divine Paragon into the legend that he is, huh?"
"Of course not! The Divine Paragon would still be legendary even if he didn't have any techniques! It was his obsession with slaying demons and his fearless demeanor that truly made him so awesome!"

"Hmph." Someone sneered in disdain before saying, "I think the stories of Divine Paragon were exaggerated and blown way out of proportion. How can a single mortal create Demon Sealing Aura and single-handedly defeat the demons? It makes no sense!"

When the Demon Sealers heard his words that were no different than blasphemy in their ears, they cursed at him, including Qian Chu's supporters, which didn't surprise Yan Hara's supporters in the slightest.
After all, regardless who they supported right now, none of them would be there if it weren't for the Divine Paragon.

Inside the Valley of Demons, Yan Hara continued her domineering display of Divine Paragon's techniques and her fearsome Demon Sealing Aura by sealing every demon with ease, quickly catching up to Qian Chu's points, and by the fifth day, she'd surpassed him again.
However, she would not encounter another demon again until the end of the fifth day. Yet, at the pace she was sealing demons, her points were still in a safe position.
As the sun began to rise on the sixth day, Yan Hara sensed a powerful presence quickly approaching her direction.
"What a powerful presence!" Yan Hara muttered in surprise.
There was no doubt that this presence belonged to the one and only Demon Emperor in the Demon Slaying Parade.
However, Yan Hara wasn't sure what to think of its appearance.
"Did Qian Chu send the Demon Emperor to me because he thinks it would be able to stop me?" she wondered out loud.
"And this presence... why does it feel familiar?
Soon, the Demon Emperor arrived before her.
Yan Hara did not immediately attack and silently observed it with narrowed eyes.
The Demon Emperor did the same, almost as if it were waiting for Yan Hara to act first.
Even without exchanging blows or words, Yan Hara could sense that something about the demon before her was different... unsettlingly so.

Artificial demons, while realistic and capable of radiating intense malice and bloodlust, always felt hollow in some indescribable way. Yet the demon standing before her felt disturbingly alive, as though it were a genuine demon.
'A real Demon Emperor...? No, there's no way...'

Even though Yan Hara believed Qian Chu would stoop to any low to preserve his position, she never imagined he would be capable of commanding a real Demon Emperor, much less smuggling one into the Demon Slaying Parade with so many spectators.
It was almost as if he no longer cared about keeping his image.
"So you are the Divine Paragon's successor, huh? Where is the Divine Paragon right now?" The Demon Emperor suddenly spoke to Yan Hara through voice transmission, startling her.
"W-What are you talking about?" Yan Hara subconsciously responded.
"There's no need to play dumb. I know that the Divine Paragon is still alive," said the Demon Emperor, dumbfounding Yan Hara even more.
"You are..." Yan Hara snapped out of her daze and finally realized why the demon's presence felt so familiar.
"You are the Demon Emperor I fought during the Supreme Demon Sealer's Qualification!" Yan Hara exclaimed in disbelief.
"Oh? You recognize me even though I have changed my appearance? Not bad..." Demon Emperor Carnage remarked with a calm smile.
Soon, the Demon Emperor arrived before her.
"Why are you—" Yan Hara wanted to ask what he was doing there but cut herself off when she realised that she already knew the answer to that question.
"So even a Demon Emperor like you is working for Qian Chu, huh? Makes me even more curious about his true identity!"

"Working for Qian Chu?" Demon Emperor Carnage burst out laughing. "I am a Demon Emperor! I have no need to work for anyone, nor have I ever worked for Qian Chu!" "Then what are you doing here?" Yan Hara frowned.

"I wanted to meet the Divine Paragon's successor and... devour them!" Demon Emperor Carnage said with a cold smile. "Devour me...?" Yan Hara echoed, a similar smile tugging at her lips. "Ever since that disastrous incident, I've wanted to fight you again and erase that humiliation. To think I would get the chance so soon!"
"You may be the Divine Paragon's successor, but you are far from being my match!" Demon Emperor Carnage launched the first strike.
"Rain of Carnage!" "Demon Sealing Zone!"
As Yan Hara and Demon Emperor Carnage began their clash, Qian Chu stopped his hunt and turned to look in their direction.
"So it has started..." he mumbled before returning to his hunt.
Meanwhile, the spectators stirred with renewed excitement, the arena buzzing with hype.
"Looks like Yan Hara has encountered the Demon Emperor! Let's see whether she can deal with it like she did with the others!"
"Once she defeats the Demon Emperor, her victory will be secured, even if Qian Chu seals the remaining demons!"

Shortly later, the Demon Sealers from the Seventh Heaven returned to the venue. "Huh? Why are you guys back already? What happened to the Demonic Realm?" The other Demon Sealers questioned them with puzzled faces.
"Uhh..." The Seventh Heaven's Demon Sealers hesitated for a moment before responding, "The Demonic Realm is secure, so we returned."
"What? How is that possible? Unless you managed to fix the seals, there's no way it's secure! Tell us what really happened!"
"Wait... what happened to the rest of you? And who is that guy with the mask?"
They finally noticed Yuan, who was following them while wearing a mask that concealed his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2480 Too Dangerous to Be Left Alive
paragraphs: When the Demon Sealers pointed at Yuan, the Seventh Heaven's Demon Sealers began sweating profusely, not knowing how to introduce him without sounding suspicious.
However, Yuan completely ignored them and walked away, acting like they weren't together.
"Huh? He wasn't with you guys?"
They silently shook their heads.
"Anyway, what happened to the Demonic Realm and the others?"
After a moment of silence, one of them finally gave in and revealed, "We were ambushed by demons."
"What?!"
"Why would the demons appear now of all times?!"
"I don't know, but it definitely wasn't a coincidence that they attacked at such a crucial time. Someone in the clan must have told them."
"Y-You—! Are you saying that a Demon Sealer has betrayed humanity, being a spy for the demons?! That's a grave accusation!"
"I'm aware, but aside from the Demon Sealers and the Celestial Emperor, no one else even knows about the situation concerning the Demonic Realm. Or are you suggesting that the Celestial Emperor—"

Before he could finish, someone hastily covered his mouth and hissed in a lowered voice, "Bastard! Are you trying to offend the Heavens?! There's no way the Celestial Emperor would ever aid the demons!"
"So what happened afterward?"
"Although we had a lot of casualties, we managed to stop the demons from destroying the seal."
"I see... It's unfortunate that we lost so many Demon Sealers during such a critical period, but you've done well."

The Demon Sealers merely shook their heads and sighed, not even bothering to ask how many demons had appeared. In their eyes, if the Demon Sealers of the Seventh Heaven had been capable of handling the situation, then the number of demons couldn't have been too significant.
Unbeknownst to them, the number of demons that had appeared was in the thousands—a force so overwhelming that even the full strength of the Demon Sealing Clan would have struggled to contain it.
"So what about the Demonic Realm itself? What about the seals?"
They proceeded to ask about the most important subject again.
After a moment of silence, the Demon Sealers of the Seventh Heaven responded, "The seal was fixed."
"Fixed?! By whom?

"Sorry, but we don't know. He appeared out of nowhere, fixed the seal, and then vanished again like a ghost." The Demon Sealers lied without batting an eye, clearly willing to say anything necessary to keep the Divine Paragon's return a secret.
Meanwhile, the other Demon Sealers stood frozen like statues, bewildered expressions on their faces as they struggled to process the nonsense they'd just heard.
Who could possibly fix the seals besides the Divine Paragon? And how reliable were the seals?
"How—"
"OOOOH!"
Suddenly, a loud commotion burst from the spectators' stands behind them, startling everyone present.
Inside the Valley of Demons, after several hundreds of exchanges between Yan Hara and Demon Emperor Carnage, it was clear who had the advantage.
Demon Emperor Carnage looked at his right arm, which had just been sealed, with a deep frown on his face.
"What's wrong, you fiend? I thought you were going to devour me," Yan Hara remarked with a mocking smile on her face.
"I see that I have underestimated you—"
"You won't be able to defeat me," Yan Hara interrupted.
"What was it called? Demon Emperor Nightmare? That demon was much stronger than you."
"Demon Emperor Nightmare?!" Demon Emperor Carnage's eyes widened at this nostalgic name.
"You've fought against Nightmare?! That's impossible! He was sealed by the Divine Paragon ages ago!"
Yan Hara shrugged, not willing to put in the effort to explain.
Demon Emperor Carnage narrowed his eyes.
"I have changed my evaluation of you," he said in a low voice. "Although you're not as ridiculous as the Divine Paragon, you're still too dangerous to be left alive."
He retrieved a crimson-colored marble and crushed it, shattering it into countless fragments.
"What the hell are you...
Yan Hara's body stiffened when she sensed multiple powerful presences suddenly appearing nearby.
One... five... ten...
In the blink of an eye, over a hundred demons surrounded Yan Hara, all of them at least a Superior Demon.
"W-What is happening?! Why are there suddenly so many high-ranking demons?!"
The spectators were left utterly stunned by the sheer number of demons that had appeared—far exceeding what should have existed within the event.

"A trap! It's a trap! Those bastards are trying to kill Senior Yan!" Her supporters shouted in disbelief as they grasped the situation. Without hesitation, they drew their weapons and charged toward the portal leading to the Valley of Demons.
However, Qian Chu's supporters swiftly reacted and blocked their path to the portal.
"Stop! What do you think you're doing?!" "I should be asking you that! Why are you blocking us?!"
Yet, Qian Chu's supporters offered no explanation and continued to block them.
Realizing that the others had no intention of allowing them to assist Yan Hara, her supporters immediately made their move, attacking without hesitation.
Meanwhile, the audience could only watch in stunned bewilderment, utterly unprepared for such an abrupt turn of events.
Before long, the audience began fleeing the venue, afraid that the situation would spiral out of control and drag them into the conflict as well.
"Meixiu, we should leave as well. There's no telling what will happen from here," Keling said to her.
Meixiu remained silent for a moment before giving a small nod. "Let's go."
However, just as she rose to leave with her master, her entire body suddenly stiffened, her gaze locking onto a certain masked figure wearing full black in the crowd.
Although many people there wore masks, something about this individual inexplicably stood out to her.
"Meixiu? What's wrong?" Keling stopped after taking a few steps upon realizing that Meixiu had suddenly frozen in place.
However, Meixiu gave no response, her eyes fixed ahead as though lost in a trance.
Seeing this, Keling followed her line of sight toward the masked individual, who stood there calmly watching Yan Hara on the display with an almost eerie stillness.

chapters.title: Chapter 2481 Masked Figure
paragraphs: Keling narrowed her eyes at Yuan the moment she noticed him—or rather, noticed the lack of presence surrounding him, as though she were staring at a ghost instead of a living person.

'Who the hell is that? Even though I cannot sense his presence, my instincts are screaming at me to not approach him!' Keling swallowed nervously when she realized that she felt fearful toward this individual that she wouldn't have even noticed if it weren't for Meixiu.
Keling was a renowned cultivator, famed for her unshakable will. Those who knew her often claimed she was incapable of fear—that she could face even the most terrifying trials with a smile.
Yet at this very moment, she felt a fear so instinctive and overwhelming that she didn't even dare probe the unknown figure with her divine sense.
"W-We need to leave immediately..." Keling mumbled in a low voice, as if not wanting to attract the masked man's attention.
She grabbed Meixiu's arm and forcefully dragged her away.
"Master, what are you...?" Meixiu muttered in surprise at her odd behavior.
As if reacting to the sound of Meixiu's voice, the masked figure suddenly turned to look in their direction—or more specifically—at Meixiu.
Keling's eyes trembled the moment the masked figure's gaze met hers... or so she thought.
Without the slightest hesitation, she grabbed Meixiu and fled at full speed, her entire body drenched in cold sweat.
However, before they could get far, the masked man suddenly vanished from his spot and appeared directly before them, blocking their path.
'Void Manipulation?!' Keling hastily stopped herself, nearly tripping over in the process.
Then, before they could even exchange a word, Keling withdrew her weapon—a massive bow that was larger than her own tall frame and pointed it at him.
"What do you want from us?!" Keling roared, sounding like a cornered mother desperately trying to protect her helpless daughter.
Despite being an expert at the sixth level of God Ascension while the masked man before her was only at the third level, she felt not the slightest trace of confidence facing him.
On the other hand, Meixiu felt no sense of danger from his presence. If anything, she felt strangely reassured, as though she instinctively knew he would never harm them.
"SPEAK!" Keling demanded in a forceful voice.
"Yuan?"
Meixiu suddenly stepped around Keling and approached the masked man. Even though it had been years since they last met, she would never forget his eyes or how he would look at her with love.
Yuan smiled behind his mask and calmly nodded, "It's me."
"W-Wha—?" Keling's jaw dropped to the ground.
"Yuan!"
Meixiu leapt forward without hesitation, arms wide, and wrapped herself around him in a fierce embrace.
"I've missed you..." she mumbled in a low voice.
"Me too."
A long moment of silence later, Yuan asked, "What are you doing here? Are you the only one here?"
"I heard the Demon Sealing Clan was doing something important and wanted to take a look," she replied. "And I came here alone with my master."
"Your master, huh?" Yuan adjusted his gaze slightly to look at Keling, who was staring at them with a bewildered face.
'Why does she look so familiar?' Yuan wondered inwardly after seeing her face more closely.
Then he noticed her large physique and bulging muscles, reminding him of a certain individual.
"What's your relationship with Kelan?" he asked.
However, Keling was too stunned to respond, so Meixiu responded in her stead, "She's Keling, Kelan's elder sister."
"I see..."
Eventually, Keling regained some of her composure and put away her weapon.
"So you're Yuan... I have heard a lot about you from my useless brother and my disciple," she said.
"I apologize for pointing my weapon at you just now. You look too suspicious with that mask."
Yuan shook his head.
"It's fine. I can tell that you just wanted to protect Meixiu. Thank you for caring for her."
"It's my responsibility as her master," she said, her chest slightly raised.
"Yuan... about this situation..."
Meixiu finally spoke about the elephant in the room.
Yuan turned to the Demon Sealers tangled in combat and sighed, "I'll deal with it."
The very next moment, Yuan leaped directly into the center of the action, where Yan Hara's supporters and Qian Chu's supporters were clashing with the intent to kill.
"That's enough." Yuan spoke in a calm voice that echoed throughout the area.

Even if the Demon Sealers wanted to continue fighting, Yuan's voice carried an immense amount of Soul Strength that shook their souls to the extent of stunning them, which temporarily restricted their movements.
"Who the hell are you?!"
"This is none of your business, so keep your nose out of it!"
"If we stop now, they will kill Senior Yan!"
The Demon Sealers angrily shouted at him after being interrupted.
To their surprise, Yuan started chuckling, as if he found the situation amusing.
"What the hell is so funny, you bastard?!"
Yuan turned to look at Yan Hara's supporters and said, "You have been so busy fighting that you failed to notice Yan Hara's brilliance."
"What...?"
Yuan gestured toward the display and said, "Take a look for yourself—whether Yan Hara is in trouble or not."
Everyone present turned toward the display at the same time.
"T-This is—!"

To everyone's shock—especially Qian Chu's supporters—Yan Hara was not only holding her ground against over a hundred demons by herself, but she was even beginning to gain the upper hand as she sealed the demons one by one.
"How is that possible?! Even if she possesses the Divine Paragon's techniques, how can she use them so frequently?! Where the hell is she getting so much Demon Sealing Aura from?!"
At this moment, Yan Hara appeared to possess an inexhaustible supply of Demon Sealing Aura, unleashing the Divine Paragon's techniques one after another without the slightest pause.

It was common knowledge that, unlike spiritual energy, Demon Sealing Aura could not be enhanced through treasures and external resources. The only way to strengthen it was through painstaking effort and time.
Yet somehow, Yan Hara had managed to improve her Demon Sealing Aura to such a terrifying extent within an impossibly short period of time.
"Is that really the Yan Hara I know, or someone else disguised as her?!"

As if reacting to the sound of Meixiu's voice, the masked figure suddenly turned to look in their direction—or more specifically—at Meixiu.
Keling's eyes trembled the moment the masked figure's gaze met hers... or so she thought.
Without the slightest hesitation, she grabbed Meixiu and fled at full speed, her entire body drenched in cold sweat.
However, before they could get far, the masked man suddenly vanished from his spot and appeared directly before them, blocking their path.
'Void Manipulation?!' Keling hastily stopped herself, nearly tripping over in the process.
Then, before they could even exchange a word, Keling withdrew her weapon—a massive bow that was larger than her own tall frame and pointed it at him.
"What do you want from us?!" Keling roared, sounding like a cornered mother desperately trying to protect her helpless daughter.
Despite being an expert at the sixth level of God Ascension while the masked man before her was only at the third level, she felt not the slightest trace of confidence facing him.
On the other hand, Meixiu felt no sense of danger from his presence.
If anything, she felt strangely reassured, as though she instinctively knew he would never harm them.
"SPEAK!" Keling demanded in a forceful voice.
"Yuan?"
Meixiu suddenly stepped around Keling and approached the masked man.
Even though it had been years since they last met, she would never forget his eyes or how he would look at her with love.
Yuan smiled behind his mask and calmly nodded, "It's me."
"W-Wha—?" Keling's jaw dropped to the ground.
"Yuan!"
Meixiu leapt forward without hesitation, arms wide, and wrapped herself around him in a fierce embrace.
"I've missed you..." she mumbled in a low voice.
"Me too."
A long moment of silence later, Yuan asked, "What are you doing here?
Are you the only one here?"
"I heard the Demon Sealing Clan was doing something important and wanted to take a look," she replied.
"And I came here alone with my master."
"Your master, huh?" Yuan adjusted his gaze slightly to look at Keling, who was staring at them with a bewildered face.
'Why does she look so familiar?' Yuan wondered inwardly after seeing her face more closely.
Then he noticed her large physique and bulging muscles, reminding him of a certain individual.
"What's your relationship with Kelan?" he asked.
However, Keling was too stunned to respond, so Meixiu responded in her stead, "She's Keling, Kelan's elder sister."
"I see..."
Eventually, Keling regained some of her composure and put away her weapon.
"So you're Yuan...
I have heard a lot about you from my useless brother and my disciple," she said.
"I apologize for pointing my weapon at you just now.
You look too suspicious with that mask."
Yuan shook his head.
"It's fine.
I can tell that you just wanted to protect Meixiu.
Thank you for caring for her."
"It's my responsibility as her master," she said, her chest slightly raised.
"Yuan... about this situation..."
Meixiu finally spoke about the elephant in the room.
Yuan turned to the Demon Sealers tangled in combat and sighed, "I'll deal with it."
The very next moment, Yuan leaped directly into the center of the action, where Yan Hara's supporters and Qian Chu's supporters were clashing with the intent to kill.
"That's enough." Yuan spoke in a calm voice that echoed throughout the area.

Even if the Demon Sealers wanted to continue fighting, Yuan's voice carried an immense amount of Soul Strength that shook their souls to the extent of stunning them, which temporarily restricted their movements.
"Who the hell are you?!"
"This is none of your business, so keep your nose out of it!"
"If we stop now, they will kill Senior Yan!"
The Demon Sealers angrily shouted at him after being interrupted.
To their surprise, Yuan started chuckling, as if he found the situation amusing.
"What the hell is so funny, you bastard?!"
Yuan turned to look at Yan Hara's supporters and said, "You have been so busy fighting that you failed to notice Yan Hara's brilliance."
"What...?"
Yuan gestured toward the display and said, "Take a look for yourself—whether Yan Hara is in trouble or not."
Everyone present turned toward the display at the same time.
"T-This is—!"

To everyone's shock—especially Qian Chu's supporters—Yan Hara was not only holding her ground against over a hundred demons by herself, but she was even beginning to gain the upper hand as she sealed the demons one by one.
"How is that possible?!
Even if she possesses the Divine Paragon's techniques, how can she use them so frequently?!
Where the hell is she getting so much Demon Sealing Aura from?!"
At this moment, Yan Hara appeared to possess an inexhaustible supply of Demon Sealing Aura, unleashing the Divine Paragon's techniques one after another without the slightest pause.
It was common knowledge that, unlike spiritual energy, Demon Sealing Aura could not be enhanced through treasures and external resources.
The only way to strengthen it was through painstaking effort and time.
Yet somehow, Yan Hara had managed to improve her Demon Sealing Aura to such a terrifying extent within an impossibly short period of time.
"Is that really the Yan Hara I know, or someone else disguised as her?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2482 Trusting Yan Harac
paragraphs: Chapter 2482 Trusting Yan Hara
Inside the Valley of Demons, Yan Hara laughed madly as she sealed one demon after another.
"Is this all you've got, Demon Emperor?!"
"Swords of Eternal Torment!"
"Demon Sealing Zone!"
In the blink of an eye, over half of the demons that ambushed her turned into stone statues.
"What the hell is going on?! Why is she so powerful?!"
"How come I have never heard of her name before? Where did this monster come from?!"
The demons were left utterly dumbfounded by Yan Hara's overwhelming prowess, reminding them of the Divine Paragon.
"What should we do, Emperor Carnage?"
"At this rate, we'll all be sealed by that woman!"
The remaining demons turned to Demon Emperor Carnage for guidance.

"Tch..." Demon Emperor Carnage sucked his teeth with an irritated frown on his face. He could've never anticipated that the woman who was powerless before him not long ago would become so disgustingly powerful.
"We're leaving!" Demon Emperor Carnage said before turning around to flee.
"Where do you think you're going?" Yan Hara's eyes widened with surprise when the demons suddenly turned to flee, and she immediately gave chase.
Even when the demons scattered in different directions, Yan Hara continued chasing without any hesitation or pause, her target being Demon Emperor Carnage from the very start.
"I will seal you even if it's the last thing I do!" Yan Hara shouted, her voice echoing loudly through the valley.
After nearly an entire hour of chasing, Demon Emperor Carnage came to a sudden halt and turned around to face Yan Hara.
"Have you finally accepted your fate?!" Yan Hara laughed as she attacked without the slightest delay.

However, just as she struck at Demon Emperor Carnage, Yan Hara sensed a faint presence materialize behind her like a ghost. Before she could fully react, a burst of spiritual energy exploded at her back, and a searing pain tore through her. *Cough* Yan Hara crashed to the ground, coughing up a mouthful of blood.
"Which bastard—?!" Yan Hara whipped around to face her assailant, and to her utter shock, she found herself staring at a familiar face.
"Qian Chu!" she growled, her voice low and venomous, as though she were facing her archenemy.
Meanwhile, outside the Valley of Demons, the Demon Sealers and spectators that didn't leave were puzzled when the display suddenly vanished.
"What the hell?! What happened to the broadcast? It was just getting to the good part!"
The display had turned off right when Demon Emperor Carnage stopped to face Yan Hara, so nobody there knew about Qian Chu's sneak attack.
"What is the meaning of this?!" Yan Hara's supporters immediately questioned Qian Chu's supporters.
"W-We have nothing to do with this!" one of them said.
"How can we trust you at this point!"
"Open the portal! We're going inside!"

"What are you all so worried about? It's not like she can't handle a Demon Emperor. I'm sure it's only temporary, and the display will be fixed soon." Hearing this seemingly reasonable explanation, Yan Hara's supporters calmed down slightly—though they couldn't completely shake the unease gnawing at their hearts.

Ten minutes slipped by, yet the display did not return. Then half an hour passed—still nothing. After a full hour without any sign of the projection coming back, Yan Hara's supporters could no longer endure it and demanded the portal be opened. However, Qian Chu's supporters refused, insisting that interfering would invalidate the Demon Slaying Parade and that they had to wait until the event concluded before entering.
"There's only one day left... we should have some more faith in Senior Yan."
"Once the Demon Slaying Parade is over tomorrow, Senior Yan will become the next leader of the Demon Sealing Clan!"
"Right! Let's trust Senior Yan!"
Not far away, Meixiu and Yuan sat side by side, watching events unfold. "What do you think?" Meixiu asked, leaning into him, her head resting on his shoulder.
"She will be fine," he responded.
"How can you be so sure?" Keling, who was sitting behind them, asked.
"I just do."

While everyone anxiously awaited the end of the Demon Slaying Parade's final day, Yan Hara continued fighting both Demon Emperor Carnage and Qian Chu at the same time, all while still injured from the earlier sneak attack.
"What happened to your energy from before, huh?!" Demon Emperor Carnage laughed out loud as he bombarded Yan Hara with powerful blood techniques.
Although Yan Hara could deal with Demon Emperor Carnage, Qian Chu's attacks were a different story. Not only was Qian Chu not affected by Demon Sealing Aura, but his cultivation was also superior.
"Do you have no shame, Qian Chu?! Not only did you ambush me, but you're working alongside a Demon Emperor!" Yan Hara shouted angrily as blood covered nearly every inch of her body.

Qian Chu calmly stared at her and responded in a nonchalant voice, "You can blame nobody but yourself for stepping out of your boundaries, Yan Hara. Had you not coveted my position, you wouldn't be in this situation right now."
"Is this really about your position, or is this about something else?" Yan Hara glared at him.
"Hmph." Qian Chu coldly sneered. "I have no time to chat nonsense with you. Hand over the Divine Paragon's legacy and we'll give you a painless death."
Yan Hara fell silent, blood dripping from her face.
"The Divine Paragon's legacy... you can forget about it because I will never hand it over," she muttered a moment later.
"Then I will just retrieve it from your corpse." Qian Chu sneered. "There are plenty of methods to retrieve memories from a corpse, after all."
"You will never get away with this!" Yan Hara roared.
"I have no intention of running away," Qian Chu calmly revealed.
"Once I open the Demonic Realm, I will plunge this—and that world into complete chaos!"
"What...?" Yan Hara frowned at his puzzling words, even wondering if she'd heard him correctly.
As if he could read her mind, Qian Chu suddenly said, "You heard me correctly."
"But why—"
Yan Hara opened her mouth to ask, but Qian Chu attacked before she could finish, unleashing a technique that was too massive to avoid.
