chapters.title: Chapter 2483 End of the Demon Slaying Parade
paragraphs: "DIE, YAN HARA!" Qian Chu laughed maniacally as he unleashed a massive technique toward her.
In the next instant, millions of crimson shards shot toward Yan Hara's bloodied figure like a devastating storm.
Yan Hara slowly closed her eyes, accepting her fate.
Yet at that very moment, a certain figure suddenly surfaced in her mind—calmly gazing at her with a reassuring smile on his face.
'Yuan...'
The moment Yan Hara saw his face in her mind, she gritted her teeth and abruptly reopened her eyes.
A powerful surge of Demon Sealing Aura erupted from her body, and just before Qian Chu's attack could reach her, a flag suddenly materialized out of thin air.
Its fabric wrapped around her in a protective embrace, shielding her as countless crimson shards crashed against it.
"What?!" Qian Chu exclaimed in shock, his eyes widening in disbelief at the sudden appearance of the Demon Sealing Flag.
"Hey... isn't that your..." Demon Emperor Carnage looked at him with a puzzled face.
"No! It can't be the Demon Sealing Flag!" Qian Chu hastily responded.
After all, the Demon Sealing Flag was in a secure location that only he knew. There was simply no way Yan Hara could have stolen it without him knowing.
Yet, the treasure that protected Yan Hara looked identical to the Demon Sealing Flag, and it was unlikely that a replica would be able to block his attack perfectly.
Once the attack ended, the Demon Sealing Flag unwrapped Yan Hara, revealing that she was completely unharmed.
"This is..." Yan Hara stared at the Demon Sealing Flag with a surprised face, looking as puzzled as Qian Chu.
Before she could even open her mouth to speak, Qian Chu gestured at it, commanding it to return to his possession.
If it was truly the Demon Sealing Flag, it would listen to his command.
The Demon Sealing Flag trembled slightly in response, but it did not move an inch.
Seeing this, Yan Hara subconsciously copied his movements and gestured at it with a grasping motion, and to Qian Chu's bewilderment, it flew directly into her grasp.
"How dare you..." Qian Chu trembled in anger.
Even if the Demon Sealing Flag was a fake, the fact it responded to Yan Hara rather than Qian Chu was an immense insult to his pride.
Qian Chu was so furious that his skin turned a vivid crimson, making him resemble a demon himself.
Then, without the slightest warning, he lunged at Yan Hara, murderous intent pouring from every inch of his body.
Yan Hara instinctively tried to defend herself, but her body was too battered and exhausted to respond. She could only will herself to move in her mind.
Yet, as though it had sensed her thoughts, the Demon Sealing Flag suddenly reacted on its own, shooting toward the incoming Qian Chu.
"Scram, you useless fake!" Qian Chu roared, attacking it with Celestial Qi.

Since the Demon Sealing Flag had been created specifically to combat demons, it lacked the power to completely suppress someone like Qian Chu, who wasn't one and was even at the fourth level of God Ascension.
After the clash, the Demon Sealing Flag was sent flying to the side, while Qian Chu continued charging straight toward Yan Hara.
"Your life is mine!"
A cold smile curled on Qian Chu's lips as his claw-like hand reached within inches of Yan Hara's throat.
However, just before contact, his body suddenly froze in place, as though an invisible hand had seized him entirely.
"What—?!"
Qian Chu's face twisted with disbelief and confusion, utterly unable to comprehend what had stopped him.
Meanwhile, Demon Emperor Carnage's eyes widened as he noticed the two objects that had suddenly appeared above Qian Chu just before he was halted.
"The Demon Sealing Scroll and the Demon Sealing Talisman!" he cried out loud.
"Impossible!" Qian Chu exclaimed after finally noticing the two treasures above him.
The next moment, his body was pulled back and pushed further away from Yan Hara.
By the time Qian Chu steadied himself, the three Demon Sealing Treasures were already by Yan Hara's side, circling her like three guardians.
"What the hell is going on?! Why are the Demon Sealing Treasures in your possession?!" Qian Chu roared, demanding for answers.
Unfortunately, not even Yan Hara herself knew the answer.
"Why should I tell you?"
Yet, Yan Hara refused to tell him.
Qian Chu gritted his teeth so hard that they cracked.
Then, he turned to Demon Emperor Carnage and shouted, "What are you doing, standing there like a bystander?! Stop being useless and help me get rid of her!"
"You want me to fight her while she has all three Demon Sealing Treasures in her possession?! You might as well tell me to kill myself!" Demon Emperor Carnage exclaimed.
"Do you want me to help you summon the Ancients or not?! In this entire world, only I am capable of doing so!" Qian Chu shouted back.
"That's..." Demon Emperor Carnage gritted his teeth upon hearing those words.
A moment later, he released a defeated sigh before joining the battle. However, he did not join alone, as the demons that had fled earlier reappeared as well.
Meanwhile, outside at the venue, the Demon Sealers anxiously awaited the conclusion of the Demon Slaying Parade, which had entered its final day.
"One more hour... just one more hour to go..."
Yan Hara's supporters paced back and forth endlessly, while others nervously stomped their feet, resembling a crowd gathered outside an emergency room awaiting life-or-death news.
Eventually, the final hour passed, and the Demon Slaying Parade officially came to an end.
"It's over! Let us inside now!"
Yan Hara's supporters immediately rushed toward the portal.
Yet, Qian Chu's supporters continued to block their path for some reason.
"What is the meaning of this?!"
"Nobody is allowed inside until the Clan Leader gives permission," one of them said.
"That's bullshit!"
Once again, the Demon Sealers began arguing with each other.
Suddenly, a tall, masked figure in full black stood up and approached the portal.
"Hey, what do you think you're doing?" One of Qian Chu's supporters stood in front of him, blocking his path.
"I am going inside," Yuan replied in a calm voice.
"Look, buddy, I don't know who the hell you think you are—"
Pap!
A loud slap suddenly echoed through the area, cutting him off mid-sentence.
Before the Demon Sealer could even finish speaking, Yuan's arm flickered, his palm crashing across the man's face.
Everyone present stopped moving to stare at Yuan in shock.
Nobody there could've expected a stranger that wasn't even a Demon Sealer to throw the first strike.
The man that had been slapped slowly turned to look at Yuan, his eyes burning with rage.
Then, he clenched his hand into a fist and swung it.
"BASTARD—"
PAP!
A second slap resounded, sounding much sharper than the first. At the same time, the man was sent flying to the side.
However, it wasn't Yuan who threw the second strike, but another Demon Sealer—one from the Seventh Heaven.
Before anyone present could even react, Yuan raised his hand and removed his mask, revealing his handsome face for all to see.
Countless gasps instantly rang out across the area as the Demon Sealers' eyes widened in shock and disbelief, their jaws practically dropping to the ground.
The spectators watched the scene with raised eyebrows, puzzled by their reaction.
Eventually, one of the Demon Sealers muttered in a dazed voice, "Divine Paragon...?"

Countless gasps instantly rang out across the area as the Demon Sealers' eyes widened in shock and disbelief, their jaws practically dropping to the ground.
The spectators watched the scene with raised eyebrows, puzzled by their reaction.
Eventually, one of the Demon Sealers muttered in a dazed voice, "Divine Paragon...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2484 Divine Paragon!
paragraphs: Yuan remained silent despite being called out to, his gaze fixed solely on the portal just a few steps away.
Without uttering a single word, he began walking toward it.
Seeing this, the Demon Sealers standing in his path instinctively moved aside, their eyes locked onto his face without blinking.
Once Yuan reached Qian Chu's supporters, he lowered his gaze to the person standing before him.
The man immediately began sweating profusely, his clothes darkening within moments as cold sweat drenched his body.
"Three..."
Yuan suddenly started counting down, sending shivers down everyone's spine.
"Y-You can't fool me!" the Demon Sealer suddenly shouted, his voice cracking at the very beginning.
"The Divine Paragon has long since died! How dare you use his face for such a shameless stunt?!"
The moment the other Demon Sealers heard those words, they finally snapped out of their stupor, as though abruptly regaining their senses.
"Wait a second... there's no way the Divine Paragon could be here!"
"Shameless bastard! What are you trying to achieve by disguising yourself as the Divine Paragon?!"
They began shouting in anger, even surrounding him like an enraged mob closing in on its target.
Suddenly, the Demon Sealers from the Seventh Heaven jumped in while shouting, "This is not a stunt! He is really the Divine Paragon!"
"What?"
The others halted their movements to stare at him.
"We were ambushed by over a thousand demons when we went to check on the seals for the Demonic Realm! If the Divine Paragon hadn't appeared, all of us would have died!"
"It was also the Divine Paragon who removed the seals, as he had been trapped inside the Demonic Realm and needed to return to our world!

"Wait a second... What do you mean the Divine Paragon had been trapped inside the Demonic Realm? He was the one who sealed it when he returned last time, and it hasn't been unsealed since then, so how did he get back to the Demonic Realm?"
"He accidentally discovered another entrance to the Demonic Realm, but it only functions one way."
"So he came out of the Demonic Realm? How are you so certain that is the real Divine Paragon and not some demon disguised as him?" asked one skeptical Demon Sealer.
"Because he got rid of all the demons by himself, using the 'Divine Paragon's lost techniques' showcased by Yan Hara!"
"No way..."
The Demon Sealers slowly turned to look at Yuan.
"Huh? Where did he go?"
However, to their surprise, Yuan's figure had vanished without a trace.
Unbeknownst to them, while their attention had been diverted by the Seventh Heaven's Demon Sealers, Yuan had already slipped into the Valley of Demons.
"I-I think I saw a shadow enter the portal..." the Demon Sealer closest to the portal suddenly said.
"He must have entered the portal already! Let's follow him and see for ourselves whether he's truly the Divine Paragon or just a fake!"
The next moment, nearly every single Demon Sealer rushed into the portal, leaving just a few behind to ensure the other spectators didn't follow them.
Inside the Valley of Demons, Yan Hara tried her best to survive the demons' onslaught.
Fortunately for her, the Demon Sealing Treasures functioned without her control and would protect her as needed, as if they had a will of its own.
"She's exhausted herself and won't be able to last much longer! Kill her! Quickly!" Demon Emperor Carnage shouted at the other demons while he and Qian Chu focused on the Demon Sealing Treasures.
"Come at me, you fiends! I'll seal every last one of you, even if it costs me my final breath!" Yan Hara shouted, her eyes blazing with unwavering resolve—the resolve to die.
Yan Hara paid no heed to conserving her strength, sealing demons one after another without pause.
In the end, she managed to seal nearly every demon present before exhausting the very last bit of her energy.
The Demon Sealing Treasures, which had been operating solely on their reserve energy, also began to run dry and soon ceased functioning altogether.
Qian Chu and Demon Emperor Carnage slowly approached Yan Hara, who knelt weakly on the ground, barely conscious as faint, shallow breaths escaped her lips.
"I have to admit, Yan Hara... you far exceeded my expectations, even startling me a little just now..." Qian Chu muttered.
A cold sigh escaped his lips before he continued, "If only you had stood on my side instead... you could have gone much farther."
"Any last words?"
Yan Hara spat out the blood in her mouth and spoke in a low voice, "Go... fuck yourself... you damn... puppet..."
Qian Chu's eyes twitched at her words.
Then, without another word, he raised his arm and brought it down toward the back of her neck in a chopping motion.
The Demon Sealing Flag, which had been lying motionless on the ground after exhausting its energy, suddenly erupted with an unfathomable amount of Demon Sealing Aura.
It rose into the air on its own and shot toward Qian Chu, aiming directly for the back of his head.
Sensing the deadly attack behind him, Qian Chu abruptly turned and redirected the strike meant for Yan Hara toward the incoming flag, attempting to block it.
In the next instant, a piercing scream tore from Qian Chu's lips as the Demon Sealing Flag not only reflected his attack, but completely obliterated his arm in the process.
Seeing this, Demon Emperor Carnage immediately leapt backward, putting distance between himself and the others.

However, he abruptly stopped when his back slammed into something hard. Assuming he had collided with a tree, he instinctively swung around to cut it down—only for his arm to be caught mid-motion by another hand.
"Y-You are—?!"
Demon Emperor Carnage's eyes nearly bulged out of their sockets as he realized that what he had collided with was not a tree, but a human—one he was very familiar with, no less.
"DIVINE PARAGON?!?!"
He screamed at the top of his lungs, so forcefully that his lungs actually burst from the strain.

chapters.title: Chapter 2485 Homunculus
paragraphs: "DIVINE PARAGON?! WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE?!" Demon Emperor Carnage screamed in terror before instinctively yanking his arm trying to break free from Yuan's grasp, pulling so hard that he ripped his own arm out.
Blood gushed everywhere for a second before another arm regenerated, sealing the wound.
"Divine Paragon...?" Qian Chu and Yan Hara turned to look at Yuan with a dumbfounded face.

"That's impossible! The Divine Paragon is dead! There's no way he could be here right now!" Qian Chu did not believe for a second that the Divine Paragon was still alive, much less appear before them right now.
Demon Emperor Carnage had tried to spread news of the Divine Paragon's return shortly after their encounter, but nobody believed him, so he gave up on trying.
Meanwhile, Yan Hara released a relieved sigh.
"Yuan..." she murmured softly before collapsing onto the ground from sheer exhaustion.
Her body instinctively recognized his presence as safety, causing the last bit of strength sustaining her to finally give out.
The Demon Sealing Flag wrapped its cloth around Yan Hara before carrying her away.
"So, have you managed to summon an Ancient yet?" Yuan suddenly asked Demon Emperor Carnage.
"That is none of your business!" Demon Emperor Carnage shouted.
"It isn't? Even though you used their existence to threaten me before?" Yuan remarked with a calm smile.
"That's..." Demon Emperor Carnage gritted his teeth.
"What's going on here, Carnage?!" Qian Chu suddenly approached him and questioned.
"I just told you! He's the Divine Paragon!" Demon Emperor Carnage shouted angrily.
"You expect me to believe that?! The Divine Paragon is dead! He may look like the Divine Paragon, but that's all!"
Qian Chu said.
Then he remembered something and smiled coldly, "You must be that newcomer I have heard a lot about. The one who resembles the Divine Paragon—Little Founder."
"I must admit, you are a splitting image of the Divine Paragon. Unfortunately for you, I am not foolish enough to fall for such trickery!"
Yuan looked at Qian Chu for a second before returning to Demon Emperor Carnage and saying, "Working together with a homunculus? I thought you hated their kind."
"?!?!" Qian Chu's eyes widened in disbelief after hearing Yuan's words.
Then, without warning, swung at Yuan while exuding an immense amount of killing intent.
"How do you know about my kind?!" he roared.
Yuan casually dodged the attack and replied, "How? I was present during the purge of your 'kind', even offering some assistance. To think one would still stand before me right now..."

Homunculus were artificial beings created through a forbidden technique that has existed even before the Great Cataclysm, brought into existence for a single purpose—to satisfy the twisted curiosity of a mad demon.

During Tian Chenyu's first visit to the Demonic Realm, Homunculus existed in great numbers, wreaking havoc across the Crimson Continent. In response, he had aided Supreme Ruler Dena in eradicating them from existence by killing the mad demon and destroying his research.
"You..." Qian Chu suddenly started walking backwards in small steps, his face twisted with disbelief.
Yuan then said, "I heard something quite entertaining earlier. You can help him summon an Ancient, is that right?"
"So what if I can?" Qian Chu subconsciously responded.
"I really want to see one—an Ancient. So, I am willing to let you live until then."
"What?!" Qian Chu exclaimed in shock.
Demon Emperor Carnage wasn't as surprised since he was also allowed to escape before for the same reason.
"What are you waiting for? If you want to die right now, I can fulfill your wish."
Yuan released some of his Demon Sealing Aura, instantly shocking them, as it was countless times stronger than what Yan Hara displayed.
Without hesitation, Demon Emperor Carnage turned around and fled, not even waiting around for Qian Chu to act.
Qian Chu gritted his teeth and also ran away.
But before he could get far, Yuan's voice resounded, "You forgot something."
The next moment, the three Demon Sealing Treasures chased after Qian Chu.
Qian Chu's entire face turned as red as a tomato after experiencing such humiliation for the first time in his life.
'I don't care who you are! Even if you really are the Divine Paragon, I will make you pay for humiliating me!' he swore inwardly.
Shortly after they escaped, the other Demon Sealers appeared.
"Where's Senior Yan?!" "She's safe," Yuan said. "Let me take you to them."
He turned around and flew away, leading them to where he placed Yan Hara.
"Senior Yan!" Her supporters exclaimed in terror after seeing her condition.
"Calm down, she's fine."
One of the Demon Sealers with a medical background approached Yan Hara and examined her condition.
"Besides some external injuries, she's mostly just unconscious from exhaustion," he said.
Her supporters sighed in relief.
"What happened here, Senior Divine Paragon?"
Yuan pointed at her and said, "You can ask her once she wakes up."
The Demon Sealers fed Yan Hara some medicine, and it didn't take long before she opened her eyes.
"Yuan...?" Yan Hara muttered in a daze as she woke up.
"Senior Yan! Are you okay?! What happened during the Demon Slaying Parade?"
Yan Hara turned to look at Yuan, who silently nodded his head.
Although she was still a bit dazed, Yan Hara explained the situation to everyone present, from Qian Chu's betrayal and cheating to the appearance of a real Demon Emperor.
"What?! The Clan Leader is in cahoots with a Demon Emperor?! The same one during the Supreme Demon Sealer's Qualification?! How the hell are we supposed to believe that?"
"Why are we asking her when we can ask the Divine Paragon?" Someone said aloud.
Suddenly, everyone there turned to look at Yuan.
Rather than affirming Yan Hara's claims, Yuan only revealed what he saw with his own eyes—that Qian Chu and the Demon Emperor were working together to fight Yan Hara.
"If I hadn't arrived in time, she wouldn't be alive right now," he said while shaking his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 2486 A Legend’s Return
paragraphs: The entire place became deadly silent after Yuan revealed what he witnessed to the others.
Even if Qian Chu's supporters refused to believe Yan Hara, there was no way they would dare accuse the Divine Paragon of lying.
"Qian Chu, that traitor! How dare he betray humanity and work with the demons?!"
"A Demon Emperor, no less!"
"I knew there was something off about the Supreme Demon Sealer Qualifications! I bet he wanted to get rid of the participants from the beginning!"
Yan Hara's supporters shouted out loud as they angrily stomped their feet.
Meanwhile, Qian Chu's supporters—at least those who weren't spies and were genuine Demon Sealers stopped supporting him at that point and switched sides.
"What happened to Qian Chu and the Demon Emperor?"
"Isn't it obvious? The Divine Paragon killed them!"
However, Yuan shook his head and said in a calm voice, "No, I didn't kill them."
"What?" They all turned to look at him with puzzled faces.
"I let them go," Yuan continued, admitting that he'd purposefully let them escape.
"W-Why would you let them go...?" Someone suddenly asked.
Yet, Yuan narrowed his gaze and coldly muttered, "Are you asking me to explain myself?"
Pap!

Another Demon Sealer slapped the guy who just spoke in the back of his head and shouted loudly, "Who the hell do you think you are?! The Divine Paragon doesn't need to explain anything! If he wants us to jump off a bridge, we will obey without a word!"
Yuan sighed inwardly before turning around and walking away.
"I want every Demon Sealer present at the Grand Library in three days. I have some important information to share with everyone," Yuan said as he left the Valley of Demons.
Nobody stopped him.
The Divine Paragon's return was so sudden and unforeseen that even now, none of them could fully process it, their minds struggling to keep up with reality.
"The... Divine Paragon has truly returned to us...?"
After a moment of silence, they started chanting like a bunch of cultists, "The Divine Paragon has returned!"
Outside the Valley of Demons, Yuan approached Meixiu and said to her, "I will spend some time at the Myriad of Techniques. If you have time, let's catch up."
Meixiu turned to look at Keling.
"You don't have to say anything," Keling spoke up before Meixiu could. "If you want to extend your break for a little longer, I have no issues."
"Thank you, master."
Keling looked at Yuan and smiled, "In exchange, I would like a friendly exchange with you."
Yuan calmly nodded, "I had a feeling you would ask for a spar. Alright."
"See you at the Myriad of Techniques."
Yuan left the venue altogether shortly after.
Meixiu and Keling followed him, but since they entered from the Ninth Heaven, they were separated the instant they walked through the portal.

While Yuan made his way to the Myriad of Techniques, news of the Divine Paragon's return spread throughout the Nine Heavens like an uncontrollable wildfire, reaching every nook and cranny in the blink of an eye.
"Divine Paragon? Who is that?"
"You don't know who he is?! He's the founder of the Demon Sealing Clan and the reason that demons are no longer a threat to civilization!"
"The Divine Paragon first appeared while the demons were running rampant, enslaving humans and treating us like livestock!"
"What do you mean he returned? It's been a long time since the Demonic Era. Where did he go? And what is so significant about his return?"

"He disappeared near the end of the Demonic Era. Nobody knew where he's gone until recently and assumed that he'd died. However, it turns out he was in the Demonic Realm—the home to demons—this entire time."
"Where is the Divine Paragon right now?" "I heard that he's resting at the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, a place only accessible to Demon Sealers."

"I don't understand the hype. He may have been an important figure in the past, but that era is long gone," someone remarked, unable to comprehend why the Divine Paragon's return was causing such a massive uproar.
"You imbecile! He's the savior of humanity! Even a single strand of his hair is worth more than your entire legacy!"
"Not to mention the demons' increased activity recently. With the Divine Paragon's return, they won't dare to act so openly any more!"
Eventually, the news reached the Celestial Emperor's ears.
"The Divine Paragon, hm?" the Celestial Emperor muttered, seemingly uninterested in the matter.
In his eyes, regardless of the Divine Paragon's past accomplishments, it had nothing to do with him.
And as many had already said, that era was long gone.
However, as the Celestial Emperor, he couldn't just sit still and do nothing.
"Send a messenger to the Divine Paragon and tell him that I'd like to meet him, even reward him for his past achievements," said the Celestial Emperor, pretending to care even if he didn't.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
Upon arriving at the Myriad of Techniques, Yuan headed directly to Senior Bai's personal world.
As expected, Meixiu and Keling were already there. However, there was one additional person present—someone he had not anticipated seeing.
"Senior Bai..."

A stiff smile surfaced on Yuan's face when he saw the familiar old man, whose appearance seemed even older than before—or more accurately, far wearier, as though he had been working nonstop since their last encounter.
Even without exchanging a single word, Yuan already had a rough idea why Senior Bai was there.
Before anyone else could speak, Senior Bai broke the silence.
"It has been a long time, little friend... though you are no longer the young man I first met."
After a brief pause, he continued, "I would like to have a conversation with you... once you are finished with your business with them."
Without giving Yuan a chance to respond, Senior Bai turned around and flew away.
Seeing this, Yuan sighed inwardly. "Do you know what happened to Senior Bai? He looks... and feels different," Meixiu asked him a moment later with a worried frown.

Divine Paragon has truly returned to us...?"
After a moment of silence, they started chanting like a bunch of cultists, "The Divine Paragon has returned!"
Outside the Valley of Demons, Yuan approached Meixiu and said to her, "I will spend some time at the Myriad of Techniques.
If you have time, let's catch up."
Meixiu turned to look at Keling.
"You don't have to say anything," Keling spoke up before Meixiu could.
"If you want to extend your break for a little longer, I have no issues."
"Thank you, master."
Keling looked at Yuan and smiled, "In exchange, I would like a friendly exchange with you."
Yuan calmly nodded, "I had a feeling you would ask for a spar.
Alright."
"See you at the Myriad of Techniques."
Yuan left the venue altogether shortly after.
Meixiu and Keling followed him, but since they entered from the Ninth Heaven, they were separated the instant they walked through the portal.

While Yuan made his way to the Myriad of Techniques, news of the Divine Paragon's return spread throughout the Nine Heavens like an uncontrollable wildfire, reaching every nook and cranny in the blink of an eye.
"Divine Paragon?
Who is that?"
"You don't know who he is?!
He's the founder of the Demon Sealing Clan and the reason that demons are no longer a threat to civilization!"
"The Divine Paragon first appeared while the demons were running rampant, enslaving humans and treating us like livestock!"
"What do you mean he returned?
It's been a long time since the Demonic Era.
Where did he go?
And what is so significant about his return?"
"He disappeared near the end of the Demonic Era.
Nobody knew where he's gone until recently and assumed that he'd died.
However, it turns out he was in the Demonic Realm—the home to demons—this entire time."
"Where is the Divine Paragon right now?" "I heard that he's resting at the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, a place only accessible to Demon Sealers."
"I don't understand the hype.
He may have been an important figure in the past, but that era is long gone," someone remarked, unable to comprehend why the Divine Paragon's return was causing such a massive uproar.
"You imbecile!
He's the savior of humanity!
Even a single strand of his hair is worth more than your entire legacy!"
"Not to mention the demons' increased activity recently.
With the Divine Paragon's return, they won't dare to act so openly any more!"
Eventually, the news reached the Celestial Emperor's ears.
"The Divine Paragon, hm?" the Celestial Emperor muttered, seemingly uninterested in the matter.
In his eyes, regardless of the Divine Paragon's past accomplishments, it had nothing to do with him.
And as many had already said, that era was long gone.
However, as the Celestial Emperor, he couldn't just sit still and do nothing.
"Send a messenger to the Divine Paragon and tell him that I'd like to meet him, even reward him for his past achievements," said the Celestial Emperor, pretending to care even if he didn't.
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
Upon arriving at the Myriad of Techniques, Yuan headed directly to Senior Bai's personal world.
As expected, Meixiu and Keling were already there.
However, there was one additional person present—someone he had not anticipated seeing.
"Senior Bai..."

A stiff smile surfaced on Yuan's face when he saw the familiar old man, whose appearance seemed even older than before—or more accurately, far wearier, as though he had been working nonstop since their last encounter.
Even without exchanging a single word, Yuan already had a rough idea why Senior Bai was there.
Before anyone else could speak, Senior Bai broke the silence.
"It has been a long time, little friend... though you are no longer the young man I first met."
After a brief pause, he continued, "I would like to have a conversation with you... once you are finished with your business with them."
Without giving Yuan a chance to respond, Senior Bai turned around and flew away.
Seeing this, Yuan sighed inwardly.
"Do you know what happened to Senior Bai?
He looks... and feels different," Meixiu asked him a moment later with a worried frown.

chapters.title: Chapter 2487 A Legend's Return(2)
paragraphs: "I have also never seen Senior Bai in such a condition before," Yuan remarked with a sigh.
"You should talk to him now. I can wait," Meixiu then said.
Yuan nodded and quickly chased after Senior Bai.
"Senior Bai!" Yuan used Void Manipulation to appear before him.
"V-Void Manipulation?!"
Senior Bai's face twisted with shock for a moment before he gradually calmed himself.
"You've grown tremendously since our last encounter..." he muttered with a weary sigh. "But then again, this seems to happen every single time, so perhaps I shouldn't be surprised anymore..."
"Senior Bai... is everything okay?" Yuan asked him with a worried frown.
"We can talk about this later—"
Yuan shook his head and interrupted.
"I don't think I will be able to enjoy my reunion with Meixiu like this..."
He continued before Senior Bai could respond, "Is this... about the Celestial Overlord's sudden drop in karma?"
"So it really was you, after all..." Senior Bai released a deep sigh.
Even though he had already suspected it was Yuan, hearing the confirmation directly from him carried an entirely different weight.
"Although I trust that you had a good reason, I still need to hear it myself. Why did you clash with Heaven's Mandate—the Celestial Emperor's soldiers?"
Yuan fell silent, pondering how to explain the situation to Senior Bai without sounding ridiculous.
"You already know that the Celestial Emperor and I share some sort of hostility toward each other, right?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"Yes," Senior Bai nodded. "Though I still can't understand how that's even possible. There should've been no way for you to have met the Celestial Emperor in the first place, much less offend him.
"That's because I haven't met him in this life yet... but I have met him in the past... in my past life."
Yuan faced Senior Bai with a solemn expression.
"Your... past life?" Senior Bai swallowed nervously as he muttered in a daze.
Yet despite the shocking revelation, there was no true bewilderment in Senior Bai's gaze, almost as though he had already anticipated such a possibility to some extent.
"The founder of the Celestial Overlords..." Senior Bai suddenly muttered.
Yuan nodded, confirming in a calm voice, "Indeed, one of my past lives was Tian Yingzhe, the founder of the Celestial Overlords."

He continued, "Remember when I handed over his techniques—his legacy to Xu Jiaqi, saying that I've found it? In truth, I regained some of Tian Yingzhe's memories and recovered the technique in that manner."
"I see..." Senior Bai fell silent for a moment to digest this information.
Then, he spoke, "But that doesn't explain the Celestial Emperor's hostility towards you."

Yuan sighed before responding, "To be honest, I don't think I can fully explain the situation to you without sounding crazy. Moreover, I will have to reveal some forbidden information that requires sacrificing your longevity."
"Information that requires longevity?" After a brief moment of silence, Senior Bai continued, asking, "Is this related to the 'Gods' in the Starry Sky?"
Yuan's eyes widened with surprise.
"How did you learn about that?"

A prideful smile tugged at Senior Bai's lips as he replied, "There is a reason some call me the Sage of Knowledge. Throughout my life, I did not merely collect techniques to expand the Myriad of Techniques—I also gathered countless ancient records covering all manner of subjects."
The Myriad of Techniques was not merely the largest collection of cultivation techniques within the Nine Heavens. It also functioned as a vast hub of information.
Of course, very few people were aware of this, as most visitors only came seeking techniques.

"Although I admittedly do not know much about them, I am at least aware of their existence. I also did not pursue such knowledge, as I became afraid of the consequences after losing a tremendous amount of longevity just learning of their existence.
"Well, since you already know about them, it will make explaining things much easier," Yuan said afterward.

"While I cannot reveal too many details, these so-called 'Gods' are my enemies. Since the dawn of time, they have been responsible for countless major incidents that led to innumerable deaths... all in pursuit of their own goals."
"As for how they're related to the Celestial Emperor... well, the first Celestial Emperor was their creation, and the current Celestial Emperor is nothing more than their puppet."
Senior Bai's jaw dropped at the heaven-shattering revelation.
Ignoring his shock, Yuan calmly continued, "And I have been fighting the Celestial Emperor and these Gods since the very beginning... across multiple lifetimes."
Senior Bai suddenly fell back onto his buttocks, his eyes wide with disbelief.
After a long minute of silence, Senior Bai remained on the ground as he asked in a nervous voice, "What... What am I supposed to do with this information?"

Yuan shook his head and said, "You don't need to do anything. I simply want you to understand my situation. Not only are you Xu Jiaqi's most trusted aide, but you've also helped me countless times since the very beginning."
"Is that so..."
Senior Bai no longer spoke afterward.
Seeing this, Yuan asked, "How are the Celestial Overlords and Xu Jiaqi doing?"

Senior Bai sighed deeply. "Terribly. The others are aware that Lady Xu recruited you, and even without concrete evidence, they're blaming her for the lost karma. Not only has she lost many of her followers, but she's also been pushed to the sidelines entirely. At this rate, forget becoming the next leader—she may even end up exiled from the faction."
"That's..." Yuan was left speechless, the situation turning out far worse than he had imagined.
Senior Bai slowly rose to his feet and stood before Yuan, staring at him with a solemn expression.
"Yuan... you must do something to help Lady Xu."
He nodded.
"I will. Just give me a little more time. I have some unfinished business with the Demon Sealing Clan."
"Speaking of the Demon Sealing Clan... Are you actually the Divine Paragon, or are you simply pretending to be him?" Senior Bai then asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2488 Sparring with Keling
paragraphs: Hearing Senior Bai's question, a calm smile appeared on Yuan's face.
"Just like Tian Yingzhe, the Divine Paragon is another of my past lives," he replied.
Senior Bai opened his mouth, but no words came out.
"Any other questions? I'll answer as much as I can," Yuan said.

"The Celestial Emperor recently released an official statement regarding your incident, claiming that the perpetrator—you—smuggled the Asura Clan out of the Primordial Realm. As far as I am aware, they are the most dangerous criminals imprisoned there."

Senior Bai paused for a moment before asking in a solemn voice, "Is... that true? If so, why the Asura Clan? I understand that they fought against the first Celestial Emperor before, so you might want to cooperate with them, but they are simply too dangerous! Because they—"
"Because they once served the Evil God, correct?" Yuan interrupted, easily seeing through Senior Bai's concerns.
Senior Bai nodded with a deep frown on his face.

"The Evil God was one of the cruelest individuals in history. The number of lives he slaughtered reached into the tens of millions. Even if the first Celestial Emperor was in the wrong for starting the war, it still does not justify the senseless massacre of innocents."
Yuan sighed, and the atmosphere around him suddenly grew heavy as he responded, "You're right. It does not justify what I did."
"Wait... what?" Senior Bai's eyes widened with disbelief as he doubted his hearing.
Yuan stared at him dead in the eyes and explained, "The Evil God... the God of War was also one of my incarnations."
"WHAT?!" Senior Bai exclaimed, falling back to the ground with a heavy thud.
"T-The Evil God?! You?!"
Yuan nodded and said, "Although it won't justify the rampage I went on, allow me to explain why I did it."
He then turned to look at Meixiu in the distance before revealing the truth behind why the Evil God had gone on a killing spree and become the most blood-soaked figure in history.

He revealed to Senior Bai that the Celestial Emperor had assassinated his wife—who had been pregnant with his child—simply because he refused to serve the Celestial Emperor during the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods.
"That's...

Since he had never had a wife, let alone children, Senior Bai could not truly comprehend Yuan's pain. However, that did not mean he couldn't understand how such a tragedy could change even the kindest of men.

Eventually, Senior Bai spoke, "I will neither support nor condemn what you did in the past—especially when it happened in another life altogether. Let us leave the past where it belongs and focus on the present instead. As long as you don't go around killing innocent people, I will continue to trust and support your decisions."
"Thank you." Yuan nodded.
"Any... any other incarnations of yours that I should..." Senior Bai paused there and shook his head, "Forget it. I don't want to know."
He then said, "About Lady Xu... do you want me to tell her?"
"No, I will tell her myself."
"I understand. Then I'll leave you alone for now. Don't make her wait too long."
Without another word, Senior Bai left the world.

Yuan returned to Meixiu afterward and explained the cause of Senior Bai's worries to her, but she wasn't familiar with Xu Jiaqi or the Celestial Overlords in general, so her understanding of the situation was superficial.

"The Celestial Overlords' significant drop in ranking was caused by you?" Keling remarked with a dumbfounded look on her face. "Wait... so you were responsible for slaughtering Heaven's Mandate and the one who released the Asura Clan from the Primordial Realm?"
Keling swallowed nervously after realizing that Yuan was the culprit behind those incidents, and she wondered whether she should really spar with such a dangerous person.

She looked at Meixiu with the corner of her eye, and to her surprise, Meixiu did not seem the slightest surprised or disturbed by the fact that her partner was essentially a wanted criminal that even the Celestial Emperor wanted dead.
At that moment, she decided to try to talk some sense into Meixiu later.
"Let's catch up. I have a lot I want to tell you," Yuan said to Meixiu, who nodded before following him away.
"Um... what about me?" Keling suddenly asked.
Yuan pondered for a second before speaking to Meixu, "Can you wait a few more minutes?
She nodded.
Yuan then turned to Keling and said, "You wanted to spar, right? Let's do it right now since you'll need some time to recover afterward."

Keling narrowed her eyes, feeling as though Yuan was looking down on her. However, the moment she recalled that he had defeated Heaven's Mandate Second Squad by himself, her irritation quickly subsided.
"Don't worry, I will go easy," Yuan added.
When Keling heard that, she felt something snap inside her head, and her aura surged violently.
"Let's fight, you bastard!"
Yuan calmly gestured at her with a beckoning motion, "Whenever you're ready."
In the next moment, Keling drew her arm back before unleashing a punch, her fist shooting toward Yuan like a cannonball.
Without even glancing at her, Yuan casually raised an arm before his face, effortlessly catching her fist just centimeters before it could collide with him.
'What ridiculous strength!' Keling's eyes widened in shock.

Although her giant bloodline was not as pure or powerful as Kelan's, she still possessed the blood of giants, granting her physical prowess far beyond that of ordinary humans. Furthermore, as a bow wielder, she had tempered her arms to extreme degrees, allowing her to draw bows that required enough strength to move mountains.
Despite all of that, Yuan had managed to stop her full-strength punch with seemingly effortless ease.
"Not bad," Yuan muttered as he gently pushed her fist aside. "But if you want me to fight you properly, then you'll need to fight as though your life depends on it."
Keling gritted her teeth and reached for her Spatial Ring.
"Disciple Meixiu, don't blame me if I accidentally kill your sweetheart!"
Keling shouted as she retrieved her weapon—a massive purple bow nearly twice her size—and aimed it at Yuan, her muscular arm already pulling back the bowstring.

chapters.title: Chapter 2489 Sparring with Keling(2)
paragraphs: "This is your last chance to apologize and fight me seriously," Keling warned Yuan, the muscles in her arm bulging like thick roots as she held the massive bowstring drawn back.
"I'll apologize if you can make me bleed even a single drop of blood," Yuan replied with a provocative smile on his face.
Keling's eyes widened at his words, and without the slightest hesitation, she released the bowstring.
Even without an arrow nocked, the sheer force unleashed by the string alone generated a terrifying shockwave that was powerful enough to effortlessly vaporize even an Immortal.
However, when the shockwave struck Yuan, the most it managed to do was stir his hair and clothes. To him, it felt no different from a gentle spring breeze.
Seeing this, Keling drew the bowstring once more. As she pulled it back, an arrow began materializing out of thin air, already nocked in place and ready to be fired.
The arrow was formed entirely from Celestial Qi and spiritual energy, compressed to such an extreme degree that it had become visible to the naked eye.
Not wanting Meixiu to get caught up in their fight, Yuan used Void Manipulation to teleport both him and Keling far away.
'He can use Void Manipulation with such mastery?!' Keling cried inwardly after being teleported with him.
Unfortunately, she had no time to dwell on it. In the very next moment, she released the bowstring, launching the arrow forged from pure Celestial Qi straight at Yuan.
The arrow traveled at nearly the speed of sound, and wherever it passed, it left behind a thin trail of fractured space.
"Is that it?" Yuan muttered as he slightly raised his arm, effortlessly avoiding the arrow altogether.
Since Keling had no genuine intention of killing him, she had only aimed for one of his limbs.
Keling had already anticipated that Yuan would evade her first attack, so she immediately unleashed several more arrows in rapid succession without the slightest pause.
She fired them so quickly that it appeared as though a dozen arrows had been released at the same time, all of them flying at Yuan with perfect accuracy.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he muttered, "Now that's what I'm talking about!"
In the next instant, he activated Heavenly White Tiger Transformation. Then, with a single swing of his clawed hand, he completely shredded every incoming arrow.
"?!?!" Keling's eyes widened with disbelief.
"Are you even human?!" she cried out loud.
"How rude!" Yuan laughed as he charged straight at Keling, throwing a simple punch toward her.
"Che!
Keling reacted swiftly, but instead of trying to dodge, she raised her bow to block the incoming fist, instinctively realizing that she lacked the speed to evade it.
Clang!
A sharp metallic clang rang out through the area as Yuan's fist collided with Keling's bow.
Keling tried to withstand the impact, but the force behind the blow was so overwhelmingly powerful that she was instantly sent flying backward.
"Cough!"
After barely steadying herself, Keling coughed up a mouthful of blood, her arms trembling numbly from the impact.
'What monstrous strength! That single exchange alone shattered the bones in my arms! Could he also possess a giant's bloodline?'
Keling could not help but suspect that giant blood flowed through Yuan's veins as well, as it was the only explanation she could think of for such absurd physical power.
"What are you waiting for?" Keling asked Yuan a moment later when Yuan stopped moving entirely.
"Sorry, I didn't expect your arms to break so easily," Yuan said calmly. "I'll wait until you've recovered."
"This bastard..."
Keling trembled in fury as veins bulged across her forehead. In her entire life, she had never encountered anyone even remotely as irritating as Yuan.
Of course, Yuan did not intentionally belittle Keling and was genuinely surprised by how "fragile" she was.
What Yuan didn't know was that Keling was actually renowned for possessing a nearly indestructible body.
"Stop looking down on me!" Keling roared as she poured a tremendous amount of Celestial Qi into her bow, causing it to transform and rapidly grow in size.
"Is that really still a bow...?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at its new form, which now resembled a massive ballista more than an actual bow.
"Arrow Stream!"
In the very next instant, arrows began firing from the massive ballista like a turret, thousands of projectiles hurtling toward Yuan every second.
In response, Yuan raised his index and middle fingers, surrounding them with Supreme Sword Aura. Then, using his fingers as though they were a sword, Yuan began slicing through the incoming arrows.
His arms flickered at such incredible speed that countless afterimages appeared, making it seem as though he possessed multiple arms at once.
"Blink Arrow!"
Keling swiftly retrieved another bow and fired it at Yuan.
The moment the arrow left the bowstring, it vanished from sight. Then, as though it had teleported through space itself, it suddenly reappeared behind Yuan and shot toward his head.
However, just as the arrow was a mere millimeter away from piercing through Yuan's head, it suddenly vanished once again.
"Agh!"
Keling screamed in pain as a burning sensation erupted from her right thigh. When she looked down, her eyes widened to find a clean hole pierced through her leg.
'He used Void Manipulation on my technique?!'
Keling cried inwardly, fear surfacing in her eyes as she realized that Yuan's mastery of Void Manipulation had reached a realm she had never even heard of before.
"Let's stop here. I'd feel bad for Meixiu if I beat her master up too badly, and you still need to preserve some dignity."
Yuan spoke casually, but instead of calming Keling down, his words only enraged her even further.
Keling's eyes turned crimson as her body rapidly expanded in size until she resembled a true giant.
Seeing this, Yuan smiled and said, "Alright, I'll give you one final chance to injure me."
Keling gathered every bit of Celestial Qi she could muster and poured it into her bow. Then, she spat a mouthful of blood onto it, causing a crimson arrow to slowly take shape shortly afterward.
"DIE!" she roared.
The crimson arrow shot forth from the bow with unstoppable force.
Yet, despite the terrifying attack hurtling toward him, Yuan remained perfectly still, showing no intention of dodging or even attempting to block it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2490 Visiting the Grand Library as the Divine Paragon
paragraphs: 'What the hell is he doing?!' Keling cried inwardly when Yuan made no attempt to react to her attack.
Even if she wanted to withdraw the shot now, it was already far too late. Almost the instant the arrow left the bow, it arrived directly before Yuan's forehead.
Yet, the moment the arrow struck Yuan's forehead, it did not pierce through his skull as Keling had imagined. Instead, the arrow shattered into countless fragments before dispersing into thin air.
Meanwhile, Yuan remained completely unharmed, not even a scratch appearing on his forehead.
"No... way..." Keling's eyes widened with bewilderment, looking as though she'd just witnessed the impossible—something incomprehensible.
Her attack just now possessed enough power to destroy even a star, yet Yuan had taken it head-on with his forehead and emerged completely unscathed.
Such a thing should have been utterly impossible.
"You... what kind of physique do you have? And how in heaven's name did you temper it?" she asked after a long moment of silence.
Yuan shrugged and calmly replied, "Normally."
Keling fell to her knees and released a deep sigh, "It's my loss."
Yuan approached her afterward and said, "Sorry for belittling you. If I hadn't done that, you wouldn't have fought me seriously."
"It's fine," Keling replied with a bitter smile. "I'll just consider it the price I had to pay to broaden my horizons today."
She proceeded to consume a recovery pill, quickly healing her injuries and exhausted spiritual energy.
"I'll go spend some time with Meixiu now. Here's a little something you can do in the meantime," Yuan suddenly tapped her forehead, transferring several techniques directly into her mind.
"Wha-What are you...?" Keling stared at him in a daze.
"A little something to thank you for taking care of Meixiu."
After saying that, Yuan teleported to Meixiu using Void Manipulation.
"Are you done already?" Meixiu asked when she noticed that Yuan had returned.
He nodded, "Yes, we're done."
Shortly later, they disappeared into one of the guest houses available there to catch up.
While Meixiu recalled her training with Keling to him, Yuan told her everything he'd experienced within the Demonic Realm, as well as the truth behind demons and humans.
"So demons were once humans... and we... we might be clones?" Meixiu wore a dazed look on her face as she tried to digest this shocking revelation.
"I'm not sure how to react—if I even can—to this sort of information..." She shook her head, utterly speechless.
"However, it does make me wonder what the original humans were like, and why they went extinct."
"...Forget it. There's no point dwelling on something like this."

In the end, the information was so far beyond her comprehension that Meixiu decided it would be easier to pretend she had never heard it at all. After all, it wasn't as if there was anything she could do with this sort of information.
"How are the others doing?" Yuan then asked.
"Sorry, but I don't know. We haven't been in contact since we went our own way."
"I see..."
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.

"I know our reunion this time has been brief, and honestly, I would rather spend a few years with you before continuing my journey," Yuan said as he prepared to leave. "Unfortunately, the Demon Sealing Clan is waiting for me, and there is still far too much left for me to do."
"I know," Meixiu said with a gentle smile on her face.
They embraced, and after a passionate kiss, Yuan departed the world and returned to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, which could be accessed through the Myriad of Techniques.
Meanwhile, Meixiu went to Keling after Yuan left.
"Master...?" Meixiu raised her eyebrows when she saw Keling cultivating with a weird smile on her face.
"Hm? Do you need something from me?" Keling opened her eyes and asked after sensing Meixiu's presence.
"Yuan left," she said.
"So soon? Would it have killed him to spend a little more time with you?" Keling sighed aloud.
Although it sounded as though she was sympathizing with Meixiu, in reality, she simply wanted more time to study the techniques Yuan had given her.
"Don't blame him, Master. It really can't be helped, considering how many responsibilities he carries," Meixiu said, defending him.
"I'm not. I'm just saying," Keling shrugged before standing up.
"Alright. Let's continue your training... with some slight changes."
"What sort of changes?"
"I will be training with you," she said with a smile.
At the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, Yan Hara greeted Yuan the moment he entered the place.
She lowered her head, greeting him with a casual but respectful nod.
"How are your injuries?" Yuan immediately asked.
"I'm pretty much fully recovered," she replied with a smile.
"Good. Let's go. I have a lot to tell you all."
"I'll lead you to the others," said Yan Hara as she turned around and began walking.
Inside the Grand Library's courtyard, every Demon Sealer from both the Demon Sealing Clan and the Demon Sealing Grotto had gathered together, anxiously awaiting the Divine Paragon's arrival.
"You witnessed the Divine Paragon fighting demons, right? What was it like?"
"It felt like a dream."
The Demon Sealers chatted amongst themselves as they waited.
"I wish I could've been there..."
"Don't be ridiculous. As incredible as it must've been to witness the Divine Paragon slaughter hundreds of demons, it was still a life-and-death situation where many Demon Sealers lost their lives."
"I wonder why he gathered all of us."
"I bet it's to reprimand us..."
"That's... very possible."
The Demon Sealers swallowed nervously, realizing how much they had strayed from their purpose.
Suddenly, someone shouted, "The Divine Paragon has arrived!"
Hearing this, everyone immediately stopped talking and straightened their backs.
In the next moment, Yan Hara and Yuan entered the courtyard together.
The Demon Sealers instantly dropped to their knees and bowed toward him with utmost reverence.
"We greet the Divine Paragon!"
They shouted in unison with such overwhelming excitement that even the air seemed to tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 2491 Lecturing the Demon Sealers
paragraphs: "We greet the Divine Paragon!"

Yuan could feel the very air vibrating from their voices alone, yet he offered no response and calmly walked down the path they had left open for him, eventually arriving before a raised platform where a majestic chair awaited.
He calmly took his seat while Yan Hara stood beside him like a loyal aide.
After briefly sweeping his gaze across the scene, Yuan finally spoke, "Be at ease."
The Demon Sealers raised their heads at command and stood up a moment later.
"Before I begin," Yuan started speaking shortly after, "Allow me to introduce myself, even if all of you already know me to some extent."

"My name is Tian Chenyu, the first leader of the Demon Sealing Clan. Many of you know me as the Divine Paragon, but quite frankly, I don't like it. It is too grand for someone like me. So from now on, if you wish to address me directly, use my name."

The Demon Sealers listened with dazed expressions, their eyes flickering with awe as they subconsciously examined Yuan's appearance and compared it to the statue of the Divine Paragon that had stood within the Grand Library for as long as they could remember.
"First and foremost, let me address the current state of the Demon Sealing Clan and you Demon Sealers," Yuan continued.

"Although the Demon Sealing Clan has always been somewhat disorganized—even during my era—it was never this chaotic. Demon Sealers respected one another and would willingly risk their lives for each other, regardless of whether they had argued or even fought the day before."
He paused briefly before his gaze sharpened.
"Meanwhile, compared to them, all of you are like a group of children pretending to be Demon Sealers. Frankly speaking, it is both deeply disappointing and disgraceful."
A heavy atmosphere instantly descended upon the Grand Library as every Demon Sealer subconsciously lowered their heads like children being scolded, none daring to meet Yuan's gaze any longer.

"Even if demons are no longer the overwhelming threat they once were, that does not mean they are harmless or incapable of threatening the world again. As long as you bear the title of Demon Sealer, your highest priority should always be dealing with demons.
Yuan's gaze turned colder as he continued, "Yet all of you are too busy fighting amongst yourselves, treating the Demon Sealing Clan like some sort of joke."
"Not only did you bastards turn the Demon Sealing Clan into a complete mess, but you even allowed someone like Qian Chu to become your leader. Are none of you ashamed of yourselves?"
Despite his harsh criticism, not a single Demon Sealer dared to speak up.
After a moment of silence, Yuan continued, "Why are you all staying silent? I want you to say something, even if it's just excuses. You're not mute, after all."
Eventually, one of the Demon Sealers who used to be Qian Chu's supporters raised his hand, requesting to speak.
Yuan shifted his gaze to the man and said, "Speak."
"N-None of us could've anticipated Qian Chu would work with the demons like this. He was an exemplary Demon Sealer in the past, working harder than anyone to reach his position."
"An exemplary Demon Sealer?" Yuan sneered.
"Had any of you even bothered to examine him, we wouldn't have this situation. After all, Qian Chu is not human."
"W-What?!"
The Demon Sealers exclaimed in shock at Yuan's claims.
"He was a demon this entire time?! That's impossible! He can wield Demon Sealing Aura, and it can only be wielded by humans!"

Yuan shook his head and explained, "Qian Chu is not a demon, but neither is he human. He is similar to the artificial demons you created, though far more advanced and sophisticated—a product born from the Demonic Realm itself."

"As for why he can use Demon Sealing Aura..." Yuan closed his eyes and released a low sigh before continuing, "He did not learn it through normal means, but through sacrifices. His kind cultivates by consuming others, turning their powers into their own like parasites.
"That's..."
The courtyard fell silent once again as the Demon Sealers pondered this information.
"Now that I think about it, Demon Sealers have started disappearing around the time he joined," muttered one of the more senior Demon Sealers, who had been there even before Qian Chu.
"Did you investigate their disappearance?" Yuan asked.
The Demon Sealer lowered his head and replied in a shameful voice, "No... I simply assumed they had given up on being Demon Sealers, since anyone is free to join or leave whenever they wish."

The Demon Sealing Clan was more akin to a volunteer organization, its members consisting mostly of people who willingly chose to fight demons. Although recruitment did occur occasionally, it was exceedingly rare.

However, even outside of this situation, people disappearing or dying was not uncommon. Such incidents were not exclusive to the Demon Sealing Clan and occurred throughout the world all the time—especially within sects, where death was practically an everyday occurrence.

"I won't blame you for failing to investigate," Yuan said as he shook his head, "but had you exercised even a little diligence, perhaps you could have exposed Qian Chu before he became the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan and began slaughtering his own people behind the scenes."
"I will also broaden all of your understanding today," he continued with a solemn expression. "Demons... are actually capable of wielding Demon Sealing Aura."

The Demon Sealers' eyes widened with shock and disbelief at the sudden revelation. Had those words come from anyone else, none of them would have believed it for even a moment. However, because it was the Divine Paragon speaking, not a single person questioned it and accepted it immediately.
"Before I explain that, I should first reveal the truth behind the demons' existence—where they came from, why they invaded us, and the current situation within the Demonic Realm."
Yuan's gaze swept across the silent crowd before he continued, "Today, I will reveal everything to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 2492 Revealing the Truth of the Demonic Realm
paragraphs: Yuan took a deep breath before speaking, "What you learn today will change your entire perspective of demons, and some might not even believe me because of how ridiculous it sounds. Unfortunately, everything I say from now on is the truth."
The Demon Sealers swallowed nervously after seeing the grave expression on Yuan's face.

After a moment of silence, Yuan began, "When demons first appeared, no one knew where they had come from, and most assumed they originated from the Starry Sky. In reality, however, they came from the Demonic Realm—a place long believed to have been 'created' by the first demon, the Red Tyrant, as a sanctuary for demonkind."

"Not only did the Red Tyrant not create the Demonic Realm, but their world has existed long before the Nine Heavens. As for the demons that came to our world... they did not come here by choice and were chased away from their own home."
The Demon Sealers' eyes widened with surprise at this revelation, but they remained silent.

"As you all probably know by now, I have been inside the Demonic Realm since my disappearance, and I have learned a lot about their kind and history while I was there. I thought I learned a lot about them during my first visit to the Demonic Realm, but it turns out that I was still a frog in a well and that I didn't know them as much as I thought."

"Anyway, within the Demonic Realm, there exist two kinds of demons. The first kind is the one all of you are familiar with—bloodthirsty, cruel, and heinous fiends that bathe themselves in the blood of innocents. They are the ones who enslaved our world during the Demonic Era, and they are the ones that must be annihilated."
"Then there is the second kind of demons..."

After a brief pause, Yuan continued, "To be frank, I do not know how else to describe them aside from 'human,' because aside from their demonic appearance, they are no different from us. These demons possess emotions, reason, and self-control just like humans do."
"WHAT?!"
Multiple people cried out in shock and disbelief upon hearing such a revelation.

However, Yuan ignored the commotion and continued, "The first kind of demons are known as 'Forsaken' within the Demonic Realm. They terrorize their own people just as they once terrorized us, which is why they are all captured and confined within a place similar to the Primordial Realm—forever imprisoned and separated from the rest of the population."

"Quite frankly, Forsakens are not all that different from the criminals and monsters that we, as a normal and peaceful society, must deal with. No matter how many good apples there are, there will always be rotten ones who steal, murder, and commit all sorts of heinous acts."

Yuan sighed before continuing, "In our world, those who commit crimes are either imprisoned or executed. However, the peaceful demons only truly have one option... imprisonment, since demons, especially powerful ones, are not so easy to kill.
"Furthermore, any demon—regardless of how peaceful or righteous they may be—has a chance of turning into a Forsaken. It is somewhat akin to an incurable disease."

"Although the Demonic Realm is vast—far larger than the Nine Heavens—their immortality has led to severe overpopulation and a shortage of resources. Because of this, they chose to send the Forsaken far away beyond their world... unknowingly sending them to ours."
Yuan paused briefly before continuing, "Before my first visit to the Demonic Realm, they were completely unaware of our existence, just as we knew nothing about them."
"I will now give you some time to digest this information before I continue," he said before falling silent.
"There's still more?!" The Demon Sealers were bewildered.
Soon, they started chatting amongst themselves.
"So demons are not that different from us..."
"Shit... what the hell are we supposed to do with this sort of information?"
Someone raised their hand and asked, "Divine Paragon, I have a question!"
Yuan looked at the man and muttered, "Who?"
"...Senior Tian! I have a question!"
Yuan nodded with a smile, "Ask away."
"What is the... your purpose for telling us this information? It feels like you are trying to change our perception of their existence, as if there is a chance we might co-exist in the future.
"Oh?" Yuan raised an eyebrow, looking somewhat surprised by their question. "How perceptive of you. What is your name?"
"This humble junior is named Zhou Yanfei, the current leader of the Demon Sealing Grotto! We are—"
"I am aware of the Demon Sealing Grotto," Yuan interrupted.

"As for your question... I will get straight to the point. I cannot say what may or may not happen in the future, as I am no fortune teller. However, I do have a feeling that our interactions with the Demonic Realm will become far more frequent moving forward. After all, during my time trapped within the Demonic Realm, I met and spoke with their leaders personally."

Another Demon Sealer raised their hand and asked, "Even if there are 'human-like' demons, I don't think it's possible for us to coexist with them—especially after everything that has happened. And if ordinary demons can become Forsaken at any moment, wouldn't that make them even more dangerous?"
Yuan then said, "Only time will tell whether or not we can truly accept them. As for the Forsaken... if they appear, then we simply slay them."

He paused briefly before continuing, "After all, we already coexist with magical beasts, even though the vast majority of them lack intelligence and act purely on wild instinct—much like the Forsaken."
When Yuan compared the Forsaken to magical beasts, many of the people present could immediately see the resemblance.
However, while magical beasts had always existed within their world, demons were essentially foreign beings from another realm, making them far more difficult to accept.
"If you need another reason to accept them..." Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breath before revealing the biggest revelation yet.
"Demons... were originally humans."

chapters.title: Chapter 2493 The True Origin of Demons
paragraphs: Everyone present wore expressions of bewilderment and disbelief as they struggled to process what Yuan had just revealed to them, and even Yan Hara stared at him with wide eyes.

Yuan cleared his throat and repeated, "You heard me correctly. The demons from the Demonic Realm used to be human just like us, but after a certain incident that I will not delve into for reasons, they have all turned into the demonic beings they are today."
The Demon Sealers exchanged glances with one another, yet not a single person uttered a word, as they were all far too shocked by this revelation.

Eventually, someone nervously raised their hand and asked, "S-Senior Tian... why won't you explain something this important in greater detail? You can't just drop such a massive revelation on us and leave it at that!"
"I also think so! If you're going to tell us this, you might as well tell us everything! We can handle the truth!"
Yuan shook his head and said, "This is not a matter of accepting the truth. I am not revealing it for a good reason."
Seeing the stubborn look on Yuan's face, the Demon Sealers quickly gave up on learning more.
Some time later, Yuan continued, "Now that I have revealed the truth about demons, allow me to tell you more about the Demonic Realm and their society."
"The Demonic Realm is separated into three major regions. The Bone Atoll, Death Paradise, and Crimson Continent, with the vast majority of demons dwelling within the Crimson Continent."
"Each region is ruled by its own ruler—the Supreme Ruler. If you want a comparison, they are akin to the Celestial Emperor, but there are three of them."
After revealing as much as he could about the Demonic Realm, Yuan asked everyone there, "Do I have any questions?"
After a long moment of silence, someone spoke up.
"Um... What is going to happen now?"
Yuan turned his head to the side to look at Yan Hara.
"What are you referring to?
"The Demonic Realm... and the Forsakens that are still running rampant in our world. Are you going to reseal the Demonic Realm?"

Yuan nodded and said, "I will replace the seal on the Demonic Realm for now—at least until the entire world knows the truth about them. As for the Forsakens still in our world... I will hunt each and every single one of them until there is none left."

After a brief pause, he continued, "That said, I will not be hunting them personally. During my time in the Demonic Realm, I have made some unexpected friends, and they will be the ones to hunt them."
"D-Demons...?" someone asked in a nervous voice.
Yuan looked directly into his eyes and calmly replied, "Yes."

Multiple audible gulps echoed throughout the area as the Demon Sealers swallowed nervously at his response. None of them could have ever imagined that the Divine Paragon—the very person most obsessed with slaying demons—would one day befriend them instead.
Even if these demons were different from Forsakens, it was still shocking.
"Can they be trusted?" another questioned in a stiff voice.
"I trust them, but if they harm even a single innocent human, I will personally slay them," Yuan replied in a cold voice.
"W-Where are they right now?"
"They are already working hard to clean up the Forsaken in our world."
"Already...?"
After a few more questions, Yan Hara spoke again, "What about the Demon Sealing Clan? Will you return to being our leader?"

The entire Grand Library instantly fell silent as everyone turned to stare at Yuan with anticipation written all over their faces, clearly hoping he would lead them once more and allow them to experience what it was like serving under a living legend.
However, Yuan sneered disdainfully and said, "Why the hell would I take on something so troublesome?"
"Eh?"
Yan Hara and many others stared at him in shock, clearly caught off guard by his unexpected response.

"Even back then, I never wanted to become the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan. That position was practically forced onto me by the other Demon Sealers. Although I have returned, my era is long gone. If anyone is going to be the leader, it should be you, who fought with your life on the line."
"B-But...
"There is no but," Yuan interrupted. "Not only have you received my legacy, but you are more than qualified to lead the Demon Sealing Clan with your skills."
Yan Hara turned to look at the crowd, uncertain whether they would truly accept her as their leader while the Divine Paragon himself was sitting right beside her.
"To the new leader of the Demon Sealing Clan, Yan Hara!" someone suddenly shouted, triggering an immediate chain reaction throughout the crowd.
"Leader Yan! Leader Yan! Leader Yan!"
Tears streamed down Yan Hara's cheeks as the majority of the Demon Sealers present began chanting her name.
Of course, there were still a few who opposed her—mostly those who had once supported Qian Chu.
Suddenly, Yuan slightly raised his hand.
In an instant, the entire crowd fell deathly silent.
"I wanted to deal with this at the beginning, but I somehow forgot."

He slowly swept his gaze across the crowd before speaking in a cold voice, "Those of you who are not true Demon Sealers and are merely on Qian Chu's payroll—or his spies—I'll give you five seconds to get the hell out."
"If you leave of your own accord, I will pretend you never existed. However, if you continue contaminating this sanctuary with your presence, I will personally seal you for a thousand years..."
A chilling smile appeared on Yuan's face as he continued, "...if I don't forget about you and leave you sealed for eternity."
Almost everyone present felt a chill run down their spine after hearing those words.
Even though it was common knowledge that Demon Sealing Aura only worked on demons, not a single person there doubted Yuan's threat for even a moment.
"Your timer starts now..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2494 Dealing With Qian Chu's Spies
paragraphs: "Five..."
The moment Yuan began counting down, several individuals within the crowd immediately started scrambling toward the exits, shoving their way through the others in panic.
"Four..."
Seeing this, even more people hurriedly followed after them.
"Three..."
By the time Yuan reached three, over a hundred Demon Sealers had run out of the Grand Library.

As Yuan finished the countdown, everyone present swallowed nervously and waited in tense silence, eager to see what he would do next—and how exactly he intended to distinguish the spies from the genuine Demon Sealers.
Without any warning, Yuan activated Swords of Eternal Torment, causing around seventy swords to materialize high above the crowd.
Before the people present could even fully raise their heads to look at them, the swords suddenly descended, shooting toward specific individuals within the crowd.

The swords caused no pain despite piercing deep into their bodies. However, their bodies rapidly began to turn to stone, the petrification spreading so quickly that they could not even scream or utter a single word before becoming stone statues.
The Demon Sealers trembled in fear as they witnessed humans being sealed for the very first time, and they slowly turned to look at Yuan, as though expecting an explanation from him.
However, Yuan offered none. Instead, he coldly commanded, "Move them somewhere far from my sight."
Those standing near the sealed spies immediately began dragging them away, moving almost entirely on instinct.

A few moments later, Yuan continued, "Although Demon Sealing Aura is not particularly effective against humans, that does not mean we are completely immune to it. And as you all just witnessed, if the Demon Sealing Aura is powerful enough, it can even seal humans."
"With that being said, unless you are me, you won't be able to seal anyone.
After another brief moment of silence, Yuan turned to Yan Hara and asked, "I heard I've received several invitations?"

She nodded and replied, "After news of your return spread, countless people and organizations throughout the Nine Heavens sent invitations requesting you to visit them. They claim they wish to personally thank you for everything you did in the past. Are you going to respond to them?"
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding with a faint smile, "Sure, let's give them a response."
"Who do you wish to reply to? Even the Celestial Emperor has sent an invitation," Yan Hara said.
The smile on Yuan's face widened slightly as he replied, "Instead of responding to just one of them, why not answer all of them at once? In the end, they all want to meet me, don't they?"
He leaned back in his chair before continuing, "Then let's do exactly that. Spread the word throughout the Nine Heavens that I will be hosting a banquet, and anyone who wishes to attend may come."
Yan Hara's jaw dropped at his words, and she hastily asked, "W-Where and when should we hold this banquet? With the Stairway to Heaven gone, it'll be difficult for everyone to arrive."
Yuan stood up and said, "I'll leave everything to you, Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan."
Then, he stepped off the platform and began walking toward the exit.
"I have somewhere I need to go. I'll return in a few weeks."
The Demon Sealers silently watched Yuan's departing figure. However, just as he reached the doorway, he suddenly stopped and spoke once more without turning around.
"Oh, right. For the time being, refrain from revealing what I told you all today to the public. It will be far more believable coming from me, and I intend to announce everything during the banquet."
With that said, Yuan left the Grand Library.
Everyone present slowly turned to look at Yan Hara, who remained standing atop the platform with a stunned expression on her face.

After taking a moment to gather her thoughts and calm her emotions, Yan Hara cleared her throat before speaking aloud, "Although I may still be inexperienced, I will do my utmost to fulfill my role as the Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan. So... please bear with me for the time being.
"Hahaha! What are you talking about, Senior Yan? We're the ones who'll be troubling you from now on!" Zhou Yanfei suddenly burst into laughter.

"Since we're all gathered here already, I might as well announce this right now. Listen well, everyone! Starting today, the Demon Sealing Grotto will officially disband and reintegrate into the Demon Sealing Clan once again!"
The Demon Sealing Grotto's Demon Sealers cheered loudly to declare their support.

Yan Hara then spoke with a determined look on her face, "Although the Divine Paragon has returned, that does not mean we can afford to become complacent. Not only are there still demons lurking out there, but demon worshippers continue to run rampant as well."
She raised her voice with renewed resolve, "So let's get back to work and show the Divine Paragon that we are not useless!"
The entire Grand Library rumbled as the Demon Sealers roared in unison, their voices filled with excitement, passion, and newfound resolve.
Shortly afterward, the Demon Sealers departed from the Grand Library and returned to their respective realms to continue their duties.
Meanwhile, Yan Hara responded to every individual and organization that had sent Yuan an invitation, informing them about the banquet he intended to host.
"This Divine Paragon is more arrogant and daring than I expected..." the Celestial Emperor muttered after receiving the response.
"Are you going to personally attend?" someone asked.
"I'll think about it."
While Yan Hara did not mention a date for the banquet, almost everyone started preparing for it.
Meanwhile, after leaving the Grand Library, Yuan went to meet with Lev and the others, who had been waiting for him at a specific location.
"Y-Yuan! What have you done?!"
A tall and muscular man confronted Yuan the moment he arrived.
"Relax, Kelan. I've already explained the situation to Senior Bai."
Since he was in the Seventh Heaven, he decided to send Lev and the others to the Super Perfect Physique Tempering Sect.
