After taking a moment to gather her thoughts and calm her emotions, Yan Hara cleared her throat before speaking aloud, "Although I may still be inexperienced, I will do my utmost to fulfill my role as the Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan.
So... please bear with me for the time being.
"Hahaha!
What are you talking about, Senior Yan?
We're the ones who'll be troubling you from now on!" Zhou Yanfei suddenly burst into laughter.
"Since we're all gathered here already, I might as well announce this right now.
Listen well, everyone!
Starting today, the Demon Sealing Grotto will officially disband and reintegrate into the Demon Sealing Clan once again!"
The Demon Sealing Grotto's Demon Sealers cheered loudly to declare their support.
Yan Hara then spoke with a determined look on her face, "Although the Divine Paragon has returned, that does not mean we can afford to become complacent.
Not only are there still demons lurking out there, but demon worshippers continue to run rampant as well."
She raised her voice with renewed resolve, "So let's get back to work and show the Divine Paragon that we are not useless!"
The entire Grand Library rumbled as the Demon Sealers roared in unison, their voices filled with excitement, passion, and newfound resolve.
Shortly afterward, the Demon Sealers departed from the Grand Library and returned to their respective realms to continue their duties.
Meanwhile, Yan Hara responded to every individual and organization that had sent Yuan an invitation, informing them about the banquet he intended to host.
"This Divine Paragon is more arrogant and daring than I expected..." the Celestial Emperor muttered after receiving the response.
"Are you going to personally attend?" someone asked.
"I'll think about it."
While Yan Hara did not mention a date for the banquet, almost everyone started preparing for it.
Meanwhile, after leaving the Grand Library, Yuan went to meet with Lev and the others, who had been waiting for him at a specific location.
"Y-Yuan!
What have you done?!"
A tall and muscular man confronted Yuan the moment he arrived.
"Relax, Kelan.
I've already explained the situation to Senior Bai."
Since he was in the Seventh Heaven, he decided to send Lev and the others to the Super Perfect Physique Tempering Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 2495 Change of Plans
paragraphs: Kelan rubbed his eyes in frustration for a moment before speaking, "I'm glad you spoke with Senior Bai, but that doesn't change the situation. Do you even realize how much trouble you're in right now?"
"I don't." Yuan calmly shook his head.
"Then listen carefully! Almost everyone within the faction blames you for what happened to our karma, so nearly everyone who isn't on Celestial Overlord Xu's side is hunting you down right now!"
"Is that so?"
Despite being hunted by one of the most powerful factions in the Nine Heavens, Yuan showed neither surprise nor fear, appearing unnaturally nonchalant about the entire situation.
"I don't know if you're just pretending not to care or if you're genuinely that fearless, but your actions don't only affect you—they also affect Celestial Overlord Xu and everyone who supports her—"
"I am aware, and I will fix it as soon as possible."
"And how are you going to do that?"
Yuan remained silent, causing Kelan to frown.
A moment later, realizing that Yuan had no intention of explaining himself, Kelan released a helpless sigh.

"I am eternally grateful to you for giving me the Great Mammoth Body Refinement Technique, so I sincerely hope you'll be able to resolve this situation somehow. For now, I'll just continue to trust you and see how things turn out."
Yuan nodded, "Thanks."
"Anyways, your friends are waiting for you at your old residence."
"What?" Kelan asked when Yuan stared at him in silence.
"You're not going to ask any questions about them?"

A grin suddenly appeared on Kelan's face as he replied, "What kind of questions? Even if they're your new lovers, it is none of my business. That being said, do Meixiu and the others know about them?"
Yuan shook his head and sighed, "They're not my lovers. I mean, aren't you going to question why I have demons following me around?
"What did you just say?"
The grin on Kelan's face immediately disappeared when he heard the word 'demon'.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and questioned in a somewhat awkward voice, "You... didn't know? Did you not see their appearance?"
"I did! But they didn't look like demons to me! Aren't demons supposed to have red skin?!"
Kelan continued in disbelief, "That group's skin was as pale as a sheet of paper! Sure, I suspected they weren't human, but I never would've thought they were demons!"
"Not all demons have red skin," Yuan explained. "Anyways, they are demons, but don't worry—they're friendly."
"Demons? Friendly?" Kelan stared at him with a strange look on his face. "That's quite the absurd thing to say, even coming from you."
"It may sound absurd now, but soon, you'll understand."

"This isn't a matter of understanding..." Kelan said with a worried expression. "Didn't you hear? The Divine Paragon—the founder of the Demon Sealing Clan and a lunatic who devoted his life to hunting demons—has returned after being missing for millions of years. If he discovers that you're working with demons, this definitely won't end well for you..."
"Worst-case scenario, you'll be branded as a traitor to humanity."
Yuan burst out laughing, dumbfounding Kelan.
"The Divine Paragon won't come after me," he said in a confident voice. "Once again, you'll understand it soon enough."
"We can continue chatting later. I need to speak with my friends now."
Without another word, Yuan flew away, leaving Kelan behind with a dazed look on his face.
"That crazy bastard..." Kelan sighed in a low voice.

Meanwhile, inside the residence Yuan had stayed at during his previous visit, Lev and the others had been waiting ever since leaving the Demonic Realm, guided by the Demon Annihilation Sword, which was capable of receiving Yuan's instructions even from afar.
"Master."
The Demon Annihilation Sword greeted Yuan at the door.
Once inside, Lev and the others greeted him.
"About time. If you had been any slower, I would've explored the world on my own," Angela remarked.
Yuan looked at her and replied, "Aren't you an immortal who has lived for hundreds of billions of years? Yet you can't sit still for a mere few days?"
"I can't help it! I've just gotten my freedom back after so long, after all!"
"I understand her feelings," Selena said, joining in on the conversation.
Yuan sighed and said, "Since you want to leave so badly, I will keep this short and get straight to the point."
"I want the three of you to fulfill your duty and eradicate every single Forsaken in this world. Until that task is complete, you are not allowed to wander around and fully enjoy this world."
Yuan smiled faintly and added, "So the faster you finish, the sooner you'll be free to explore this world at your own pace."
"It's only a matter of cleaning up some trash. We'll be done in no time," Helena said confidently.
"How long do you think it'll take?" Yuan asked.

Selena answered, "Over the past few days, I've searched for the Forsaken's presence throughout this world and detected a total of around two hundred thousand, with seventy thousand, five hundred and twenty-one within this realm alone, most of them concentrated in the same region."
She paused briefly before continuing, "If we take this seriously, I estimate it will take roughly two weeks—three at most—to eradicate them completely."
"That fast?" Yuan stared at her with a stunned expression.

Angela shrugged and said, "Since this world is divided into nine separate realms and traveling between them takes time, most of that time will be spent on that alone. Otherwise, wiping them out would only take us a single day."
"Quite frankly, I expected it would take at least a few years. However, if it'll only take a month at most, I'll have to push my schedule up a bit, perhaps even change it entirely."
After pondering for a moment, Yuan asked, "Are you capable of controlling the Forsaken?"
"We are."
They nodded.
A profound smile tugged at Yuan's lips upon hearing this, and he quickly said, "Change of plans. Rather than killing all of them, I want you to round them up for me."

chapters.title: Chapter 2496 Pseudo Eternal
paragraphs: "Round them up? So you want us to capture them?" Selena asked with a raised eyebrow.
"No. I want the three of you to become their new leaders."
"Does that mean you no longer intend to kill them?" Angela then asked.
"Of course not," Yuan replied calmly. "They will definitely die eventually, but before that, I want them to actually serve some purpose."
He then added, "Once you've gathered all of them together, wait for my instructions."

The Transcendents exchanged glances with one another. Although capturing the Forsaken would undoubtedly be far more troublesome than simply slaughtering them outright, they could not care less about the extra effort.
As long as it allowed them to explore this new world and truly enjoy their newfound freedom, they were willing to do it.
"Is there anything else before we begin?" Angela asked.
"Oh, right." Yuan suddenly recalled something. "Among those demons should be a homunculus. Don't touch him."
A faint smile appeared on his face as he continued, "He intends to summon an 'Ancient,' and I want to see how exactly he plans on accomplishing that."
"Summoning one of us?" Helena muttered in a puzzled voice, hearing about such a thing for the first time.
She then shook her head and said, "That's impossible. Especially for something like a mere homunculus."

"Whether he is capable or not doesn't matter. I just want to see what he does. Besides that, avoid contact with other humans and try not to reveal your cultivation, as the realm of Absolute God doesn't exist in this world yet."
They silently nodded in acknowledgment.
Shortly afterward, the three Transcendents departed to carry out their duties.
Yuan then turned to look at Lev and the other individual beside him.
"What should I do?" Lev asked.
"Quite frankly, I'm not sure," Yuan admitted. "At first, I intended to have you assist with the cleanup, but that no longer seems necessary."
"If you'd like, you can explore this world for the time being."
While Lev wasn't as excited to explore the Nine Heavens, it didn't mean he had no interest in it.
"In that case, I'll take a look around until you need me."
"What about me?" another voice asked.
Yuan turned to look at the crimson-haired beauty standing before him and said, "The same applies to you, Dena."
Right before they departed from the Demonic Realm, Dena had emerged from her seclusion and successfully ascended, becoming a Transcendent herself.
"I want your blood," she said.
"Even though you're now a Transcendent?" Yuan raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"What does that have to do with me wanting your blood? You promised to give it to me after I finish my ascension. Moreover, I might become even stronger afterward."
"Are you sure...?" he asked again.
"Save your breath. My answer will remain the same no matter how many times you ask."
After a moment of silence, Yuan released a defeated sigh and said, "Very well."
He then opened a wound on his palm and gathered enough blood to make a fist-sized sphere before offering it to Dena.
"Whenever you are ready."
Dena closed her eyes and spread her arms wide in a welcoming manner.
"Ready," she mumbled softly.
Upon hearing her confirmation, Yuan gestured toward her, causing the sphere of blood to surge forward and penetrate her skin before flowing directly into her veins.
Dena accepted the blood without flinching or making a sound, quietly savoring the strange sensation of foreign blood flowing through her veins for the very first time.

Although it might not seem particularly significant at first glance, this moment marked the very first time in history that a Supreme Ruler had willingly accepted another person's blood in such a manner.
Furthermore, Dena was not just any Supreme Ruler, but the strongest one in history.
Suddenly, Dena spoke in a strained voice, "It's not enough... I need more blood!"
Even though he had already given her several times more blood than he'd given Lev and the others, Yuan did not hesitate for even a moment and continued pouring more of his blood into her body.
"N-Not enough! No matter how much blood I absorb, it still feels like something is missing!" Dena shouted in frustration.
'Something is missing...?'
Yuan frowned slightly, not immediately understanding what she meant.
Then, Yuan began carefully examining her body to determine what exactly was happening within her.
'This is...
A hint of surprise appeared in Yuan's eyes when he discovered something inside her body that had not existed before.
'Did this appear after her ascension?' he wondered inwardly.
Although Yuan was not entirely certain what it was, the discovery helped him understand what Dena meant by something being 'missing'.
Without any hesitation, he immediately began infusing Eternal Essence into the blood he was feeding her.
Almost immediately, Dena began reacting to it.
The mysterious thing within Dena's body began absorbing Yuan's Eternal Essence, steadily filling itself with the energy.
Once it became completely saturated, it suddenly transformed, branching out into vein-like structures that intertwined with her existing veins and heart without fully merging with them.
<'Supreme Ruler Dena' has accepted your blood!>
<You have turned 'Supreme Ruler Dena' into your Demonic Servant!>
"How do you feel?" Yuan asked afterward.
However, Dena did not respond. She merely stood there with her eyes closed, motionless and silent, as though she had suddenly fallen asleep.
Suddenly—
<Congratulations! You have successfully created a Pseudo Eternal!>
"A what?" Yuan's eyes widened at the notification before him.
Dena slowly opened her eyes the next moment.
As she took a deep breath, Yuan immediately sensed a faint trace of Eternal Essence exuding from her body.
'No way...'
"This feeling coursing through my body..." Dena mumbled. "It feels exactly the same as that thing I consumed in the past..."
Yuan stared at her with a dumbfounded expression, wondering what exactly differentiated a Pseudo Eternal from an incomplete one.
Dena raised her arm and stared at her hand with a curious expression before suddenly releasing Eternal Essence from her palm.
Seeing this, Yuan's expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly shouted, "Stop!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2497 Pseudo Eternal(2)
paragraphs: "?!?!" Dena was taken by surprise when Yuan abruptly grabbed her hand, stopping her from using Eternal Essence.
"This isn't a power that you should wield within the Nine Heavens," Yuan quickly explained.
"Why not—"
Just as Dena opened her mouth to inquire more details, she suddenly felt a painful sensation course through her body, as if assaulted by an invisible power.
"Cough!"
She coughed up a mouthful of blood the following moment.
"What just happened...?" She stared at the bloodied floor with a dazed look on her face.

Seeing this, Yuan released a helpless sigh before explaining, "To keep things simple, this world is protected by an otherworldly force known as the 'Absolute Power.' Within its influence, Eternal Essence—the power you just used—cannot be freely wielded without paying a tremendous price."
He narrowed his eyes and continued, "Even godly beings such as the Demon God are powerless before it."
"Even the Demon God...?" Dena swallowed nervously as she wiped the blood from her lips, her pupils trembling at the thought of such a mysterious and unfathomable power.
"But to be honest, that's not why I stopped you," Yuan admitted. "Since Eternal Essence is incredibly powerful, I was worried you might accidentally blow this place apart."
He then looked at her with a puzzled expression and added, "In fact, I didn't expect the Absolute Power to affect you at all."
"What do you mean?" Dena asked with her head tilted.
"I thought the Absolute Power only affected Eternals since I can wield Eternal Essence within the Nine Heavens without any issue," he said. "Perhaps it's because you're now a Pseudo Eternal."
"Pseudo Eternal? Me?" Dena pointed at herself with a dumbfounded face.
Yuan nodded and explained, "I'm not sure how, but after accepting my blood, you became one."
Dena pondered for a moment before responding, "Maybe it has something to do with that thing I consumed."
"Are you injured?" Yuan then asked.
"No, I am fine."
"Fortunately, you didn't use much Eternal Essence.
"But I didn't even use that much... In fact, I barely used it."
"That's why you got off easy with a warning."
After a brief moment of silence, Dena spoke again, a hint of curiosity in her voice, "What is its purpose? What is it trying to protect?"

Yuan shrugged and replied, "I'd like to know as well. All I know is that it was left behind by the most powerful existence to ever exist—the Absolute Being—and that countless Eternals are attempting to obtain it."
"You can obtain it?" Dena's eyes widened upon hearing this new information.
"That's what I've been told," Yuan replied. "Although nobody has actually seen it before, since it's completely invisible."
"What's the benefit of acquiring it?"
"Again, from what I've heard, you become the most powerful being in the universe."
After another moment of silence, an excited smile tugged at Dena's lips.
"I know what I want to do now," she said.
Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed out loud, "Don't tell me you want to look for the Absolute Power..."
"Is it that obvious?"
"I can understand why Eternals would seek to obtain it... But you?" Yuan looked at her with a puzzled expression. "What would you even do with that much power?"
"I don't know," Dena replied calmly. "Nor do I need a reason to pursue it. Ever since my birth, I've always strived for greater power. I suppose it's simply in my nature to seek strength."
A faint smile appeared on her face as he continued, "And what better goal is there than becoming the most powerful being in the universe?"
Yuan wanted to convince her otherwise, but he knew Dena better than anyone out there. Once she set her mind on something, changing it was nearly impossible.
Moreover, after thinking about it for a moment, he realized it was not necessarily a bad thing. Not only would it keep her occupied, but there was even a chance she might actually find it.
Yuan then turned to Lev and asked, "Do you want to accompany her? It would ease my worries a little if the two of you traveled together, considering you're both still unfamiliar with this world."
Lev immediately nodded his head and said, "Yes, I can go with her. I would also feel much safer with someone as powerful as her by my side."
"Good. Then it's decided. The two of you can search for the Absolute Power, and while you're at it, explore this world."
"Do you have any clues for us?" Lev then asked.
"Nope," Yuan replied without hesitation. "The Absolute Power is completely invisible to both senses and treasures, so you'd basically be searching for a ghost."
He then added, "The only thing I can tell you is that it won't be located within an artificial world and that it's somewhere within this world."
"Then how are we supposed to know if we come across it?" Dena asked.
"Beats me." Yuan simply shrugged.
"Are you messing with me?" Dena frowned, suspecting that he was being deliberately unhelpful because he disapproved of her decision to search for it.
"There's a reason nobody has managed to find it yet. If it were that easy, the Eternals would have already obtained it long ago," Yuan said with a sigh.

"That being said, the Absolute Power possesses the ability to weaken the influence of Eternals. Since you're now a Pseudo Eternal yourself, there's a chance you might sense something if you get close to it."
"Is that so..."
"Before you go... remember the rules I gave Selena and the others? They also apply to you two, so don't go around picking fights with people."
"What if someone picks a fight with us?" Dena asked with a serious expression.
"The vast majority of people in this world haven't even lived for a million years. Compared to you, they're basically infants," Yuan replied calmly. "So try your best to ignore them."
After a brief pause, he added, "And if they refuse to be ignored... then do what you think is right... without blowing things out of proportion."

sentences.text: "?!?!" Dena was taken by surprise when Yuan abruptly grabbed her hand, stopping her from using Eternal Essence.
"This isn't a power that you should wield within the Nine Heavens," Yuan quickly explained.
"Why not—"
Just as Dena opened her mouth to inquire more details, she suddenly felt a painful sensation course through her body, as if assaulted by an invisible power.
"Cough!"
She coughed up a mouthful of blood the following moment.
"What just happened...?" She stared at the bloodied floor with a dazed look on her face.

Seeing this, Yuan released a helpless sigh before explaining, "To keep things simple, this world is protected by an otherworldly force known as the 'Absolute Power.' Within its influence, Eternal Essence—the power you just used—cannot be freely wielded without paying a tremendous price."
He narrowed his eyes and continued, "Even godly beings such as the Demon God are powerless before it."
"Even the Demon God...?" Dena swallowed nervously as she wiped the blood from her lips, her pupils trembling at the thought of such a mysterious and unfathomable power.
"But to be honest, that's not why I stopped you," Yuan admitted.
"Since Eternal Essence is incredibly powerful, I was worried you might accidentally blow this place apart."
He then looked at her with a puzzled expression and added, "In fact, I didn't expect the Absolute Power to affect you at all."
"What do you mean?" Dena asked with her head tilted.
"I thought the Absolute Power only affected Eternals since I can wield Eternal Essence within the Nine Heavens without any issue," he said.
"Perhaps it's because you're now a Pseudo Eternal."
"Pseudo Eternal?
Me?" Dena pointed at herself with a dumbfounded face.
Yuan nodded and explained, "I'm not sure how, but after accepting my blood, you became one."
Dena pondered for a moment before responding, "Maybe it has something to do with that thing I consumed."
"Are you injured?" Yuan then asked.
"No, I am fine."
"Fortunately, you didn't use much Eternal Essence.
"But I didn't even use that much...
In fact, I barely used it."
"That's why you got off easy with a warning."
After a brief moment of silence, Dena spoke again, a hint of curiosity in her voice, "What is its purpose?
What is it trying to protect?"
Yuan shrugged and replied, "I'd like to know as well.
All I know is that it was left behind by the most powerful existence to ever exist—the Absolute Being—and that countless Eternals are attempting to obtain it."
"You can obtain it?" Dena's eyes widened upon hearing this new information.
"That's what I've been told," Yuan replied.
"Although nobody has actually seen it before, since it's completely invisible."
"What's the benefit of acquiring it?"
"Again, from what I've heard, you become the most powerful being in the universe."
After another moment of silence, an excited smile tugged at Dena's lips.
"I know what I want to do now," she said.
Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed out loud, "Don't tell me you want to look for the Absolute Power..."
"Is it that obvious?"
"I can understand why Eternals would seek to obtain it...
But you?" Yuan looked at her with a puzzled expression.
"What would you even do with that much power?"
"I don't know," Dena replied calmly.
"Nor do I need a reason to pursue it.
Ever since my birth, I've always strived for greater power.
I suppose it's simply in my nature to seek strength."
A faint smile appeared on her face as he continued, "And what better goal is there than becoming the most powerful being in the universe?"
Yuan wanted to convince her otherwise, but he knew Dena better than anyone out there.
Once she set her mind on something, changing it was nearly impossible.
Moreover, after thinking about it for a moment, he realized it was not necessarily a bad thing.
Not only would it keep her occupied, but there was even a chance she might actually find it.
Yuan then turned to Lev and asked, "Do you want to accompany her?
It would ease my worries a little if the two of you traveled together, considering you're both still unfamiliar with this world."
Lev immediately nodded his head and said, "Yes, I can go with her.
I would also feel much safer with someone as powerful as her by my side."
"Good.
Then it's decided.
The two of you can search for the Absolute Power, and while you're at it, explore this world."
"Do you have any clues for us?" Lev then asked.
"Nope," Yuan replied without hesitation.
"The Absolute Power is completely invisible to both senses and treasures, so you'd basically be searching for a ghost."
He then added, "The only thing I can tell you is that it won't be located within an artificial world and that it's somewhere within this world."
"Then how are we supposed to know if we come across it?" Dena asked.
"Beats me." Yuan simply shrugged.
"Are you messing with me?" Dena frowned, suspecting that he was being deliberately unhelpful because he disapproved of her decision to search for it.
"There's a reason nobody has managed to find it yet.
If it were that easy, the Eternals would have already obtained it long ago," Yuan said with a sigh.
"That being said, the Absolute Power possesses the ability to weaken the influence of Eternals.
Since you're now a Pseudo Eternal yourself, there's a chance you might sense something if you get close to it."
"Is that so..."
"Before you go... remember the rules I gave Selena and the others?
They also apply to you two, so don't go around picking fights with people."
"What if someone picks a fight with us?" Dena asked with a serious expression.
"The vast majority of people in this world haven't even lived for a million years.
Compared to you, they're basically infants," Yuan replied calmly.
"So try your best to ignore them."
After a brief pause, he added, "And if they refuse to be ignored... then do what you think is right... without blowing things out of proportion."

chapters.title: Chapter 2498 Yan Hara's Question
paragraphs: "I understand. I will try my best not to kill anyone," Dena said with a nonchalant expression.

Yuan then turned to Lev and smiled, "I know you'll probably be too intimidated to stop her, but since you're the more reasonable one, I expect you to talk some sense into her if she starts going overboard."
"I... will try," Lev responded after swallowing nervously.
Some time later, Lev and Dena left together.
"Looks like I am alone once again..." Yuan muttered with a smile.
"What about me?" A voice suddenly resounded.
Yuan turned to look at the Demon Annihilation Sword and fell silent for a moment.
Then, he asked, "Can you return to your sword form? Or is that human form permanent?"
In response to his question, the Demon Annihilation Sword suddenly started glowing throughout her body, and in the next moment, reverted back to her sword form.
"That's good—"
Before Yuan could even finish his sentence, the Demon Annihilation Sword immediately transformed again, returning to her human form.
"I like this form better," she said.
Yuan fell silent. It wasn't that he disliked her walking around in a human form. The real issue was her appearance, as she had taken on the form of Ai Rong—Tian Chenyu's childhood sweetheart.
"I don't mind if you want to remain in that form, but can you change your appearance?"
"Why?" she asked while tilting her head, looking genuinely confused by his request.
After all, she had taken on the appearance of the person most precious to him—to Tian Chenyu—so she could not comprehend why he would want her to abandon it.

"Because that appearance belongs to someone else, and you are not that person," Yuan explained calmly. "Since you possess a will of your own, you should take on an appearance that you personally like instead."

Admittedly, the Demon Annihilation Sword could not fully understand Yuan's logic. However, when she noticed the faint trace of pain hidden within his eyes, she felt an unfamiliar sensation stir within her heart.
Then, without a word, she changed her appearance. However, since she didn't know what sort of appearance she liked, she decided to just revert to her sword form to save herself the trouble.

Seeing this, Yuan immediately felt a little guilty since it wasn't as though the Demon Annihilation Sword was purposefully taunting him with Ai Rong's appearance, and he knew that she'd done it to please him.
'Ai Rong... where are you now?' Yuan sighed inwardly.

He had already reunited with the reincarnations of several lovers from his past lives, yet he still had not encountered Ai Rong. This made him wonder whether she was still somewhere out there... or if something else had happened to her entirely.

After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke again, "After giving it some thought, I suppose it won't hurt if you continue using that appearance for a little while longer—at least until you become more familiar with humans and discover your own preferences."
The Demon Annihilation Sword immediately returned to her human form and then asked, "What about you? I can tell that you feel pain whenever you look at me."
Although she did not say it outright, she had long noticed that Yuan had been deliberately avoiding looking directly at her ever since she first assumed Ai Rong's appearance.
"Sure, it's a little painful," Yuan admitted. "But that's because I haven't seen that face for so long. I'll quickly get over it."
"Anyways, you can remain in that appearance for now. End of discussion."
The Demon Annihilation Sword quietly nodded.
Some time later, Yuan left the building and met up with Kelan again.
"I'll be leaving now."
"What about your friends?"
"They've also left."
"I see. What are you going to do now? Visit the others?"
"I will... after I am done with my current business."
"Alright."
"By the way, I met your sister." Yuan suddenly remarked.
"Which one?"
"You have multiple?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Four... since I last visited. It's been a long time since I visited my family, so I might have more now," he sighed.
"Is that so? I met Keling, Meixiu's master."
"I figured. What did you talk about?
"Nothing much. I did give her a few techniques as a thank-you for training Meixiu. That's about it," he said, not mentioning their spar.
"D-Did you give her 'that' technique?" Kelan swallowed nervously.
"What technique?" Yuan asked, playing dumb.
"You know what I mean!" Kelan cried out loud.
"Who knows?" he shrugged.
"Y-You...!" Kelan was speechless.
"Anyway, I have to leave now. See ya later."
Before Kelan could say anything else, Yuan vanished into thin air like a ghost.
"Void Manipulation!" Kelan exclaimed. "And to such a terrifying degree! Just how much stronger has he grown since our spar?"
After leaving the Super Perfect Physique Tempering Sect, Yuan returned to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library to look for Yan Hara.
Inside her private office, Yan Hara was busy dealing with the countless responsibilities that came with becoming the Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan.
"That bastard Qian Chu! I can't believe how much work he left behind for me!" she cursed out loud while scratching her head.
Not only did she have to deal with Qian Chu's unfinished work, but she also had to deal with the Demon Sealing Grotto's businesses now that they had combined, as well as Yuan's banquet.
"I don't think I have ever seen you so busy."
A familiar voice suddenly resounded, halting Yan Hara's thoughts.
When she looked up, she saw Yuan walking into her office with a calm smile on his face.
"Y—Senior Tian..."
Yuan closed the door behind him and said, "Just call me Yuan when we are alone."
"Yuan..."

After a moment of hesitation, Yan Hara asked, "I have been wanting to ask you this ever since your return, so I will get straight to the point... Just what are you planning by coming back as the Divine Paragon? What about your current identity—your life as Yuan?"
After a moment of silence, Yuan replied with a calm smile, "There appears to be a misunderstanding here."

chapters.title: Chapter 2499 The Time and Location of the Banquet
paragraphs: "A misunderstanding?" Yan Hara raised her eyebrows.

"What is there to misunderstand?" she sighed. "Since you've come back as the Divine Paragon, you'll have to live his identity starting now. Or do you think you'll be able to switch between the Divine Paragon and Yuan like a switch whenever you want? It might work for some time, but sooner or later, you'll be exposed."
"So what if I am exposed? It's not like I am pretending to be the Divine Paragon," Yuan calmly shrugged.
"That being said..."
He suddenly approached Yan Hara and leaned toward her shoulder, whispering a few words directly into her ear.

At first, Yan Hara blushed from the warmth of his breath and the gentle closeness of his voice. However, the more she listened, the wider her eyes became, quickly filling with shock and disbelief after realizing what he was planning.
"That's insane!" she exclaimed loudly.
Yuan said nothing and merely stood still with a profound smile on his face.
"Are you really going to...?" Yan Hara asked in a saddened voice.
He nodded, remaining silent.

After another moment of silence, Yan Hara sighed again before speaking, "Let's talk about your banquet. I have notified everyone about it. The only issue right now is the venue and time. As I'd already mentioned, without the Stairway to Heaven, gathering everyone will be difficult, unless we host the banquet in the Grand Library. As for the time... this is something you must decide since I don't know when you'll be available."
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "The banquet will happen two months from now in the Seventh Heaven... right beside the Demonic Realm."
"What...?"
Yan Hara's jaw dropped, her eyes widened with disbelief.

"If I am going to tell everyone about the Demonic Realm, we might as well do so right beside it, right? As for the Stairway to Heaven... it will return by then, so everyone will be able to make it there. More people will be able to show up in the Seventh Heaven than the Ninth Heaven, too."

Yan Hara then said, "Then we'll need to start working on creating the venue. Fortunately, there's plenty of space over there. As for the size... I guess I'll just make it as big as I can make it in two months."
"Thanks for helping me out."
"Don't mention it. You're busy, right?"
He nodded with a smile.
"What are your plans until the banquet?
"Bringing the Stairway to Heaven back."
Yan Hara raised her eyebrows.
"Bring it back? How? Nobody even knows where it disappeared to, unless..."
She rubbed her eyes and sighed, "Of course you do. Why did I even bother asking?"
Yuan chuckled at her reaction and revealed, "I own the Stairway to Heaven, after all."
"Huh? Since when?"
"Since its creation," he calmly replied.
"Wait... that would mean..." Yan Hara's eyes widened again with shock.
However, Yuan didn't elaborate this time and turned around, walking to the exit.
"I'll see you in two months, Leader Yan!"
Before Yan Hara could reply, Yuan walked out of the room, leaving her utterly speechless.
"He's also the creator of the Stairway to Heaven...?" Yan Hara muttered to herself long after Yuan left.
Meanwhile, after leaving the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, Yuan went to look for the Stairway to Heaven.
However, there was one issue. Although he knew where it was located, he didn't know how to access it. After all, this was the first time the Stairway to Heaven had used this defensive mechanism.
A few moments later, Yuan retrieved Number One Under Heaven and spoke to it.
"Zi Xuan, you should be awake by now, right?"
"Zi Xuan? Are you angry?" he asked with a stiff smile.
"What gave you such an impression?" Zi Xuan finally responded.
"Because... I haven't been using you recently?"
"Not just that, but you've been cheating on me with another sword!"
Zi Xuan suddenly materialized in her spirit form and pointed at the Demon Annihilation Sword.
"Who is that?!"
Since the Demon Annihilation Sword had disappeared alongside Tian Chenyu, none of Yuan's later incarnations had ever wielded it. As a result, Zi Xuan had never heard of its existence before.
"This is the sword wielded by Tian Chenyu, who existed before Tian Qiyuan..." Yuan quickly explained.
"That doesn't explain why you're using her instead of me!"

Yuan sighed and said, "You know the reason very well. I have been in the Demonic Realm, and she's literally a demon-sealing sword. It was far more effective to use her in such a situation. Moreover, I wanted you to rest properly."
He continued, "Now that we've returned to the Nine Heavens, I will start using you again."
"What about me?" the Demon Annihilation Sword suddenly asked. "Am I going to become useless now that we're no longer in the Demonic Realm?"

"That's..." Yuan hesitated for a moment before continuing in an awkward tone, "I wouldn't call you useless... but once all the demons in this world have been dealt with, your purpose will technically be fulfilled."
Even as he said those words, Yuan felt unsure how to explain it without sounding like a complete asshole.
"Of course, that doesn't mean you'll become useless," Yuan quickly added. "At the end of the day, as long as the Demonic Realm continues to exist, your presence will always be needed."
"As for you..." Yuan returned to Zi Xuan. "You know where Tian Qiyuan's personal world is, right? I still cannot remember, so I'll need you to take me there."
"Hmph," she coldly snorted, clearly still upset.
Yuan rubbed his eyes and said, "If you don't tell me, I won't be able to upgrade you..."
"What did you just say?" Zi Xuan's ears immediately twitched the moment she heard a certain word.
She slowly turned to look at him with sparkling eyes, resembling a dog that had just heard its favorite word.
"I said that I'm going to upgrade you," Yuan repeated as he retrieved a certain material from his spatial ring and showed it to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 2500 Returning to the Primordial Chaos(End of Divine Paragon's Return Arc)
paragraphs: Zi Xuan stared at the material in Yuan's grasp with a dumbfounded look on her face.

"I thought Number One Under Heaven was your perfect masterpiece. I cannot imagine it becoming any stronger than it already is—not to mention that you still haven't fully unlocked all of its abilities."

A faint smile appeared on Yuan's face as he replied, "There is no such thing as true perfection. Although Number One Under Heaven was my greatest creation as Tian Qiyuan, at the end of the day, it is still merely a mortal treasure."

He then continued, "Furthermore, after learning about Eternals and the treasures they created, I realized there was still an enormous amount of room for improvement. That being said, since I still haven't learned their techniques, I can only do some slight upgrade for now."
"Even if it's just a little, I am already shivering with excitement," Zi Xuan remarked with a weird smile on her face.
"So, where is Tian Qiyuan's world?"
"It is located in the hottest place in the Nine Heavens—the Apocalyptic Chasm, which exists deep within the Primordial Chaos."
"The Primordial Chaos again, huh?" Yuan muttered, recalling when he went there to enter the Primordial Realm.
However, he'd only gone far enough to reach the Primordial Realm the last time, which was barely inside the Primordial Chaos.
"Let's head to the Primordial Chaos now," he said a moment later.
Meanwhile, word of the banquet started spreading again, this time with the time and location revealed.
"The Divine Paragon's banquet will be held in the Seventh Heaven beside the Demonic Realm in two months!"
"What? Beside the Demonic Realm? I know he's the Divine Paragon, but that's a little..."
"What is there to be afraid of? With the Divine Paragon present, no demon will even dare to get close, much less attack."
"I am not worried about our safety... It just feels... like a weird location to have a banquet."
"I think it's the perfect location to celebrate the return of someone like the Divine Paragon, though.
"How are we going to get to the Seventh Heaven, anyway? Even if we travel through the Starry Sky, we won't make it there in time for the banquet."
"I thought the Celestial Emperor was working to replace the Stairway to Heaven. Do you think it'll be done in time for the banquet?"
"Only time will tell..."
Somewhere in the Ninth Heaven...
"You heard about the upcoming banquet, right? Are you going to attend?" Keling asked Meixiu.
"No," Meixiu responded without hesitation, shaking her head. "I highly doubt Yuan is hosting a banquet just for the sake of it, and whatever he has planned, I do not want to become a burden."
"Is that so? Then let's continue our training."
A few days later, Yuan arrived at the entrance to the Primordial Chaos, a vast expanse resembling an enormous floating slab of rock suspended in the endless void.
"Just like before, this place is filled to the brim with Chaotic Essence," Yuan muttered after examining the place, and the longer he looked, the more it reminded him of the Primal Expanse.
"This place hasn't changed one bit, huh?" Zi Xuan remarked with a nostalgic look on her face.

She then looked at Yuan and continued with a smile, "Did you know that this is where I earned most of the money I used to buy your swords back then? Since very few people dare to approach this place, it's filled with treasures."
"Not only that, but the magical beasts here are incredibly unique, and the materials from their bodies can sell for a fortune."
"Still, it's incredibly dangerous, and I would have several near-death encounters every time I came here."
"Are you bragging right now?" Yuan smiled.
Zi Xuan shook her head and said, "If it weren't for your swords fueling my desire to survive, I definitely wouldn't have lasted long enough to become your Sword Spirit."
Some time later, they entered the Primordial Chaos.

"The Primordial Chaos is divided into seven levels, and the deeper one goes, the more dangerous it becomes. Our destination—the Apocalyptic Chasm—is located within the fifth level," Zi Xuan explained.

"Also, it's highly advised not to use Void Manipulation while inside. The spatial distortions within the Primordial Chaos are extremely unstable, and you could easily end up being teleported somewhere you never intended to go."
"Is there anything else I should be wary of?" Yuan asked.

"Well..." Zi Xuan pondered for a moment before continuing, "If you were an ordinary cultivator, I'd warn you to conserve your spiritual energy as much as possible, since it's impossible to recover it naturally inside the Primordial Chaos, and even recovery pills have their effects drastically weakened here."
Sure enough, because of his unique physique and Chaotic Hearts, Yuan had no issue recovering his spiritual energy with the Chaotic Essence there.

Upon entering the first level of the Primordial Chaos, Yuan did not waste any time observing his surroundings and immediately flew straight toward the second level, completely ignoring the magical beasts chasing after him.
Even though he had only just entered the Primordial Chaos, the weakest magical beasts there were already at the first level of God Ascension.
Not wanting to waste time and energy fighting them, Yuan released a portion of his aura in an attempt to scare the magical beasts away.
However, they did not even flinch and continued chasing after him relentlessly.
"The magical beasts here do not fear death. They've suppressed their instincts to such an extent that even their natural fear can be completely ignored," Zi Xuan explained.
"What a pain in the ass..." Yuan sighed aloud before casually cutting them down with Supreme Sword Aura, not even bothering to stop and collect their materials afterward.
However, it did not take long before even more magical beasts began chasing after him once again.
"I'll take care of them for you," Zi Xuan suddenly said. "I need to prepare for my upgrade, after all."
